items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第283页 持续风险评估的重要性 持续评估金融犯罪风险 金融犯罪风险具有动态性和持续演变性。犯罪分子始终试图通过金融体系转移非法资金而不 被察觉，他们将利用新技术和趋势，无视金融机构建立的管控措施。犯罪分子不断寻找可利 用的漏洞，并测试反洗钱（AFC）框架的抗风险能力。 当企业发生重大业务变更时，必须重新评估相关风险。此类变更可能包括高风险产品供应、 进入新市场或组织运营所在司法管辖区的变更。 持续评估金融犯罪风险有助于企业适应不断演进的机器学习/交易欺诈技术及威胁态 势，通过交易监测识别模式与重大异常变化，有效应对新兴地域性风险，并确保符合监 管要求与国际标准。 FATF 与监管机构倡导主动风险管理策略，并根据需要重新评估风险。通过这种策略及 定期风险评估，企业能够将资源集中投入高风险领域，从而有效降低风险。 除定期开展全企业范围的风险评估外，组织机构还通过持续风险评估（CRA）对风 险进行持续管理。 企业在与客户建立业务关系前，应对每位新客户开展客户风险评估（CRA）。同时需定期复 核评估结果，若客户行为模式或风险特征发生变更时也应及时更新评估。此类变更可能包 括： • 交易模式偏差 • 新产品或服务申请 • 拒绝提供信息或文件。 • 暴露于高风险司法管辖区的风险增加。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 283 The importance of continuous risk assessment Continuously assessing financial crime risk Financial crime risks are dynamic and constantly evolving. Criminals will always attempt to move illicit funds through the financial sector undetected. They will use new technologies and trends, regardless of the controls that organizations establish. Criminals continuously search for loopholes to exploit and test the resilience of AFC frameworks. Organizations must reevaluate risks whenever there is a material change to their business. This could include higher-risk product offerings, entering a new market, or changes in jurisdictions where the organization operates. Continuously assessing financial crime risk helps organizations adapt to evolving ML/TF techniques and threats, monitor transactions to detect patterns and significant changes, respond to emerging geographical risks, and meet regulations and international standards. FATF and regulatory bodies promote a proactive approach to risk management and reassessing risks as required. This approach, and regular risk assessments, enable organizations to divert their resources to high-risk areas to mitigate them effectively. In addition to conducting overarching enterprise-wide risk assessments regularly, organizations manage risk continually through CRAs. Organizations should conduct a CRA for every customer they onboard before establishing a business relationship with that customer. They should also review the CRA regularly and whenever there are changes in a customer’s behavior and risk profile. These changes might include: • Transaction pattern deviations. • Requests for new products or services. • Reluctance to provide information or documentation. • Increased exposure to high-risk jurisdictions.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第284页 • 客户所属行业的变化 • 组织运营方式的变化，例如产品线调整或转向在线业务运营模式。 客户行为分析（CRAs）系统可帮助组织监测客户行为变化并重新评估风险。例如，若发现 客户计划将销售业务拓展至高风险地区，企业需采取强化措施，包括加强第三方资质审核、 要求补充文件材料或提高交易审查标准。 产品与渠道风险评估能帮助组织发现产品使用场景与预期用途的偏差，从而有效识别潜在 威胁或风险。部分风险可能在产品上市初期并不明显，但可通过持续监测逐步显现。以新 冠疫情为例，企业纷纷转向数字化渠道运营，这要求企业同步完善线下渠道管控措施，以 应对新型欺诈风险——包括数字身份盗用、跨境电汇交易以及文件真实性验证方式革新等 挑战。 这些风险评估有助于组织持续评估金融犯罪风险，并使其能够采取全面、主动的方法，根据 需要对风险进行管理和重新评估。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 284 • Changes in the customer’s sector. • Changes in how the organization operates, such as changing product lines or shifting to online business operations. CRAs enable organizations to detect changes in customer behavior and reassess risks. For example, if an organization detects that a customer plans to extend its sales to high-risk jurisdictions, it might need to introduce enhanced measures such as increased third-party screening, request additional documentation, or increase transaction scrutiny. Product and channel risk assessments enable organizations to detect deviations from the intended use of their products, helping to identify new threats or risks. Some risks might not be clear at product launch, but might be identified through ongoing monitoring. For example, during COVID-19, organizations shifted to digital channels. This required aligning existing face- to-face channel controls to address emerging fraud risks, such as digital identity fraud, cross-border wire transfers, and new ways of verifying the authenticity of documentation. These risk assessments help organizations continuously assess financial crime risks and enable them to take a holistic, proactive approach to manage and reassess risks as needed.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第285页 客户风险评估与企业级风险评估对比 CRA评估与个别客户及业务关系相关的潜在ML/TF风险。相比之下，EWRA 则分析整个组 织面临的ML/TF风险。 客户风险评估 企业范围风险评估 评估客户及业务关系的个体风险敞口 评估组织风险敞口 利用KYC 信息评估入职时的风险，并通过持 续尽职调查更新风险评估 识别固有风险并评估控制措施 确定是否需要EDD 确定剩余风险以指导控制措施的设计并分配 资源 根据美国金融犯罪执法局（FinCEN）发布的《基于风险评估客户关系及开展客户尽职调查 的联合声明》》，客户关系涉及不同层级的金融犯罪风险。金融机构通过客户关系评估 （CRA）识别风险因素、为客户分配风险评级、建立风险档案，并确定适用的客户尽职调 查（CDD）级别。客户关系评估综合考量通过KYC 流程收集的信息，包括客户文件资 料、业务活动记录及产品需求等要素。高风险客户可能需要执行尽职调查（EDD），而低 风险客户在某些司法管辖区可能符合简化尽职调查（SDD）的条件。尽职调查要求因司法 管辖区而异。 该EWRA 识别固有风险、评估控制措施，并确定组织面临的剩余风险。该流程有助于组织 设计反洗钱/反CFT 框架，指导政策与程序制定，将资源分配至高风险领域，并提升决策质 量。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 285 Customer risk assessment versus enterprise-wide risk assessment The CRA evaluates potential ML/TF risks associated with individual customers and business relationships. In contrast, the EWRA analyzes ML/TF risks that the organization as a whole faces. Customer risk assessment Enterprise-wide risk assessment Assesses individual customer and business relationship risk exposure Assesses organizational risk exposure Uses KYC information to assess risk at onboarding and ongoing due diligence to update the risk Identifies inherent risks and assesses controls Determines whether EDD is needed Determines residual risk to guide the design of the control and allocate resources According to FinCEN’s Joint Statement on the Risk-Based Approach to Assessing Customer Relationships and Conducting Customer Due Diligence, customer relationships present varying levels of financial crime risks. Organizations conduct CRAs to identify risk factors, assign risk ratings to customers, create risk profiles, and decide which level of CDD to apply. The CRA considers information collected through KYC processes, such as documents, customer business activity, and requested products. Higher-risk customers might require EDD, while lower-risk customers might qualify for simplified due diligence (SDD) in some jurisdictions. Due diligence requirements vary depending on the jurisdiction. The EWRA identifies inherent risks, assesses controls, and determines the residual risk that the organization faces. The process helps organizations design their AML/CFT framework, guides policy and procedure development, allocates resources toward higher-risk areas, and improves decision-making.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第286页 产品风险评估 产品风险评估有助于企业识别并理解金融产品所涉及的风险与威胁，同时评估犯罪分子可能 利用这些产品洗钱的行为。在完成风险评估后，企业可采取相应措施加以缓解。 为识别和理解风险，组织应考虑以下因素： • 产品固有特性：包括跨境电汇支付、第三方支付服务、匿名性、远程访问功能、第三 方接入权限、结构与复杂度异常、交易监管力度薄弱以及现金密集型运营模式等核心 特征。 • 产品交易模式：重复行为与趋势分析 例如快速交易、大额交易量、高频交易、涉及高风险或受制裁司法管辖区，以及高 风险客户在高风险行业中的使用。 每种产品均应根据其所涉及的AML/ CFT 风险获得风险评分。对每种产品及其风险进行清 晰、书面化的定义，有助于组织机构进行恰当评估。已识别的风险会影响EWRA 及风险评 估系统（RAS）。例如，若多个产品被判定为高风险，则会提升整体EWRA 风险评分，从 而需要采取额外管控措施。若某产品的风险评估分数超过风险评估标准（RAS），企业可 能停止该产品的供应。 产品风险评估对于设计交易监控等控制措施也具有重要价值，可确保对所有产品实现 充分覆盖。 尽管产品风险评估流程可能因组织规模不同而有所差异，但通常包括以下内容： • 产品开发：负责产品设计并提供技术规格。 • IT：提供必要的技术基础设施。 • 运营分析：提供产品使用模式的深度洞察 • 合规性：识别控制措施并确保合规性。 • 法律服务：提供相关法律适用方面的法律援助。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 286 Product risk assessment A product risk assessment helps organizations identify and understand the risks and threats associated with their financial products. It assesses how criminals might use these products to launder illicit funds. After identifying and assessing these risks and threats, organizations can implement measures to mitigate them. To identify and understand risks, organizations should consider factors, including: • Inherent product characteristics: Features or attributes such as cross- border wire payments, third-party payments, anonymity, remote access, third-party access, unusual complexity and structure, minimal transaction oversight, and cash-intensive nature. • Transactional patterns of the product: Recurring behaviors and trends such as rapid movements, high volumes, frequent transactions, involvement of high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions, and use by high-risk customers in high-risk sectors. Each product should receive a risk score based on the AML/CFT risks it presents. A clear, documented definition of each product and its risks helps organizations assess them appropriately. Identified risks affect the EWRA and the RAS. For example, if many products are deemed high-risk, this raises the overall EWRA risk score, prompting additional controls or measures. If a product’s risk assessment score exceeds the RAS, the organization might cease offering it. A product risk assessment is also very useful in designing controls such as transaction monitoring to ensure adequate coverage of all products. Although the product risk assessment process might vary, depending on the organization’s size, it typically includes: • Product development: Designs the product and provides specifications. • IT: Provides necessary technological infrastructure. • Operations: Provides insights about product usage patterns • Compliance: Identifies control measures and ensures compliance. • Legal: Provides legal assistance on applicable laws.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第287页 合规官在监督产品风险评估过程中发挥着积极作用。他们负责识别风险、评估相 关控制措施，并分配适当的风险评分。 由于风险评估是一个持续性过程，企业应定期对新产品和现有产品进行审查。对于新产 品，应在向客户推出前完成评估。产品上市后，应定期进行审查，并在发生重大产品变更 时及时评估。清晰且结构严谨的风险评估有助于识别潜在漏洞和风险敞口。 企业有时会发现新旧产品存在未被识别的风险隐患。例如，某预付卡产品若出现高风险客 户频繁进行大额交易的情况，就需要重新评估产品风险等级，调整交易频次与金额的阈值 标准，或限制该产品仅面向特定客户群体。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 287 Compliance officers play an active role in overseeing the product risk assessment. They identify risks, assess relevant controls, and assign appropriate risk scores. Because risk assessment is an ongoing process, organizations should review both new and existing products regularly. For new products, the assessment should be conducted before they are offered to customers. Once the product becomes available, it should be reviewed periodically and whenever significant product changes occur. A clear and well-structured risk assessment helps identify vulnerabilities and exposures. Sometimes, organizations might notice previously unidentified risks for a new or existing product. For example, a new prepaid card might show high volumes of rapid transactions from high-risk customers. This might require revisiting the product risk assessment and setting thresholds for the number of transactions, volumes, or restricting the product to certain customer sectors.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第288页 设计您的AFC程序与控制系统 引言 引言：设计您的AFC程序及控制系统 反洗钱（AFC）计划是金融犯罪风险管理的基石，旨在帮助金融机构预防、识别、降低风险 并上报非法金融活动。全球标准制定机构与各国监管机构均建议或强制要求实施基于风险 的反洗钱计划，其核心组成部分包括： 包括持续性数据披露（CDD）、事件驱动披露（EDD）、实时监控、交易报告、风险评 估及治理监督。金融机构需定期更新政策，以应对不断演变的威胁、监管变化及新兴技 术（如人工智能驱动的金融犯罪检测）。具备全球视野的反洗钱（AFC）计划有助于提 升合规性、增强抗风险能力并维护金融诚信，有效防范洗钱、恐怖主义融资及制裁违规 行为。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 288 Design Your AFC Program and Controls Introduction Introduction: Design your AFC program and controls An AFC program is the cornerstone of financial crime risk management, ensuring that organizations prevent, detect, mitigate, and report illicit financial activities. Global standard setters and national regulatory bodies recommend or mandate risk-based AML programs. Key program components include CDD, EDD, ongoing monitoring, transaction reporting, risk assessments, and governance oversight. Institutions must regularly update policies to address evolving threats, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies, such as AI-driven financial crime detection. A globally aware AFC program fosters compliance, resilience, and financial integrity, safeguarding institutions against money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions violations.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第289页 案例研究：加拿大某银行治理缺失问题 2023年12月，加拿大金融交易与报告分析中心（fintrac）对加拿大皇家银行（RBC）处以 747.5万加元罚款，因其违反《犯罪所得（洗钱及恐怖主义融资法）》相关规定。 监管机构在2022年合规检查中发现了AML/ CFT 缺陷。主要问题包括： • 尽管有合理依据怀疑交易与洗钱活动存在关联，但RBC未能提交16份可疑交易报告 （SAR）。在其他案例中，SAR的提交方式不符合规定的监管标准。 • 加拿大皇家银行（RBC）在制定、更新及实施反洗钱/反恐融资（AML/CTF）政策与程 序方面缺乏完善的书面治理文件。 • 加拿大皇家银行（RBC）在识别可疑活动及提交可疑交易报告（STRs）方面存在流程 不完善的问题。此外，该银行对可疑交易报告（SAR）提交的指导方针缺乏一致性， 且未纳入fintrac提出的“合理依据”阈值标准。 本案例说明了监管不力如何导致关键金融犯罪防控措施存在漏洞。由于治理结构不完善，加 拿大皇家银行（RBC）未能制定、更新及实施适当的政策与程序。该银行未按法律规定提交 可疑交易报告（SARs），因此在执法行动中遭受了财务损失和声誉损害。反洗钱政策必须 具有动态性和风险导向性。金融机构需持续更新治理框架，以应对不断演变的反洗钱/ CFT 风险。 为确保强有力的反洗钱/反CFT 治理，董事会及高级管理层必须积极监督反洗钱合规工 作。反洗钱/反CFT 政策应定期审查并更新，以反映新的监管要求。应定期开展独立审计 与测试，以确保治理结构持续有效。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 289 Case study: Lack of governance at a Canadian bank In December 2023, the Financial Transactions and Reports Analysis Centre of Canada (FINTRAC) imposed a CA$7.475 million fine on Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) for non-compliance with the Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act. The regulator discovered AML/CFT deficiencies during its compliance examination in 2022. Key failures included: • RBC failed to file 16 SARs, despite reasonable grounds to suspect that transactions were linked to money laundering activities. In other cases, SARs were filed in a way inconsistent with prescribed regulatory standards. • RBC lacked adequate documented governance for developing, updating, and implementing AML/CTF policies and procedures. • RBC had incomplete procedures for identifying suspicious activity and filing STRs. In addition, the bank kept inconsistent guidance on SAR filings that did not incorporate FINTRAC’s “reasonable grounds” threshold. This case illustrates how weak oversight can create gaps in key financial crime controls. Due to inadequate governance, RBC failed to develop, update, and implement appropriate policies and procedures. The bank did not file SARs as required by law. It suffered financial consequences and reputational damage from the enforcement action. AML policies must be dynamic and risk-based. Financial institutions must continuously update governance frameworks to align with evolving AML/CFT risks. To ensure strong AML/CFT governance, boards of directors and senior leadership must actively oversee AML compliance. AML/CFT policies should be regularly reviewed and updated to reflect new regulatory requirements. Regular, independent audits and testing should be done to ensure governance structures remain effective.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第290页 关键要点 • 治理薄弱可能导致合规性失败及监管罚款。 • 监管机构期望制定动态且基于风险的反洗钱政策。 • 高层领导必须直接参与反洗钱（AML）项目的监督工作。 • 定期审计可确保治理有效性并防止监管违规行为。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 290 Key takeaways • Weak governance might lead to compliance failures and regulatory fines. • Regulators expect dynamic, risk-based AML policies. • Senior leadership must be directly involved in oversight of AML programs. • Periodic audits ensure governance effectiveness and prevent regulatory breaches.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第291页 治理和监督 需要制定AFC政策与程序 政策与程序是AFC合规计划中管理风险的核心指导文件。总体而言，政策将适用于组织的法 律法规要求转化为具体条款；程序则为实施政策的分步操作指南。这些政策与程序通常包 含对高层监督的强制性要求。 起草AFC政策和程序 AFC政策与程序构成企业AFC合规框架的核心要素，既能确保风险管控的有效性、法规遵从 性及运营完整性，又需具备清晰性、风险导向性及业务模式适应性，同时严格遵循全球及各 司法管辖区的AFC标准要求。 AFC政策与程序是什么？ • 政策文件确立了AFC合规性的原则、目标及监管义务，将法律与监管要求转化为企业 特定承诺。 • 该程序提供了详细的分步实施指南，以确保各项政策在不同业务部门及司法管辖区中得 到一致执行。通常会为同一项政策制定独立的执行流程，以便根据不同业务部门和司法 管辖区的具体情况调整其实施方式。 AFC政策与程序为何具有重要意义？ • 政策与程序确保合规性。金融机构通常选择使其政策与FATF 建议、巴塞尔银行监管 委员会（BCBS）指南、国家反洗钱法律及监管要求保持一致。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 291 Governance and oversight Need for AFC policies and procedures Policies and procedures are essential guidelines on managing risks for an AFC compliance program. In general, policies translate legal and regulatory requirements as applicable to the organization. Procedures are the step-by- step instructions on how to implement policies. Policies and procedures generally include requirements for oversight at senior levels. Drafting AFC policies and procedures AFC policies and procedures form the core of an organization’s AFC compliance framework, ensuring effective risk management, adherence to regulations, and operational integrity. These policies must be clear, risk-based, and adaptable to evolving business models while aligning with global and jurisdictional AFC standards. What are AFC policies and procedures? • Policies establish the principles, objectives, and regulatory obligations for AFC compliance. They translate legal and regulatory requirements into business-specific commitments. • Procedures provide detailed, step-by-step implementation guidance to ensure policies are applied consistently across different business units and jurisdictions. Separate procedures are often written for a policy to tailor its execution to various business units and jurisdictions. Why are AFC policies and procedures important? • Policies and procedures ensure regulatory compliance. Institutions typically choose to align their policies with FATF Recommendations, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS) guidelines, national AML laws, and regulatory expectations.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第292页 • 政策应确保全面覆盖范围，涵盖所有产品与服务（包括未来新增项目），以避免合规 性漏洞。 • 为遵循基于风险的方法，政策必须根据机构风险敞口、客户特征及地理风险因素进行 定制化设计。 • 为确保治理结构与问责机制的有效实施，需建立结构化的政策框架，明确合规管理中的 角色分工、职责划分及监督机制。 各组织应制定明确的规程，以确定何时需采纳新政策，并规定其起草、批准及更新的流 程。 完善的政策应当包含应对各类例外情况或豁免条款的条款，并明确划分具体人员或岗位的职 责范围。同时需制定定期审查机制（通常每年一次），并明确规定触发专项审查与更新的具 体事件，例如新产品上市或重大监管事件发生等情形。实施细则通常以流程文件形式呈现， 且会根据具体业务部门或其他实体的特性进行量身定制。通过这种方式，可快速对流程进行 调整，以反映不影响整个组织的变更。 AFC政策是如何设计和实施的？ • 采用基于风险的方法，组织应根据客户风险、产品风险及交易风险定制相关政 策。 • 为确保管辖权合规性，跨国组织必须使政策与各国特定法律保持一致，同时遵循全球 AFC原则。这可能导致在某些司法管辖区实施更高标准，以维持全球一致性。 • 为规范例外情况与豁免条款，政策偏差必须形成书面记录、提供合理依据，并经治理机 构批准。在适用情况下，可针对特定时段实施临时豁免。所有已知政策执行漏洞均须及 时记录并在合理期限内整改。为确保有效治理与监督，相关问题及政策违规记录可集中 归档保存。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 292 • Policies ensure comprehensive coverage. They should cover all products and services, including future offerings, to prevent compliance gaps. • To follow a risk-based approach, policies must be tailored to institutional risk exposure, customer profiles, and geographic risk factors. • To demonstrate proper governance and accountability, a structured policy framework ensures clear roles, responsibilities, and oversight mechanisms for compliance management. Organizations should maintain a clearly defined protocol to identify when a new policy must be adopted, as well as the process for drafting, approving, and updating it. Good policies should include provisions for addressing any exceptions or exemptions and should clearly assign responsibilities to specific people or roles. They should also provide a schedule for reviewing the policy, typically on an annual basis, and stipulate events that would trigger an ad hoc review and update. Examples include the introduction of a new product or the occurrence of a relevant regulatory event. Detailed implementation guidance is provided in procedures, which are typically tailored to specific business units or other entities. In this way, changes in procedures can be made quickly to reflect changes that do not impact the entire organization. How are AFC policies designed and implemented? • Using a risk-based approach, organizations should customize policies based on customer, product, and transaction risks. • To ensure jurisdictional compliance, multinational organizations must align policies with country-specific laws, while maintaining global AFC principles. This may result in implementing higher standards in some jurisdictions to maintain global consistency. • To govern exceptions and dispensations, deviations from policy must be documented, justified, and approved by governance bodies. Where appropriate, dispensation may be provided for a specific time. Any known gaps in implementing policies must be documented and addressed within a reasonable period. A record of issues and policy violations may be centrally maintained for effective governance and oversight.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第293页 • 在实施新政策时，组织机构通常会设置过渡期（例如六个月），以便实现以 下目标： o 差距分析与商业风险评估 o 系统、程序及流程更新 o 培训与员工教育。 金融机构通过制定清晰、可执行且具有灵活性的AFC政策，能够有效强化合规性、降低金 融犯罪风险，并提升运营韧性。 维持有效的AFC政策与程序 受监管机构要求的组织必须制定书面反洗钱（AFC）政策与程序，以降低和管理洗钱及 恐怖主义融资风险。组织应定期审查并更新这些政策与程序，通常每年一次，但具体更 新频率需根据组织所面临风险的性质而定。 企业还应针对可能改变其风险状况的事件开展定期评估，例如新业务拓展、管辖区域变更， 或审计及监管审查结果。若未能持续更新政策，可能导致新风险问题直至下次定期评估时才 得到处理。 此外，企业需持续关注新兴议题及监管动态。这种“战略视野扫描”尤为重要，因为AFC （美国联邦通信委员会）监管环境具有高度动态性。新流程的实施可能需要数月甚至数年 时间。主动开展战略视野扫描有助于企业及时高效地制定、调配资源并落实新政策。 政策的制定与审批过程应充分吸纳法律顾问、内部利益相关方及外部专家的意见（视情况而 定）。政策与程序一经批准，须确保全体员工持续可获取。组织应及时批准政策及程序的变 更，并形成书面文件，向全体员工及时传达。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 293 • When implementing new policies, organizations typically include a transition period, such as six months, to allow for: o Gap analysis and business risk assessment. o System, procedural, and process updates o Training and staff education. By developing clear, enforceable, and adaptable AFC policies, financial institutions strengthen compliance, mitigate financial crime risks, and ensure operational resilience. Maintaining effective AFC policies and procedures Regulated organizations are required to maintain written AFC policies and procedures that mitigate and manage the risks of money laundering and terrorist financing. Organizations should regularly review and update these policies and procedures, typically on an annual basis, although the nature of the risks the organization is encountering should drive the frequency. Organizations should also conduct reviews in response to events that might change their risk profile, such as a new business or jurisdiction, or the results of an audit or regulatory examination. Failure to update policies on a continuous basis might result in a failure to address new risks until the next scheduled review. Additionally, organizations need to maintain awareness of emerging issues and regulatory activity. This “horizon scanning” is particularly important because the AFC environment is highly dynamic. It could take many months or even years to implement new processes. Proactive horizon scanning helps organizations plan, resource, and implement new policies in a timely and effective manner. The development and approval of policies should include the participation of legal counsel, other internal stakeholders, and external experts where appropriate. Once approved, policies and procedures should be accessible to all employees on an ongoing basis. Organizations should approve, document, and promptly communicate to their staff any changes to policies and procedures.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第294页 AFC政策与流程需根据组织的具体风险特征、风险承受能力及规模进行量身定制。跨国企业 应在定期审查和战略展望过程中开展差距分析，确保政策体系覆盖其运营所在司法管辖区的 相关地方法规。同时，区域或本地政策流程也需结合当地法律法规及风险特征进行调整，但 须确保不与企业全球政策产生冲突。 治理委员会及其职能 治理委员会在组织的金融犯罪合规框架中承担战略监督、决策权及问责职能。其核心职 责包括：确保反金融犯罪政策与程序符合监管要求及风险管理目标，同时支持高效的案 件升级、审查及执法流程。 治理委员会的架构必须基于组织的风险特征、监管义务及运营需求进行设计。 每个委员会均须依据职权范围文件开展工作，该文件需明确其职责、权限及授权范围。委员 会必须正式记录会议纪要，以供监管审计和内部治理审查使用。会议纪要通常包括所作决 策、提出异议事项以及异议处理方式。 关键委员会的示例包括： • 董事会风险委员会：该委员会通常由一名或多名董事会成员领导，负责对AFC风险进行 战略监督，确保相关政策符合全球及当地监管要求。委员会成员及主席可将相关事项提 请董事会审议。 • 反洗钱治理委员会：该委员会可由二线管理层领导，负责监督全企业范围内的反洗 钱/ CFT 风险管理、内部控制及反洗钱/ CFT 计划实施效果。委员会审议内容包括： 导致可疑交易报告（SARs）的警报审查进展、警报数量与分类情况、审计与鉴证审 查结果，以及新发风险。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 294 AFC policies and procedures should be tailored to the specific risk profile, risk appetite, and size of the organization. Global organizations should conduct gap analyses as part of their review and horizon scanning processes to ensure the policy covers relevant local regulations in the jurisdictions in which they operate. This may also require regional or local policies and procedures to reflect the local laws, regulations, and risks, as long as they do not conflict with the organization's global policy. Governance committees and their functions Governance committees provide strategic oversight, decision-making authority, and accountability in an organization’s financial crime compliance framework. They ensure that AFC policies and procedures are aligned with regulatory requirements and risk management objectives, while supporting effective escalation, review, and enforcement processes. Governance committees must be structured based on an organization’s risk profile, regulatory obligations, and operational needs. Each committee must operate under a terms-of-reference document, which outlines its mandate, responsibilities, and authority. The committee must formally record meeting minutes for regulatory audits and internal governance reviews. Meeting minutes typically include decisions made, objections raised, and how the objections were dealt with. Examples of key committees include the: • Board risk committee: This committee is typically led by one or more board members. It provides strategic oversight of AFC risks, ensuring policies align with global and jurisdictional regulations. The terms and the chair may escalate items for the board’s attention. • AML governance committee: This committee may be led by the second line and oversees enterprise-wide AML/CFT risk management, internal controls, and AML/CFT program effectiveness. It considers progress in reviewing alerts, volumes, and categories of alerts that resulted in SARs, results of audits and assurance reviews, and emerging risks.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第295页 • 高风险客户审查委员会：该委员会负责评估重点实体（PEPs）、代理银行及其他高风险 客户的入行流程及持续尽职调查工作。委员会通常由业务负责人领导，其中必须包含美 国外国资产控制委员会（AFC）合规团队作为法定成员。 • 制裁监督委员会：虽然AFC委员会通常包含制裁监督职能，但根据机构风险敞口程度， 可能需要设立独立委员会。该委员会负责确保遵守全球制裁计划、实施观察名单筛查及 执行升级程序。 治理委员会的Quora平台通常包含以下内容： • 董事会成员或高级管理人员需为AFC合规工作提供战略监督与资源配置支持。 • 首席合规官、MLRO 或其授权代表负责领导AFC政策执行、风险评估及监管事务对接 工作。 • 第一道防线是负责风险管控的业主方及在日常运营中执行AFC政策的运营领导者。 • 第二道防线旨在提供独立监督、政策执行及风险评估职能（必要时可辅以 MLRO）。 • 第三道防线是报告独立审计结果，并在适当情况下确保合规性有效性，同时 保持独立性。 金融机构通过建立结构完善、文件完备且高效的治理委员会，能够有效强化反洗钱合 规体系、提升监管参与度，并加强风险管理监督力度。 在监管审查期间，治理结构的稳健性可体现反洗钱（AML）计划的实施成效。审查人员 可通过文件及会议纪要索取职权范围说明与相关意见，并将其作为评估反洗钱委员会 （AFC）计划有效性的证据材料。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 295 • High-risk customer review committee: This committee assesses onboarding and ongoing due diligence for PEPs, correspondent banks, and other high-risk clients. It is typically led by business leaders, with AFC compliance teams forming part of the quorum. • Sanctions oversight committee: While AFC committees typically include sanctions oversight, there may be a need for a separate committee based on the organization’s risk exposure. It ensures compliance with global sanctions programs, watchlist screening, and escalation procedures. Quora for governance committees typically include: • Board members or senior executives to provide strategic oversight and resource allocation for AFC compliance. • The chief compliance officer, MLRO, or their delegates to lead AFC policy execution, risk assessments, and regulatory engagement. • The first line of defense risk owner and operational leaders who implement AFC policies in daily operations. • The second line of defense to provide independent oversight, policy enforcement, and risk assessments (in addition to the MLRO, if needed). • The third line of defense to report independent audits and ensure compliance effectiveness, where appropriate, while maintaining independence. By ensuring structured, well-documented, and effective governance committees, financial institutions strengthen AFC compliance, regulatory engagement, and risk management oversight. During regulatory exams, the robustness of the governance structure demonstrates the strength of the AML programs. Examiners may request terms of reference and inputs via papers and meeting minutes, and present them as evidence of the effectiveness of the AFC program.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第296页 向治理委员会提交内部报告 向治理委员会提交内部报告是机构反洗钱合规框架的核心职能。该机制确保高层管理者能 获得准确、及时且数据驱动的洞察，从而有效支持决策制定、风险管理及合规监管。内部 报告有助于识别金融犯罪风险、评估控制措施有效性，并维护监管问责机制。 内部报告通过使治理委员会能够主动应对金融犯罪威胁及监管义务，从而强化风险管控并确 保合规性。此外，这些报告为客户风险评级、政策修订及AFC资源配置提供依据。通过确保 监管合规与审计准备状态，内部报告彰显了企业对透明度与合规监控的坚定承诺。 内部AFC报告通常包含以下内容： • 关键风险指标（KRI）是用于评估AFC风险的定量与定性指标，包括可疑交易量及趋 势、尽职调查审查积压情况以及监控系统缺陷。 • 关键绩效指标（KPI）是衡量AFC控制效果的指标，包括SAR申报时限、筛查中假阳性 率降低率以及警报处理时间等。 • 监管合规更新内容应包含美国食品药品监督管理局（AFC）新规摘要、执法动向及新兴 风险分析，以确保政策始终符合现行法律要求。由于需要预留充足时间并进行资源规 划，对新兴风险及趋势开展全景扫描尤为重要。 • 监管检查报告、审计结果及内部风险评估：包含监管检查准备与发现情况报告、内外部 审计结果、已识别的合规性差距以及纠正措施跟踪记录。 • 高风险客户及交易报告包含对入职决策与尽职调查的评估。在某些情况下，委员会可能
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 296 Internal reporting to governance committees Internal reporting to governance committees is a critical function of an institution’s AFC compliance framework. It ensures that senior leadership has accurate, timely, and data-driven insights to support decision-making, risk management, and regulatory compliance. Internal reports help identify financial crime risks, assess control effectiveness, and maintain regulatory accountability. Internal reporting enhances risk oversight and ensures compliance by enabling governance committees to proactively address financial crime threats and regulatory obligations. In addition, these reports inform customer risk-ratings, policy revisions, and AFC resource allocation. By ensuring regulatory and audit readiness, internal reports demonstrate an organization’s commitment to transparency and compliance monitoring. Internal AFC reports usually contain: • Key risk indicators (KRI) are quantitative and qualitative metrics assessing AFC risks, including suspicious transaction volumes and trends, due diligence review backlog, and monitoring system deficiencies. • Key performance indicators (KPI) are measures of AFC control effectiveness, such as SAR filing timelines, false positive reduction rates in screening, and alert resolution times. • Regulatory and compliance updates should include summaries of new AFC regulations, enforcement trends, and emerging risks, to ensure that policies remain aligned with current legal obligations. Horizon scanning for emerging risks and trends is particularly important because it requires considerable lead time and resource planning. • Regulatory examination reports, audit findings, and internal risk assessments: Reports on regulatory examination preparation and findings, internal and external audit outcomes, identified compliance gaps, and corrective action tracking. • High-risk customer and transaction reports include assessments of onboarding decisions and due diligence. items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第297页 根据风险特征及其他因素，就是否吸纳或退出特定客户提出明确意见。 金融机构通过建立结构化、透明化且以风险为导向的内部报告机制，可有效提升治 理问责水平、加强监管合规性，并有效降低金融犯罪风险。 AFC合规性监管报告 监管报告是全球金融机构必须履行的核心义务，旨在确保遵守《反海外腐败法》（AFC）相 关规定、提升财务透明度并有效控制风险。不同司法管辖区通常设有独特的报告规则、申报 截止日期及信息披露要求。若违反规定，企业可能面临巨额罚款、声誉损害以及监管机构的 执法行动。 AFC监管报告的类型包括但不限于： • 持续报告：包括可疑活动报告及当前阈值报告，当出现可疑情况或达到特定阈值时需提 交此类报告。 • 定期报告：包括年度MLRO 报告及其他定期报告，监管机构对这些报告的发布频 率、格式及截止日期有明确要求。 现有报告包括但不限于： • 特殊反避税规则（SARs）：当交易行为显得异常、缺乏经济合理性或引发反避税委 员会（AFC）关注时，需适用该规则。全球各地的执行截止日期存在差异。 • CTRs（现金交易报告）：对于超过国家特定阈值的现金交易，必须提交此类报告。在 美国，该要求适用于单日现金交易金额超过10,000美元的情况。欧盟与中东地区的限 额标准存在差异。 • 制裁报告：当客户、交易或实体根据联合国、OFAC 、欧盟或国家制裁名单与受制裁个 人、组织或国家存在关联时，需提交此类报告。 • 跨境转账报告：对于超过规定阈值的国际交易，需提交此类报告以追踪非法资金流动、 贸易洗钱及恐怖主义融资活动。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 297 express opinions on whether to onboard or exit a particular customer based on risk profiles and other factors. By ensuring structured, transparent, and risk-focused internal reporting, financial institutions improve governance accountability, regulatory compliance, and financial crime risk mitigation. Regulatory reporting for AFC compliance Regulatory reporting is a critical obligation for financial institutions worldwide, ensuring compliance with AFC laws, financial transparency, and risk mitigation. Each jurisdiction typically enforces unique reporting rules, filing deadlines, and disclosure requirements. Non-compliance can lead to severe financial penalties, reputational harm, and regulatory enforcement actions. Types of AFC regulatory reports include, but are not limited to: • Ongoing reports: These include suspicious activity reports and current threshold reports, which are required when suspicion or certain thresholds are triggered. • Periodic reports: These include annual MLRO reports and other regular reports for which regulatory bodies mandate cadence, format, and deadlines. Ongoing reports include, but are not limited to: • SARs: These are required when a transaction appears unusual, lacks an economic rationale, or raises AFC concerns. Deadlines vary globally. • CTRs: These reports are mandated for cash transactions above country- specific thresholds. For the US, the requirement is any cash transaction that exceeds US$10,000 in a single day. The EU and Middle East have varying limits. • Sanctions reports: These are filed when a customer, transaction, or entity is linked to a sanctioned individual, organization, or country based on UN, OFAC, EU, or national sanctions lists. • Cross-border transfer reports: These are required for tracking international transactions exceeding defined thresholds to monitor illicit financial flows, trade-based money laundering, and terrorist financing.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第298页 • 受益所有人报告：该制度在许多司法管辖区具有强制性，旨在揭露隐性所有权结构及 空壳公司滥用行为。 具有特定管辖权的监管报告示例包括但不限于： • 欧洲联盟 o 《金融工具市场指令II》（MiFID II）交易报告中的市场行为描述：用于市场完整性 监测的金融交易说明。 o 6AMLD报告：重点关注成员国间对predicate offenses（predicate offenses，即预设犯 罪行为）的统一定义及责任范围的扩展。 • 合众国 o 美国金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）8300表格：用于报告贸易或商业活动中收 到的超过1万美元现金支付款项。 o FinCEN第314(a)条款要求：实现金融机构与执法部门之间的信息共享。 • 英国 o REP-CRIM报告：详细记录金融机构内发现的犯罪活动。 o MLRO 年度报告：汇总该组织在AFC合规方面的活动，重点分析趋势、风险及应对 措施。 监管报告要求包括但不限于： • 准确性和完整性：报告必须包含详细且可验证的数据，以防止错误、监管审查及报告违 规行为。 • 时效性：全球范围内文件提交截止日期存在差异，各机构必须确保提交过程快速且准 确。 • 保密性与反泄密：严禁披露搜救（SAR）详细信息，以防止干扰执法调查。 通过使监管报告流程与司法管辖区要求保持一致，金融机构能够提升财务完整性、加强监 管合作并强化金融犯罪预防工作。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 298 • Beneficial ownership reports: These are enforced in many jurisdictions to expose hidden ownership structures and shell company misuse. Jurisdiction-specific examples of regulatory reports include, but are not limited to: • European Union: o Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II (MiFID II) transaction reports: Describe financial transactions for market integrity monitoring. o 6AMLD Reports: Focus on uniform definitions of predicate offenses and extended liability across member states. • United States: o FinCEN Form 8300: Reports cash payments exceeding US$10,000 received in trade or business. o FinCEN 314(a) request: Enables information sharing between financial institutions and law enforcement. • United Kingdom: o REP-CRIM report: Describes criminal activities detected within the financial institution. o Annual MLRO’s report: Summarizes the organization’s AFC compliance activities, highlighting trends, risks, and mitigation measures. Regulatory reporting requirements include, but are not limited to: • Accuracy and completeness: Reports must contain detailed, verifiable data to prevent errors, regulatory scrutiny, and reporting breaches. • Timeliness: Filing deadlines differ globally, and institutions must ensure swift and precise submission. • Confidentiality and anti-tipping off: Disclosure of SAR details is strictly prohibited to prevent interference with law enforcement investigations. By aligning regulatory reporting processes with jurisdictional requirements, institutions strengthen financial integrity, regulatory cooperation, and financial crime prevention efforts.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第299页 对监管机构要求的回复 响应监管机构要求是企业AFC合规计划的核心要素，这凸显了透明度、协作精神与责任担当 的重要性。与监管机构保持有效沟通不仅能规避处罚风险，更能通过展现合规文化来赢得长 期信任与公信力。这同时也是监管机构与行业携手打击洗钱、恐怖主义融资等金融犯罪的关 键环节。 监管机构可开展常规检查或专项调查，评估金融机构是否遵守当地及国际反洗钱委员会 （AFC）的相关规定。若发现严重合规违规行为，可能启动监管审查程序，要求机构在 严格监管监督下限期整改。通过积极配合监管要求并及时弥补发现的漏洞，金融机构能 够有效降低声誉风险与运营风险。 司法管辖区通常会授予监管机构特殊权限，以便获取相关记录和信息。以英国为例， 《2000年金融服务与市场法》第166条规定，监管机构有权要求金融机构提供客户档案、 交易记录或风险管理流程等数据。相关机构必须建立完善的记录体系和规范化的治理机 制，以便快速响应监管要求，同时有效证明其具备健全的反欺诈控制体系。 与监管机构沟通的最佳实践包括以下内容： • 准备状态与数据完整性：保持客户尽职调查文件、交易日志及审计追踪记录的最新状 态，以确保及时且准确的提交。 • 指定联络人：将监管机构互动事务集中于合规主管或类似职位之下，以确保高 效且一致的沟通。 • 及时透明的响应：在截止日期前提供完整信息，主动披露潜在延误或挑战以建立监管 信任。 • 整改措施与监测：制定纠正行动计划、报告进展情况，并强化AFC框架以防止问 题重复发生。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 299 Responding to regulator requests Responding to regulator requests is a crucial element of an organization’s AFC compliance program, underscoring the need for transparency, collaboration, and accountability. Effective engagement with regulators helps to avoid penalties, while demonstrating a culture of compliance that fosters long-term trust and credibility. It is also a key part of the cooperative effort between regulators and industry to combat money laundering, terrorism financing, and other financial crimes. Regulators may conduct routine examinations or targeted investigations, assessing whether institutions adhere to local and global AFC mandates. In some cases, a monitorship may be imposed following serious compliance breaches, requiring the institution to correct shortcomings under strict regulatory supervision. By cooperating fully and addressing identified gaps promptly, organizations reduce reputational and operational risks. Jurisdictions often grant regulators special provisions to obtain relevant records and information. For example, in the UK, Section 166 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 allows regulators to demand data on customer files, transactions, or risk management processes. Organizations must maintain accurate records and structured governance to quickly comply with such requests and demonstrate robust AFC controls. Best practices for engaging with regulators include the following: • Preparedness and data integrity: Keep customer due diligence files, transaction logs, and audit trails up to date, facilitating timely and accurate submissions. • Designated liaison: Centralize regulator interactions under a head of compliance or similar role, ensuring efficient and consistent communication. • Timely and transparent responses: Provide complete information before deadlines, proactively disclosing potential delays or challenges to build regulatory trust. • Remediation and monitoring: Develop corrective action plans, report progress, and strengthen AFC frameworks to prevent repeat findings.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第300页 通过及时响应监管机构要求，企业不仅强化了对美国金融公司协会（AFC）的承诺、降 低了合规风险，还建立了稳固的监管关系，从而有效维护了财务诚信。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 300 By responding promptly to regulator requests, organizations reinforce AFC commitments, mitigate compliance risks, and maintain strong supervisory relationships that bolster financial integrity.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第301页 AFC程序与控制措施的实施 客户生命周期全周期管控 完善的控制框架有助于实现AFC合规要求，确保金融机构在客户生命周期的每个阶段都能 有效识别、评估并降低金融犯罪风险。面对不断演变的全球监管要求与新兴金融犯罪威 胁，金融机构必须通过控制措施进行风险评估、履行合规义务，并维护金融体系的完整 性。 客户生命周期包含以下管控措施： 1. 入职培训中作为KYC /CDD组成部分的身份识别与验证： • 身份验证：通过政府颁发的证件、生物特征认证及技术入职解决方案对客户身份 进行验证。 • 风险评估：基于交易行为、行业类型及司法管辖区风险敞口对客户风险进行 评估，以确定风险评级。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 301 Implementation of AFC program and controls Controls across the customer lifecycle A well-structured control framework supports AFC compliance, ensuring that financial institutions effectively identify, assess, and mitigate financial crime risks at every stage of the customer lifecycle. With evolving global regulations and emerging financial crime threats, institutions must use controls to assess risk, meet their obligations, and protect financial integrity. The customer lifecycle consists of the following controls: 1. Identity and verification as part of KYC/CDD at onboarding: • Identity verification: Validate customer identity through government- issued documents, biometric authentication, and technological onboarding solutions. • Risk profiling: Assess customer risk based on transaction behavior, industry type, and jurisdictional exposure to assign a risk rating.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第302页 • 有益所有权审查：通过调查复杂公司结构以明确所有权与控制权。 2. 入职时筛查： • 制裁筛查：将客户信息与联合国、OFAC 、欧盟及地方当局等适用名单进行交叉核 对。若确认存在匹配项，则无法完成客户入账流程。 • PEP筛查：确认客户是否为PEP（暴露后预防对象），或其亲属及密切接触者。 • 负面媒体核查：识别与客户相关的潜在声誉风险及法律争议。 3. 高风险客户的EDD（预期死亡日期）： • 财富来源与资金核查：确保高风险客户具有合法资金来源。 • 附加EDD措施：根据所提供的产品及其相关风险采取相应的附加措施。 4. 交易监控与支付筛查： • 通过持续监控分析客户历史交易记录，识别可能涉及洗钱或逃税行为的异常或复杂 交易模式。 • 地缘政治与制裁合规性：与高风险司法管辖区或受限实体相关的旗帜支付。 5. 持续筛查： • 批量筛查：持续进行，通常每日执行，以确保对制裁名单的任何变更与组织客 户名单进行比对核查。 • PEP与不良媒体筛查：持续进行重复筛查以识别并解密PEP信息，同时发现针对 现有客户的新不良媒体事件。 6. 调查与监管报告： • 持续监控措施：当KYC 更新过程中发现异常、通过交易监控触发警报，或前台 人员发现可疑行为时启动。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 302 • Beneficial ownership review: Investigate complex corporate structures to identify ownership and control. 2. Screening at onboarding: • Sanctions screening: Cross-check customer details against applicable lists, such as those from the UN, OFAC, EU, and local authorities. If a true match is confirmed, onboarding cannot proceed. • PEP screening: Identify whether the customer is a PEP—or a relative or close associate of a PEP. • Adverse media checks: Flag potential reputational risks and legal controversies linked to the customer. 3. EDD for high-risk customers: • Source of wealth and funds verification: Ensure high-risk clients have legitimate financial sources. • Additional EDD measures: Apply relevant additional measures based on products offered and their associated risks. 4. Transaction monitoring and payment screening: • Ongoing control that analyzes a customer’s historical activity to detect unusual or complex patterns that could indicate money laundering or tax evasion. • Geopolitical and sanctions compliance: Flag payments linked to high- risk jurisdictions or restricted entities. 5. Ongoing screening: • Batch screening: Performed on an ongoing basis, typically daily, to ensure that any changes to sanctions lists are checked against the organization’s list of clients. • PEP and adverse media screening: Repeated on an ongoing basis to identify and declassify PEPs and to identify any new adverse media against existing clients. 6. Investigations and regulatory reporting: • Ongoing controls: Begin when concerns are raised during a KYC refresh, when alerts are triggered through transaction monitoring, or when front office staff identify suspicious behavior.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第303页 • 病例升级与管理：根据组织流程要求，可能需将病例升级至二线诊疗方案。 • SAR申报：向相关金融情报单位（FIU）报告可疑活动。 7. 定期审查与持续尽职调查： • 定期KYC 更新：根据风险等级及不断变化的监管要求，执行强制性数据更新。 • 持续风险评估：根据信息或行为变化调整客户档案及交易限额。 • 持续风险监测：实施持续监控和深入交易审查，以降低风险敞口。 • 动态风险管理：复杂流程（如持续KYC）需要持续监控数据以识别变化并触发 KYC 更新。 8. 客户离场流程与退出策略： • 基于风险评估的账户关闭机制：根据信息披露义务要求，若客户存在涉嫌非法活 动或合规风险，机构可能需获得批准方可终止服务。对于因风险偏好差异导致的 客户退出情形，应采取个案审查与决策机制。 金融机构通过实施动态风险管控措施并运用先进技术，有效强化反洗钱（AFC）监管能 力，同时符合国际反洗钱义务要求。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 303 • Escalation and case management: Depending on the organization’s procedures, the case may need to be escalated to the second line. • SAR filing: Report suspicious activities to the appropriate FIU. 7. Periodic review and ongoing due diligence: • Scheduled KYC refreshes: Conduct mandatory data updates based on risk levels and evolving regulatory expectations. • Continuous risk assessments: Adjust customer profiles and transaction limits based on information or behavioral shifts. • Ongoing risk monitoring: Apply continuous surveillance and deeper transaction scrutiny to mitigate exposure. • Dynamic risk management: Sophisticated processes, such as perpetual KYC, involve continuously monitoring data to identify changes and trigger a KYC refresh. 8. Customer offboarding and exit strategy: • Risk-based account closure: Based on reporting obligations, the organization might need approval to offboard customers due to suspected illicit activity or noncompliance risks. Exits based on a mismatch in risk appetite should be reviewed and decided on a case- by-case basis. By implementing dynamic, risk-based measures and leveraging advanced technologies, financial institutions enhance AFC controls and align with international AFC obligations.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第304页 AFC控制系统的启动 KYC 过程 随着全球监管框架的不断演变，金融机构必须实施基于风险的尽职调查以防范金融犯 罪。KYC 流程是AFC合规的核心要求，确保金融机构在建立或维持业务关系前识别、 核实并评估客户风险。 针对特定客户群体（如PEP、高净值人士及高风险司法管辖区客户），KYC 前准入委员会 可在正式身份确认前评估其适格性。该委员会通常由合规专家、风险管理者、法律顾问及业 务部门负责人组成，通过综合评估司法管辖区风险、业务活动及战略契合度来作出决策。最 终结果将决定客户是否进入完整KYC 流程，以及所需尽职调查的层级（标准或强化型）。 这一环节通过早期筛选不合格客户，确保资源高效配置、风险及时管控及监管合规性，从而 实现流程优化。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 304 Onboarding AFC controls The KYC process With evolving global regulatory frameworks, financial institutions must implement risk-based due diligence to prevent financial crime. The KYC process is a core requirement in AFC compliance, ensuring financial institutions identify, verify, and assess customer risks before establishing or maintaining business relationships. For specific customer profiles, such as PEPs, high-net-worth individuals, and customers from high-risk jurisdictions, a pre-KYC onboarding committee might assess suitability before formal identification. The committee typically includes compliance experts, risk managers, legal advisors, and business unit leaders, who collectively evaluate jurisdictional risks, business activities, and strategic fit. The outcome determines whether customers proceed to full KYC and what level of due diligence—standard or enhanced—is required. This step ensures efficient resource use, early risk mitigation, and regulatory alignment by filtering out unsuitable clients early in the process.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第305页 KYC 与入职培训 典型的KYC /CDD流程包含以下步骤： • 身份与验证（ID&V）： o 身份识别是指收集个人及商业信息，包括姓名、出生日期、国籍、地址、税务识别 号以及公司注册数据。 o 验证是指通过政府颁发的文件、生物特征认证、人工智能驱动的验证工具以及身 份识别记录的法医分析，对所提供信息进行身份认证的过程。 o 组织机构必须充分理解并获取相关信息，以明确客户与组织关系的目的及预期性 质。 o 加强后的监管要求组织机构确定公司账户的最终受益所有人（UBOs）。 • 入组前需进行筛查以评估风险： o 制裁筛查是指将客户信息与联合国、欧盟、OFAC 及各国制裁名单进行交叉比 对，以识别高风险实体。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 305 KYC at onboarding The typical KYC/CDD process consists of the following steps: • Identity and verification (ID&V): o Identification is the collection of personal and business details, including name, date of birth, nationality, address, tax identification number, and company registration data. o Verification is the authentication of provided information using government-issued documents, biometric authentication, AI-driven verification tools, and forensic analysis of identification records. o Organizations must understand and obtain information, as appropriate, on the purpose and intended nature of the customer’s relationship with the organization. o Enhanced regulations require organizations to determine the ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) of corporate accounts. • Screening is conducted prior to onboarding to determine risk: o Sanctions screening is when customer details are cross-checked against UN, EU, OFAC, and national sanctions lists to detect high-risk entities.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第306页 o 开展不良媒体监测旨在识别其与金融犯罪、腐败及欺诈活动之间的关联。 o PEP筛查是指组织机构判定个人或受益所有人是否为PEP，或PEP的亲属或密切关联 方。 • 风险评估： o 可对客户进行风险评估，并根据行业类型、监管辖区风险敞口及交易行为将其划分 为低风险、中风险或高风险等级。更高级的评估方法可生成1至100分的风险评分， 从而实现基于风险评估方法的精细化应用。 o 被判定为高风险的客户通常会通过强化尽职调查进行更深入的审查。被判定为 标准风险的客户（包括低风险和中风险客户）同样需接受尽职调查。 过程 • EDD： o EDD要求更深入地核实财富来源和资金来源，并通过支持性文件对任何索赔 进行审查和验证。 • 潜在排斥反应： o 若经尽职调查后，机构对客户所呈现的风险水平感到担忧，可要求客户提供补充 文件。最终，若补充信息仍不足以证明客户资质，该机构可能会拒绝其申请以保 护自身利益。 • 持续尽职调查、筛选、监测及KYC 更新： o 除入职时的尽职调查外，企业会根据客户类别和监管要求定期实施基于风险的KYC 更新周期。这些更新确保企业及时掌握客户或业务状况的变化，并相应调整风险评 级。若更新结果显示风险等级升高，则可能触发强化尽职调查程序。 o 各组织还需持续开展制裁措施筛查、重点暴露人群（PEPs）筛查及不良事件筛查工 作。组织必须对每项筛查结果进行评估。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 306 o Adverse media monitoring is conducted to identify links to financial crime, corruption, and fraudulent activities. o PEP screening is when organizations determine whether the individual or beneficial owner is a PEP, or the relative or close associate of a PEP. • Risk assessment: o Customers may be assessed for risk and assigned low-, medium-, or high-risk status based on industry type, jurisdictional exposure, and transaction behaviors. More advanced approaches may provide a risk score from 1 to 100, allowing for a more nuanced application of the risk- based approach. o Customers deemed high risk are typically examined more deeply through enhanced due diligence. Customers deemed standard risk, which includes low and medium risk, also undergo a due diligence process. • EDD: o EDD involves verifying source of wealth and source of funds more deeply, examining and verifying any claims through supporting documentation. • Potential rejection: o If, upon conducting due diligence, the organization is not comfortable with the level of risk a client presents, it might request additional documentation. Ultimately, if additional information also does not suffice, the organization might reject the customer to protect itself. • Ongoing due diligence, screening, monitoring, and KYC refresh: o In addition to due diligence at onboarding, organizations apply risk- based KYC refresh cycles periodically based on customer category and jurisdictional requirements. These refreshes ensure that the organization is noting any changes in the customer’s or business’s circumstances and updating the risk rating appropriately. If the refresh presents a higher degree of risk, enhanced due diligence may be triggered. o Organizations also conduct screening for sanctions, PEPs, and adverse news on an ongoing basis. The organization must screen each

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第307页 客户需执行交易以检测是否存在制裁风险敞口。若检测到此类风险敞口，机构将暂 停支付并启动后续处理流程。 o 通过监测可疑交易模式，企业能够识别异常行为、触发警报并动态调整风险评估模 型。传统企业多采用基于规则的系统，如今则可选择与人工智能系统互补或替代，从 而提升运营效率与决策精准度。 通过采用全面的风险导向型KYC 框架，金融机构能够提升反洗钱合规性、降低金融犯罪风 险，并与不断演变的国际监管要求保持一致。 客户风险评估 客户风险评估（CRA）是一项合规流程，用于评估客户可能引发的金融犯罪风险。该流程通 过综合分析多重风险因素，确定针对每位客户所需实施的监控与审查强度。 关键风险因素包括： • 客户概况：包括自然人或法人实体、所有权结构、业务性质、所属行业以及是 否涉及主要利益相关方（PEPs）。 • 管辖权：需评估客户是否来自高风险司法管辖区或在该地区开展业务，这些管辖区信息 来源于FATF 灰名单、黑名单或OFAC 、欧盟及当地监管机构的名单。 • 产品：需考虑客户所使用的产品或服务可能被用于金融犯罪。典型应用场景包括代理 银行服务、私人财富管理、加密货币及贸易融资等领域。 • 交付渠道：需评估客户是通过线下方式还是线上方式完成注册。缺乏面对面互动的交易 通常风险较高。 • 交易行为：识别与预期交易模式的偏差、无法解释的高额跨境交易或复杂支付结构的 使用情况。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 307 transaction the customer carries out to detect any sanctions exposure. If it detects such exposure, the organization blocks payments and escalates to establish further steps. o Monitoring transactions for patterns of suspicion allows the organization to detect anomalous behaviors, trigger alerts, and adjust risk profiles dynamically. Traditionally, organizations have used rules-based systems. Now, they may either complement or replace such systems with AI- based systems to achieve better efficiency and effectiveness. By adopting a comprehensive, risk-based KYC framework, financial institutions enhance AFC compliance, mitigate financial crime risks, and align with evolving international regulatory obligations. Customer risk assessment A customer risk assessment (CRA) is a compliance process that determines the financial crime risk posed by a customer. A CRA evaluates multiple risk factors to determine the appropriate level of monitoring and scrutiny required for each customer. Key risk elements include: • Customer profile: Include natural person or legal person, ownership structure, nature of business, industry, and presence of PEPs. • Jurisdiction: Consider whether a customer is from or conducts business in high-risk jurisdictions, as identified in FATF grey and black lists or the lists from OFAC, the EU, and local regulators. • Product: Consider how the products or services the customer uses could be misused for financial crime. Examples include correspondent banking, private wealth management, cryptocurrency, and trade finance. • Delivery channel: Consider whether the customer is onboarded in person or online. Transactions conducted without face-to-face interaction tend to be higher risk. • Transactional behavior: Identify deviations from expected transaction patterns, unexplained high-volume cross-border transactions, or the use of complex payment structures.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第308页 加拿大风险评估（CRA）采用结构化方法，以确保风险因素得到准确测量和分类。具体 步骤包括： • 数据收集：采集KYC 与CDD相关信息，包括客户身份、业务活动、受益所有人及交易 用途。 • 风险评分：根据管辖权、交易行为及行为因素分配加权风险评分。 • 风险分级：将客户划分为低风险、中风险或高风险类别，以指导监测强度的调 整。 • 审批流程：高级合规官在最终入职或持续合作前会对高风险客户档案进行审核。 通常，客户关系评估（CRAs）会在客户生命周期的以下阶段进行： • 初始客户风险评估（CRA）：在客户入职阶段实施，旨在建立其基线风险特征。对于新 客户而言，其交易模式通常在入职阶段尚不明确。 • 持续性CRA：由重大变更触发，例如业务活动、所有权或管辖权的变更，或由报告 的可疑活动引发 • 定期客户关系评估（CRA）：根据风险等级进行定期审查，对高风险客户需 加强评估频率。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 308 The CRA follows a structured approach to ensure risk factors are accurately measured and classified. The steps include: • Data collection: Gather KYC and CDD information, including customer identity, business activities, beneficial ownership, and transaction purposes. • Risk scoring: Assign weighted risk scores based on jurisdictional, transactional, and behavioral factors. • Risk classification: Group customers into risk categories—such as low, medium, or high-risk—which guide monitoring intensity. • Approval process: Senior compliance officers review high-risk customer profiles before final onboarding or continued engagement. Typically, CRAs are conducted at these phases in the customer lifecycle: • Initial CRA: Conducted at onboarding to establish a customer’s baseline risk profile. For new customers, transaction patterns are typically unknown at onboarding. • Ongoing CRA: Triggered by material changes, such as a shift in business activity, ownership, or jurisdiction, or by suspicious activity reported • Periodic CRA: Scheduled reviews based on risk level, with high-risk customers assessed more frequently.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第309页 金融机构通过实施稳健的CRA框架，可有效提升金融犯罪检测能力、监管合规性及 风险管理策略。 自然人KYC 自然人KYC 流程是AFC合规性的重要组成部分，确保金融机构准确核实客户身份、评估风 险敞口并监控金融活动。该流程包含客户身份识别计划（CIP）及额外尽职调查环节。随着 全球监管环境的演变，金融机构通过采用先进的身份验证方法、基于风险的监控机制以及 受益所有人透明化措施，可有效强化合规框架。 CIP是KYC 的第一步，要求金融机构收集并核实个人客户的身份信息。核实自然人身份的 核心要求包括： • 政府颁发身份证件上的完整法定姓名 • 出生日期，确认年龄及身份合法性 • 国籍及居住地址，需提供居住证明 • 政府颁发的身份证明文件，如护照、国民身份证或驾驶证 • 税务识别号（TIN）、社会保障号（SSN）或等效编号 不同司法管辖区对客户身份识别的要求存在差异。CIP（客户身份保护）机制通过确保仅 合法客户能够获取金融服务，有效降低身份欺诈及金融犯罪风险。 CDD（客户风险评估）系统会综合评估客户的风险等级、财务行为特征及预期交易 模式，具体包括但不限于以下方面： • 就业与收入信息。 • 资金来源与交易活动。 • 账户用途及预期活动。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 309 By implementing a robust CRA framework, financial institutions enhance financial crime detection, regulatory compliance, and risk management strategies. KYC for a natural person The KYC process for a natural person is a critical element of AFC compliance, ensuring that financial institutions accurately verify a customer’s identity, assess risk exposure, and monitor financial activities. The process consists of the customer identification program (CIP) and additional due diligence. As global regulations evolve, financial institutions benefit from adopting advanced identity verification methods, risk-based monitoring, and beneficial ownership transparency measures to strengthen compliance frameworks. CIP is the first step in KYC, requiring financial institutions to collect and verify the identity of individual customers. Core requirements for verifying a natural person’s identity include: • Full legal name, as per government-issued ID • Date of birth, confirming age and identity legitimacy • Nationality and residential address, confirming proof of residence • Government-issued identification, such as a passport, national ID, or driver’s license • Tax Identification Number (TIN), Social Security Number (SSN), or equivalent The requirements for identifying a customer vary by jurisdiction. CIP ensures that only legitimate customers access financial services, while reducing identity fraud and financial crime risks. CDD assesses the customer’s risk level, financial behavior, and expected transactions, including, but not limited to: • Employment and income information. • Source of funds and transaction activity. • Account’s purpose and expected activity.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第310页 所有客户均须遵守CDD条款，并持续接受监管以确保符合不断更新的AFC法规要 求。 EDD通常适用于高风险客户，例如暴露后预防（PEP）人员或在高风险司法管辖区开展 业务的个体。EDD包括但不限于以下内容： • 财富与资金来源的全面验证。 • 加强交易监测并增加审查频率。 • 额外不良媒体筛查 • 针对联合国、欧盟及OFAC 观察名单实施更频繁的制裁筛查。 通过实施动态、基于风险的KYC 控制措施，金融机构能够提升反洗钱合规性，降低非法 融资风险，并履行监管义务。 法人KYC 法人KYC 流程要求金融机构对公司、合伙企业、信托机构及其他法律实体进行资质审 查，以防范金融犯罪。针对高风险实体，法人KYC 流程包含CIP（信用信息程序）、CDD （信用数据披露）和EDD（实体数据披露）三大环节。 CIP通过收集和验证以下信息来确立法律实体的身份： • 注册商号及法律实体类型，例如公司、合伙企业、信托机构或其他形式。 • 企业注册编号（BRN）及注册地管辖范围。 • 税务识别号（TIN）或等效编号。 • 主要营业场所及联系方式。 • 经认证的公司章程、营业执照或信托契约。 CIP（客户身份保护）是AFC合规计划的核心要素，旨在确保仅有合法实体能够获得金融服 务，从而有效降低金融犯罪风险，包括欺诈行为及非法金融网络的利用风险。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 310 CDD is mandatory for all customers, with ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with evolving AFC regulations. EDD is typically required for high-risk customers, such as PEPs or individuals operating in high-risk jurisdictions. EDD includes, but is not limited to: • Comprehensive source of wealth and funds verification. • Enhanced transaction monitoring and more frequent reviews. • Additional adverse media screening. • More frequent sanctions screening against UN, EU, and OFAC watchlists. By implementing dynamic, risk-based KYC controls, financial institutions enhance AFC compliance, mitigate illicit finance risks, and uphold regulatory obligations. KYC for a legal person The KYC process for a legal person ensures that financial institutions verify corporations, partnerships, trusts, and other legal entities to prevent financial crime. KYC for legal persons consists of CIP, CDD, and EDD for high-risk entities. The CIP establishes the legal entity’s identity by collecting and verifying: • Registered business name and legal entity type, such as a corporation, partnership, trust, or others. • Business Registration Number (BRN) and jurisdiction of incorporation. • Tax identification number (TIN) or equivalent. • Principal place of business and contact information. • Certified articles of incorporation, business license, or trust deeds. CIP is the cornerstone of any AFC compliance program to help ensure that only legitimate legal entities gain access to financial services, thereby reducing financial crime risks including fraud, and exploitation by illicit financial networks.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第311页 CDD评估实体的结构、所有权及交易模式，包括： • 企业性质与行业分类 • 预期交易量与财务活动 • 受益所有人（BO）与最终受益所有人（UBO）的识别与验证 • 董事、高级管理人员及授权签字人的身份验证。 CDD具有强制性要求，其具体内容取决于实体风险、司法管辖区规定及监管预期。 具有较高金融犯罪风险的法人实体需实施EDD（实体识别与数据验证），具体包 括： • 复杂的公司结构分析，例如多层所有者结构或离岸控股。 • 资金来源与财富来源验证。 • 所有客户均需接受PEP（预防性执行程序）及受益所有人与董事的制裁筛查。 • 加强监测频率并持续开展交易审查。 与所有权结构清晰的本地注册公司相比，所有权结构不透明且存在名义股东的控股公司将 面临更严格的审查。某些行业企业（如中小型企业、军火制造商、矿业公司、博彩机构、 代理银行及高价值资产交易商）可能面临更高的金融犯罪风险。 通过将基于风险的方法嵌入并应用于KYC 流程，金融机构能够更有效地管理与降低金融犯 罪风险，确保合规监管要求的落实，并向投资者和客户展现其在反洗钱（AFC）方面的全 面合规能力。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 311 CDD assesses the entity’s structure, ownership, and transaction patterns, including: • Nature of business and industry classification. • Expected transaction volumes and financial activities. • Identification and verification of beneficial owners (BO) and ultimate beneficial owners (UBO). • Verification of directors, senior management, and authorized signatories. CDD is mandatory and varies based on entity risk, jurisdictional requirements, and regulatory expectations. Legal persons that pose a higher financial crime risk require EDD, which includes: • Complex corporate structure analysis, such as multiple layers of owners, or offshore holdings. • Source of funds and source of wealth verification. • PEP and sanctions screening for beneficial owners and directors, is required for all customers. • More frequent monitoring and ongoing transaction reviews. A holding company with opaque ownership and nominee shareholders would face greater scrutiny than a locally registered company with a clear ownership structure. Companies in certain industries, such as MSBs, arms manufacturers, mining companies, gaming and gambling organizations, correspondent banks, and high-value asset dealers, might encounter higher financial crime risks. Through the embedding and implementation of a risk-based approach to KYC processes, financial institutions can manage and mitigate financial crime risks more effectively, ensure adherence to regulations, and demonstrate strong overall AFC compliance to investors and customers.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第312页 针对高风险场景的附加入职控制措施 诸如FATF 建议、欧盟反洗钱指令及FinCEN法规等监管框架要求采用基于风险的客户准 入机制，确保高风险客户在获得金融服务前需接受额外审查。 客户可根据以下标准被归类为高风险群体： • 地理风险：在受制裁司法管辖区或经OFAC 、欧盟或其他监管机构认定的高风险国家开 展业务或进行交易 • 行业风险：从事现金密集型或高风险业务，如货币服务、加密货币交易所、赌博、武 器贸易和奢侈品交易。 • PEPs：因担任公职而面临更高贿赂和腐败风险的个人 • 复杂所有权结构：具有离岸资产持有、名义董事或UBO 不明确的实体 • 负面媒体报道：与负面媒体报道相关的客户，正在经历法律诉讼、监管罚款或金融犯 罪调查 金融机构可实施临时性或永久性限制措施。 在EDD完成前可采用临时控制措施，例如限制账户功能。对于被标记为高风险的客户，将 持续实施永久性管控措施。 此类限制措施包括： • 另一项资金与财富验证方式，要求在进行后续交易前详细提交财务来源证明文件。 • 交易与产品限制措施，例如对高风险产品、服务及交易量实施限制。 • 需获得高级管理层批准，例如在账户激活前必须获得合规委员会或董事会的批准。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 312 Additional onboarding controls for high-risk scenarios Regulatory frameworks such as FATF Recommendations, EU AML Directives, and FinCEN regulations require a risk-based approach to onboarding, ensuring that higher-risk customers undergo additional scrutiny before gaining full access to financial services. Customers might be classified as high-risk based upon: • Geographic risk: Operating in or transacting with sanctioned jurisdictions or high-risk countries identified by OFAC, EU, or other regulators • Industry risk: Engaging in cash-intensive or high-risk businesses such as money services, cryptocurrency exchanges, gambling, arms trading, and luxury goods • PEPs: Individuals with heightened bribery and corruption exposure due to public office roles • Complex ownership structures: Entities with offshore holdings, nominee directors, or unclear UBO • Adverse media: Customers linked to adverse media reports, undergoing legal proceedings, regulatory fines, or financial crime investigations Financial institutions might apply temporary or permanent restrictions. Temporary controls might be applied until EDD is completed, such as limited account functionality. Permanent controls would be applied continuously for customers that have been labeled high-risk. Examples of these restrictions include: • An additional source of funds and wealth verification that requires detailed documentation of financial sources before transacting further. • Transaction and product restrictions, such as limiting high-risk products, services, and transaction volumes. • Senior management approval, such as mandating compliance committee or board approval before account activation.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第313页 • 延长审查与监测周期，包括延长合规性审查时限及加强交易监测力度。 • 客户与金融机构定期召开审计及合规会议，旨在监督并确保客户内部控制体系、系 统运行及合规问题报告机制具备充分性与有效性。 金融机构通过整合基于风险的入职管控机制，可有效提升合规性、降低监管风险敞口， 并维护金融体系的完整性。 质量控制功能 质量控制（QC）是AFC合规框架中的关键职能，可确保KYC 、CDD及交易监控输出结果的 准确性、一致性及法规合规性。通过识别错误、不一致性和潜在违规行为，QC强化了监管 机构要求的风险导向方法。 质量控制（QC）常与质量保证（QA）混淆。尽管QA与QC均能提升合规效率，但二者功能 各异。QA旨在确保政策与程序得到正确执行，并推动流程持续改进；QC则致力于确保输出 结果符合既定标准。 例如，检查PEP文件（输出结果）以确保所有必要数据点均被准确捕获，属于质量控制 （QC）职能范畴；而审查PEP尽职调查流程、基础操作规程及具体执行措施（即流程本 身），则属于质量保证（QA）职能范畴。 AFC合规性中质量控制（QC）的主要目标包括： • 通过识别不完整、错误或过时的KYC 记录来实现错误检测与纠正。 • 通过确保符合全球及辖区AFC要求来遵守法规。 • 通过强制实施统一的KYC 、风险评估及文件记录标准来实现输出标准化。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 313 • Extended review and monitoring periods to include longer compliance review timelines and heightened transaction monitoring. • Regular audits and compliance meetings scheduled between the customer and financial institution to oversee and ensure the customer’s internal controls, systems, and reporting of compliance issues are adequate and effective. By integrating risk-based onboarding controls, financial institutions enhance compliance, reduce regulatory exposure, and safeguard financial integrity. Function of quality control Quality control (QC) is a critical function within an AFC compliance framework. It ensures accuracy, consistency, and regulatory adherence in KYC, CDD, and transaction monitoring outputs. By detecting errors, inconsistencies, and potential non-compliance, QC strengthens the risk-based approach required by regulators. QC might be confused with quality assurance (QA). Although QA and QC both enhance compliance efficiency, they serve different purposes. The purpose of QA is to ensure that policies and procedures are properly executed and that processes are continuously improved. QC ensures that outputs meet the required standards. For example, examining PEP files (the output) to ensure all requisite data points are accurately captured would be part of the QC function. Examining the PEP due diligence process, the underlying procedures, and the actions (the process) would be part of the QA function. The primary objectives of QC in AFC compliance include: • Error detection and correction by identifying incomplete, incorrect, or outdated KYC records. • Adherence to regulations by ensuring compliance with global and jurisdictional AFC requirements. • Output standardization by enforcing uniform KYC, risk assessment, and documentation standards.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第314页 • 通过提升员工能力并识别潜在不足之处来开展培训与持续改进。 为提升质量控制（QC）有效性，金融机构应： • 通过系统性审核客户档案及风险评估报告，定期开展KYC 审查工作。 • 考虑采用最新工具和技术（如人工智能）实现自动化，以标记不一致性和缺失数据。 • 建立独立的质量控制（QC）团队，以确保对产出进行无偏倚的监督。 • 通过追踪质量控制（QC）趋势、常见缺陷及纠正措施，提升内部报告质量。 通过实施结构化质量控制机制，金融机构可降低合规风险、提升监管遵从性，并强化 金融犯罪预防工作。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 314 • Training and continuous improvement by enhancing staff competency and highlighting any weaknesses. To enhance QC effectiveness, financial institutions should: • Conduct regular KYC reviews by systematically auditing customer files and risk assessments. • Consider automation by utilizing the latest tools and technologies, such as AI, to flag inconsistencies and missing data. • Establish independent QC teams to ensure unbiased oversight of outputs. • Enhance internal reporting by tracking QC trends, common deficiencies, and corrective actions. By implementing structured QC mechanisms, financial institutions reduce compliance risks, improve regulatory adherence, and strengthen financial crime prevention efforts.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第315页 持续性AFC控制 正在进行的尽职调查 持续尽职调查是金融机构为确保合规性而实施的流程，旨在定期更新客户风险评估、监控 交易行为并识别可疑操作，从而符合美国金融监管委员会（AFC）的监管要求。与客户入 行阶段的尽职调查不同，持续尽职调查是一个动态演进的过程，能够及时应对风险变化、 金融犯罪威胁及监管政策更新。该流程包含多项关键监控机制，包括定期KYC 审查、触发 事件分析、实时支付筛查、批量审核、持续KYC 以及先进合规技术应用。 定期KYC 审查会根据客户风险等级按固定周期进行。金融机构必须对客户信息、所有权结 构、业务活动及风险分类进行审查与更新。例如： • 高风险客户通常需每年接受一次评估。 • 中风险客户通常每两至三年接受一次评估。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 315 Ongoing AFC controls Ongoing due diligence Ongoing due diligence is a process that ensures financial institutions regularly update customer risk assessments, monitor customer transactions, and identify suspicious behavior to maintain compliance with AFC regulations. Unlike the customer due diligence undertaken at onboarding, ongoing due diligence is an evolving process that responds to risk changes, financial crime threats, and regulatory developments. Ongoing due diligence consists of several critical monitoring mechanisms, including periodic KYC reviews, trigger event reviews, real-time payment screening, batch screening, perpetual KYC, and advanced compliance technologies. Periodic KYC reviews take place at regular intervals, based on the customer’s risk level. Financial institutions must review and update customer information, ownership structures, business activities, and risk classifications. For example: • High-risk customers are typically reviewed annually. • Medium-risk customers are typically reviewed every two to three years.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第316页 • 低风险客户通常每三至五年接受一次评估。 触发事件审查可能在客户风险特征发生重大变化时进行。触发事件示例包括： • 企业重组、最终受益人变更、迁至高风险司法管辖区或在高风险司法管辖区建立新贸易 伙伴。 • 异常交易行为，例如意外的大额存款或资金快速流动。 • 新兴负面媒体报道、监管处罚或刑事调查。 • 静态数据变更，例如地址变更或总部搬迁。 交易监测与筛选机制可用于以下用途： • 实时支付筛查技术通过分析交易数据，在交易完成前识别制裁违规行为及高风险交 易对手方。 • 批量筛查是指持续将客户数据库与制裁名单（如OFAC 、联合国及欧盟名单）、监管执 法通知及负面媒体报道进行比对。该机制旨在检测客户加入后可能发生的变更。 先进的合规技术可通过技术应用提升持续尽职调查工作。例如： • 持续KYC 通过采用数据驱动的触发机制实时更新客户风险档案，从而降低对定期刷新 的依赖。 • 自动化AI风险检测技术通过机器学习提升异常检测能力、预测性合规建模及实时风险 管理水平。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 316 • Low-risk customers are typically reviewed every three to five years. Trigger event reviews might occur whenever significant changes impact a customer’s risk profile. Examples of trigger events include: • Business restructuring, changes in ultimate beneficial owners, relocation to a high-risk jurisdiction, or establishing new trading partners in high-risk jurisdictions. • Unusual transaction behavior, such as unexpected high-value deposits, or rapid movement of funds. • Emerging adverse media reports, regulatory sanctions, or criminal investigations. • Static data changes, such as an address change or relocation of headquarters. Transaction monitoring and screening mechanisms can be used for the following: • Real-time payment screening analyzes transactions to detect sanctions violations and high-risk counterparties before the transactions are completed. • Batch screening involves the continuous checking of customer databases against sanctions lists (such as the OFAC, UN, and EU lists), regulatory enforcement notices, and negative media sources. It is designed to detect changes that might have occurred after customers were onboarded. Advanced compliance technologies can enhance ongoing due diligence via the use of technology. For example: • Perpetual KYC involves the use of data-driven triggers to update customer risk profiles in real time, reducing reliance on periodic refreshes. • Automated AI risk detection uses machine learning to enhance anomaly detection, predictive compliance modeling, and real-time risk management.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第317页 支付筛查 支付或交易筛查是指对资金流入和流出交易进行核查以防范金融犯罪的过程。对于为客户提 供资金转账服务或代表第三方机构进行资金流转的机构而言，这是其实施金融犯罪防控的核 心措施。相关机构必须执行支付筛查流程，以避免违反制裁规定及恐怖主义融资行为的发 生。 支付链中处理交易的每个实体均需执行支付筛查。发起银行指资金发送方机构，受益银行则 代表客户接收资金。两家机构均需将支付信息与相关名单进行比对筛查。 支付筛查用于识别组织发送或接收支付时涉及的个人、实体或司法管辖区的风险。支付风 险等级因多种因素而异，例如司法管辖区及支付用途。 合规官需根据组织的风险承受能力，确定应批准的交易类型。 支付通常以结构化数据消息形式呈现，其中包含关于支付的完整信息。此类信息可能 包括财务数据
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 317 Payment screening Payment or transaction screening is the process of verifying transactions, both incoming and outgoing, to prevent financial crime. It is a primary financial crime control for organizations that facilitate the transfer of funds for their customers, or on behalf of another entity. Organizations are required to perform payment screening to prevent sanctions breaches and the financing of terrorism. Each entity handling the transaction in a payment chain is required to conduct payment screening. The originating bank is the organization sending the funds. The beneficiary bank is the organization receiving the funds on behalf of its customers. Both organizations screen the payment against any relevant lists. Payment screening identifies the risk of individuals, entities, or jurisdictions for payments an organization sends or receives. Payments carry varying levels of risk that depend on several factors, such as jurisdiction and purpose of payment. A compliance officer must determine which transactions to accept based on the organization’s risk appetite. Payments are typically structured messages of data containing complete information about the payment. Such information might include financial

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第318页 涉及的金融机构、资金往来双方、金额、日期、货币种类、地址及自由文本信息。每笔支 付包含多条消息：其中一条消息载有资金转账信息，其余交易消息则用于通过支付网络发 起指令请求与执行指令。 支付筛查通常是一个自动化实时处理流程。这意味着系统会在支付发起时及完成前进行 筛查。若系统识别出任何预设匹配项，该交易将被暂停、调查，并在必要时予以阻断。 支付筛查系统（如图所示）通过比对交易记录与名单数据实现交易匹配。匹配机制基于消息 类型及消息字段进行分析，系统会将名单中的实体名称与交易记录中的实体名称进行比对。 同理，系统还会将授权名单中的银行识别代码（BIC）与支付消息中的发送方及接收方BIC 进行比对。消息类型可反映支付性质特征，这可能会影响系统配置参数。例如，在处理贸易 融资交易时，需参照双重用途商品清单及高风险船舶数据进行筛查。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 318 institutions involved, sending and receiving parties, amounts, dates, currencies, address, and free text information. Each payment has multiple messages. One message carries the transfer of funds information. The other transaction messages are used to request and send instructions through the payment network. Payment screening is usually an automated, real-time process. This means the system screens payments as they are initiated and before they are completed. If the system identifies any preset match, the transaction will be held, investigated, and, if necessary, blocked. Payment screening systems, such as the one shown, match transactions against list data. The matching configuration is based on message types and fields within a message. The system compares entity names on the list to the entity names on the transaction. Similarly, the system matches bank identifier codes (BIC) on the sanctioned list against the sending and receiving BIC in the payment message. The message type might identify the nature of the payment. This could change the configuration. For example, if it is a trade finance transaction, you would screen against dual-use goods lists as well as additional high-risk vessel data.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第319页 批量筛查 批量筛查是反洗钱合规体系中的关键环节，金融机构可通过该流程系统性地比对客户数据 库与最新制裁名单、主要受益人名单及负面媒体报道信息。与实时交易监控不同，批量筛 查采用定期执行模式，可有效识别新制裁对象、动态变化的高风险客户群体以及新兴金融 犯罪威胁。 批量筛查对于以下情况至关重要： • 识别新兴风险：此前被归类为低风险的客户可能因制裁措施、刑事调查或政治风险敞口 而转变为高风险客户。 • 监管合规性：金融机构必须遵守美国金融犯罪执法局（FinCEN）、美国证券交易 委员会（OFAC）、欧盟反洗钱指令或其他相关监管机构所规定的反洗钱义务。 • 预防金融犯罪：批量筛查有助于识别与洗钱、恐怖主义融资和欺诈活动的关联，确保 金融机构不会无意中助长非法交易。 批量筛查采用结构化自动化流程，并通过合规性软件实施： • 数据提取：从内部数据库中检索客户身份信息、识别编号及相关商业关系。 • 名单匹配：将客户信息与国际制裁数据库进行比对，包括联合国、欧盟、OFAC 等机 构的名单、监控名单及负面媒体报道来源。 • 假阳性结果解析：筛查算法会标记潜在匹配项，需由合规团队进行人工验证。基于人 工智能驱动的技术系统可对匹配项进行风险评估，并提供优先级列表。 • 风险升级与上报机制：对高风险实体实施强化尽职调查，若发现洗钱或其他金融犯罪迹 象，须及时向金融情报单位（FIU）提交可疑交易报告。违规制裁行为将通报相关监管 机构，涉事客户通常将依照规定予以离岸处理。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 319 Batch screening Batch screening is a critical process and component in AFC compliance, allowing financial institutions to systematically review customer databases against updated sanctions lists, PEP lists, and adverse media sources. Unlike real-time transaction monitoring, batch screening is conducted at scheduled intervals to detect newly sanctioned individuals, evolving high-risk customers, and emerging financial crime threats. Batch screening is essential for: • Identifying emerging risks: Customers previously classified as low risk might become high risk due to sanctions, criminal investigations, or political exposure. • Regulatory compliance: Financial institutions must comply with AFC obligations outlined by FinCEN, OFAC, the EU AML Directives, or other relevant regulatory bodies. • Preventing financial crime: Batch screening helps identify links to money laundering, terrorist financing, and fraud, ensuring institutions do not inadvertently facilitate illicit transactions. Batch screening follows a structured, automated process using compliance software: • Data extraction: Retrieving customer identities, identification numbers, and associated business relationships from internal databases. • List matching: Comparing customer details against international sanctions databases, such as lists from the UN, EU, OFAC, and others; watchlists; and adverse media sources. • False positive resolution: Screening algorithms flag potential matches, requiring manual verification by compliance teams. AI-driven technology systems might risk-rate matches, offering a prioritized list. • Escalation and reporting: High-risk entities are subjected to enhanced due diligence, and where necessary, suspicious activity reports are filed with FIUs if money laundering or other financial crime concerns arise. Sanctions violations will be reported to the relevant regulatory bodies. Those customers would typically be offboarded in accordance with the

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第320页 该组织的退出政策需获得必要批准，并针对涉及受制裁个人及实体的特定交易取得特 殊许可。 • 人工智能驱动的筛查解决方案：在经过适当测试和实施后，人工智能驱动系统 可提高检测准确性，减少假阳性结果，并增强对潜在风险的识别能力。 • 持续性批次筛查：通过实时持续监测替代周期性更新，以实现更快的风险检测。 • 管辖权限要求：目前许多监管机构要求持续开展筛查工作，以确保符合美国食品药品 监督管理局（AFC）框架要求。 政治暴露人员筛查 由于能够接触公共资金和法定招标项目，主要经济人物（PEPs）更容易卷入贿赂和腐败活 动。因此，在反金融犯罪框架中，对客户进行筛查以识别主要经济人物及其亲属和密切关联 人员，是一项至关重要的管控措施。 不同司法管辖区及监管机构将PEPs（预防性用药）划分为以下类别： • 外国预防性暴露者（PEP）包括外国政府官员，如国家元首、高级政治家、军事领导 人、司法官员以及国有企业高级管理人员。 • 国内预防性教育计划（PEPs）包括在组织运营所在国担任高级公职的官员。 • 国际组织首席执行官（PEPs）是联合国、国际货币基金组织和世界银行等全球性 机构的高管及董事会成员。 FATF 指南规定，外国PEP应始终被视为高风险对象，并需接受强化尽职调查。对于国内外 机构的PEP，FATF 建议开展风险评估以确定其风险等级及相应的尽职调查程度。 需注意，部分司法管辖区将PEP分类扩展至家庭成员及密切关联人员，因其可能间接参与财 务活动。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 320 organization's exit policy, subject to the necessary approvals and special licenses for specific transactions linked to sanctioned individuals and entities. • AI-driven screening solutions: When appropriately tested and implemented, an AI-driven system can provide improved accuracy, reducing false positives and enhancing detection of hidden risks. • Perpetual batch screening: Replaces periodic updates with continuous real-time monitoring for faster risk detection. • Jurisdictional mandates: Many regulators now require ongoing screening to ensure compliance with AFC frameworks. Politically exposed persons screening PEPs are at heightened risk of involvement in bribery and corruption schemes because of their access to public funds and legal tenders. For this reason, screening customers to identify PEPs along with relatives and close associates of PEPs, is a critical control in an anti-financial crime framework. Different jurisdictions and regulatory bodies classify PEPs into the following categories: • Foreign PEPs include officials in foreign governments, such as heads of state, senior politicians, military leaders, judicial officials, and high-ranking members of state-owned enterprises. • Domestic PEPs include officials who hold a high public office within the country of an organization’s operation. • International organization PEPs are executives and board members of global entities, such as the UN, International Monetary Fund, and World Bank. FATF guidance provides that foreign PEPs should always be considered high risk and subject to enhanced due diligence. For domestic and international organization PEPs, FATF recommends that a risk assessment be conducted to determine their level of risk and the appropriate level of due diligence. Note that some jurisdictions extend PEP classifications to family members and close associates because of their potential indirect involvement in financial

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第321页 犯罪行为。然而，个人保护实体（PEP）的分类标准在全球范围内存在差异。此外，部分 司法管辖区将个人终身列为PEP，而其他地区则规定离任后设定有效期。金融机构应建立 明确的审查程序，以确定何时解除PEP分类。 许多组织会选择第三方供应商来提供潜在PEP（潜在暴露人群）的相关信息。在此情况 下，组织应遵循适当的外包程序，因为外包机构仍需承担相关风险。 无论PEP筛查是在内部开展还是通过供应商实施，均应考虑以下方面： • 筛查时机：在大多数司法管辖区，必须在客户开始活跃活动前进行PEP筛查，并应持续 对客户进行再筛查以确认其PEP状态是否发生变化。 • 筛查对象：需考虑筛查哪些相关方，特别是当客户为具有多个受益所有人及关联方的 企业实体时。 • 警报处理流程：需建立明确的操作规程并配备专职团队以处理PEP警报。在此过程中 需考虑对假阳性结果的容差度。对于高风险PEP（预防性暴露后用药）也应建立签发 流程。 • 测试：实施正式且持续的测试流程，以确保系统持续有效运行并进行质量保证 （QA）检查。 • 其他控制措施：包括在客户入职阶段及整个客户生命周期中对PEP（主要交易对手） 实施强化尽职调查流程。需考虑针对PEP所需的其他控制措施，例如特定交易监控规 则。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 321 crimes. However, PEP classifications vary globally. Additionally, some jurisdictions classify individuals as PEPs for life, while others set an expiration period after leaving office. Financial institutions should establish clear review procedures that determine when to lift a PEP classification. Many organizations select a third-party vendor to provide information about potential PEPs. When this happens, organizations should follow appropriate outsourcing procedures, because the outsourcing organization continues to own the risk.
