Regardless of whether PEP screening is done in-house or via a vendor, the following areas should be considered: • When to screen: In most jurisdictions, PEP screening must be done before the customer becomes active, and customers should be rescreened on an ongoing basis to check whether their PEP status has changed. • Who to screen: Consider which parties to screen, particularly if customers are corporate entities with multiple beneficial owners and associated parties. • Alert processing: Have a clear procedure and a team in place to clear the PEP alerts. Consider the tolerance for false positives during this process. There should also be a sign-off process for higher-risk PEPs. • Testing: Implement a formal, ongoing testing process to ensure the system continues to operate effectively and with QA checks. • Other controls: Include enhanced due diligence processes on PEPs at onboarding and throughout the customer life cycle. Consider what other controls are needed for PEPs, such as specific transaction monitoring rules.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第322页 不良媒体检查 负面媒体核查——亦称负面新闻筛查 识别公开信息中与个人或实体相关的金融犯罪风险关联。随着社交媒体平台事实核查机制 逐步弱化，以及自动化软件即服务筛查解决方案的普及，金融机构必须采取基于风险的负 面媒体筛查策略，确保风险评估的准确性与可信度。 金融机构必须开展负面媒体筛查以： • 识别新兴风险：客户可能因负面媒体报道、刑事指控或监管调查而面临更高的金融犯 罪风险或声誉风险。 • 确保符合全球反洗钱委员会（AFC）法规要求：美国金融犯罪执法局 （FinCEN）、欧盟反洗钱指令及其他监管机构均要求金融机构对高风险客户实施 持续性媒体监控。 • 强化基于风险的AFC框架：负面媒体报道可能影响客户尽职调查、强化尽职调查及持 续交易监控。 需注意，并非所有负面媒体报道结果均需上调风险评级。 各组织必须评估以下信息： • 信息来源的可信度：可靠来源包括监管报告、主要财经出版物及执法部门通告。未经核 实的社交媒体帖子与低质量博客内容需谨慎评估。 • 与AFC风险的相关性：媒体报道是否涉及金融犯罪行为？ • 时间范围：较早的案例可能相关性较低，尤其是当法律结果使当事人或实体获得无罪释 放时。然而，若指控或案件涉及高级管理人员或担任受监管职务的个人，则必须予以考 虑。 • 后续行动：法律诉讼是否已被撤销？监管罚款是否已达成和解？该个人是否面临任何 后果？
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 322 Adverse media checks Adverse media checks—also known as negative news screening— identify publicly available information linking individuals or entities to financial crime risks. With the increasing de-escalation of fact-checking on social media platforms, and the rise of automated software-as-a-service screening solutions, financial institutions must take a risk-based approach to adverse media screening, ensuring accurate and credible risk assessments. Financial institutions must conduct adverse media screening to: • Identify emerging risks: Customers might pose higher financial crime risks or reputational risks due to negative media exposure, criminal allegations, or regulatory investigations. • Ensure compliance with global AFC regulations: FinCEN, the EU AML Directives, and other regulatory bodies require financial institutions to implement continuous media monitoring for high-risk customers. • Strengthen risk-based AFC frameworks: Adverse media findings can influence customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and ongoing transaction monitoring. It is important to note that not all negative media findings warrant an increased risk rating. Organizations must assess the following information: • The credibility of the source: Reliable sources include regulatory reports, major financial publications, and law enforcement notices. Unverified social media posts and low-quality blogs should be carefully evaluated. • The relevance to AFC risks: Does the media report indicate financial crime violations? • The timeframe: Older cases might hold less relevance, especially if legal outcomes exonerated the individual or entity. However, if the allegations or case relate to a senior manager or an individual that held a regulated role, this must be considered. • Any follow-up actions: Were legal proceedings dismissed? Were regulatory fines settled? Were there any consequences for the individual

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第323页 例如个人罚款、监禁或旅行禁令？风险评估应反映事件发生后的变化。 自动化不良媒体筛查解决方案面临的挑战包括： • 社交媒体虚假信息：平台驱动的事实核查机制衰退增加了虚假或误导性报道 的可能性。各组织必须同意并优先采用经过验证的信息来源。 • 假阳性结果与算法偏倚：自动化筛查工具需采用精细化过滤机制及合规性监督措施 以避免误判。若判定某匹配结果并非真实匹配，则必须进行记录并注明原因。 • 监管期望的演变：部分司法管辖区现已强制要求实施实时监测，而非静态或定期的 不良媒体筛查检查。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 323 such as personal fines, imprisonment, or travel bans? Risk assessments should reflect post-incident changes. Challenges in automated adverse media screening solutions include: • Social media misinformation: The decline in platform-driven fact- checking increases the likelihood of false or misleading reports. Organizations must agree to and prioritize verified sources. • False positives and algorithmic bias: Automated screening tools require refined filtering and compliance oversight to avoid misidentification. If you determine that a match is not a true match, you must document it and note the reason. • Evolving regulatory expectations: Some jurisdictions now mandate real- time monitoring instead of static or periodic adverse media screening checks.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第324页 其他有助于降低风险的尽职调查要求 了解你的员工和供应商 企业需防范员工可能实施金融犯罪或与犯罪分子勾结的风险。完善的员工尽职调查计划 （即员工背景调查计划，简称KYE计划）可有效降低此类风险。供应商背景调查计划 （即供应商KYV 计划）有助于评估第三方供应商的风险。供应商可能提供具有价值的物 品以影响员工行为，从而导致贿赂和腐败风险。 欺诈行为可能由员工或供应商实施。为降低或控制此类风险，组织应在入职阶段及合作关系 存续期间建立完善的尽职调查与监控程序。 根据当地劳动法和数据保护法规要求，所有新员工都必须接受背景调查。具体流程可能包 括联系前雇主、进行信用核查、制裁措施审查、潜在雇员筛查以及负面媒体报道核查。虽 然多数企业会在入职阶段完成这些核查，但若能在员工整个职业生涯中持续跟进政策合规 性检查，将为组织提供更可靠的保障。 若供应商在与企业建立合作关系时存在欺诈意图或系统存在安全隐患，就可能引发数据泄 露、隐私泄露及安全风险。在企业入职流程中，组织方通常会实施尽职调查措施，包括对企 业及其代表人员进行背景审查。例如，董事需通过搜索引擎等开源情报渠道，核查其是否涉 及制裁名单、重点防范对象（PEP）或负面媒体报道记录。 为防范欺诈行为及潜在利益冲突，建议企业对供应商员工姓名及出生日期进行核查。若供 应商提供的IT服务需接入企业IT基础设施，企业应开展网络安全检查以确保符合相关政策 要求。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 324 Other due diligence requirements that help to mitigate risks Know your employee and vendor Organizations need to address risks from employees who might commit financial crimes or collaborate with criminals. A robust employee due diligence program, also known as a know your employee (KYE) program, lowers those risks. A know your vendor (KYV) program helps assess the risk of third-party vendors. Vendors might offer items of value to influence the actions of your employees, which leads to bribery and corruption risks. Fraud can be committed by employees or vendors. To mitigate or control those risks, organizations should have robust due diligence and monitoring programs at onboarding and throughout the lifetime of the relationship. Background checks are necessary for all new employees in accordance with local employment laws and data protection laws. This might include contacting former employers, conducting credit checks, sanctions and PEP screening, and adverse media checks. While most organizations conduct these checks during onboarding, checking to confirm compliance with policies and procedures throughout the lifetime of the employee offers further assurance to organizations. Vendors might introduce fraud, data privacy, and security risks if they enter a relationship with the organization with the intention to defraud or if the vendor has incapable systems. During onboarding, organizations conduct due diligence measures that typically include screening the organization and persons acting on its behalf. For example, directors should be screened against sanctions, PEPs, and adverse media lists using open-source intelligence, such as search engines. To detect fraudulent activity or potential conflicts of interest, it is recommended that organizations screen vendor staff names and dates of birth. If vendors provide IT services that require access to the organization's IT infrastructure, the organization should conduct a cybersecurity check to confirm compliance with its policies.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第325页 交易监控与调查 引言 引言：交易监控与调查 交易监控（TM）系统是帮助金融机构识别可疑交易模式的技术框架。 本模块将深入探讨交易监控系统（TM系统）的行业最佳实践与技术规范。您将掌握交易监 测警报评估技能，理解后续可能开展的各类调查类型。课程还将涵盖数据分析与文档编制的 最佳实践，帮助您开展全面的反洗钱（AML）调查，并掌握系统优化技巧。 案例示例：英国某银行AML控制措施失效 2021年，英国金融行为监管局（FCA）对国民威斯敏斯特银行（NatWest）处以近2.648亿英 镑罚款，因其反洗钱（AML）管控存在重大漏洞。该罚单源于该行未能有效监管珠宝商 Fowler Oldfield的黄金交易活动。 2011年，福勒·奥尔德菲尔德银行（Fowler Oldfield）成为国民西岸银行（NatWest）的客 户，当时该银行还是一家小型家族企业。当NatWest银行将Fowler Oldfield纳入客户名单 时，该行最初认为不会处理该企业的现金业务。然而在2012年11月至2016年6月期间， Fowler Oldfield向该行存入了约3.65亿英镑资金，其中包含2.64亿英镑的存款。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 325 Transaction Monitoring and Investigation Introduction Introduction: Transaction monitoring and investigation Transaction monitoring (TM) systems are the technological frameworks that help financial institutions detect suspicious transaction patterns. In this module, we will explore industry best practices and expectations for TM systems. You will gain skills to evaluate transaction monitoring alerts and understand the various types of investigations that might follow. This module will also cover best practices in data analysis and documentation, equipping you to conduct thorough AML investigations, and understand system tuning. Case example: AML control failures at a UK Bank In 2021, the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) fined National Westminster Bank (NatWest) nearly £264.8 million for significant failures in its AML controls. The fine was issued for failing to adequately monitor the activity of Fowler Oldfield, a jewelry business involved in buying and selling gold. Fowler Oldfield became a NatWest customer in 2011 when it was a small, family-owned company. When NatWest took on Fowler Oldfield as a customer, the bank initially thought it would not handle cash from the business. However, between November 2012 and June 2016, Fowler Oldfield deposited approximately £365 million with the bank, including £264 million in

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第326页 现金。2013年，该客户开始进行大额现金存款，并在整个合作期间持续保持这一行为。 NatWest未能基于风险敏感性原则对Fowler Oldfield的交易活动进行监控。NatWest自动 化交易监控系统存在的缺陷包括： • 银行系统将现金存款错误标记为支票存款，导致这些交易无法通过更严格的现金专用 监控规则进行监测。由于标签错误，“安全毯”监控规则未能识别可疑活动。 • 在大部分合作关系期间，NatWest银行未针对高风险客户制定针对支票的专项监控规 则，导致数百万英镑的现金交易未被有效监控。 • 由于警报生成量过大，银行有时会关闭监控警报功能。 尽管银行员工多次向反洗钱调查组提出交易监控警报审查建议并展开调查，但所有调查均未 促使Fowler Oldfield银行改变其经营行为及商业模式。这些调查主要针对反复出现的问题， 但由于各团队分散在不同分支机构且缺乏信息共享，导致调查结果缺乏连贯性。此前的独立 评估已发现多项问题，包括客户风险评级与风险评估体系存在缺陷、一线防御机制缺乏专业 领域知识储备，以及对高风险客户实施差异化监控措施不足。 尽管NatWest银行未参与洗钱活动，但法院明确指出其监管失职直接助长了非法交易的发 生。本案是《反洗钱法》（FCA）首次对洗钱违规行为提起刑事诉讼，凸显了建立完善交 易监控系统及严格执行风险敏感型持续监测机制的必要性。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 326 cash. In 2013, the customer began making large cash deposits, continuing this practice for the duration of the relationship. NatWest failed to monitor Fowler Oldfield’s activity on a risk-sensitive basis. Weaknesses in NatWest’s automated transaction monitoring included: • The bank’s system mislabeled cash deposits as check deposits, which prevented these transactions from being monitored with more stringent cash-specific monitoring rules. The “Security Blanket” monitoring rule failed to detect suspicious activity because of mislabeling. • For most of the relationship, NatWest had no check-specific monitoring rules for high-risk customers, allowing millions of pounds in cash transactions to go unmonitored. • At times, the bank turned off monitoring alerts because too many alerts were being generated. Although bank staff raised and investigated several transaction monitoring alert reviews to the AML investigations team, none of the investigations prompted changes in Fowler Oldfield’s behavior and business model. The investigations addressed repeated concerns that were fragmented because the teams worked across multiple offices and did not share information. Independent assessments had previously identified concerns, including issues with customer risk ratings and risk assessments, lack of subject matter expertise within the first line of defense, and insufficient differential monitoring for high-risk customers. Although NatWest was not complicit in money laundering, the court emphasized that its failures were instrumental in facilitating illicit transactions. This case marked the FCA's first criminal prosecution for AML violations and highlighted the need for robust transaction monitoring systems and adherence to risk-sensitive ongoing monitoring protocols.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第327页 关键要点 • 必须建立完善的风险敏感型交易监控机制，尤其要加强对高风险客户的监管。 • 正确标注交易记录以避免漏检可疑活动。 • 持续更新监控系统以适应客户行为的变化。 • 通过强有力的反洗钱（AML）管控措施，避免遭受严厉处罚及监管审查。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 327 Key takeaways • Ensure robust risk-sensitive transaction monitoring, especially for high-risk customers. • Correctly label transactions to avoid missed suspicious activities. • Continuously update monitoring systems to adapt to changing customer behavior. • Avoid severe penalties and regulatory scrutiny through strong AML controls.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第328页 事务监控 交易监控控制 企业通过实施交易监控管控措施来管理持续性风险。当客户行为超出其档案记录的正常范围 时，交易监控系统会触发警报。系统会对这些警报进行分析，以判断异常行为是否具有合理 解释依据，或是否存在可疑迹象。 交易监控控制通常采用自动化方式，但工作人员仍可在需要时手动触发警报。传统上，系 统采用基于规则的架构。然而，为提升可疑活动检测能力，企业正日益采用基于人工智能 的控制方案。 人工警报可能指前台部门在银行网点收到现金存款时生成的报告。而自动化控制系统则更 具针对性和精确性——例如，可识别特定司法管辖区居民使用特定货币的所有交易并触发 警报。在实施货币管制限制的地区，这类系统尤为必要。 阈值是行为的标准。可采用交易监测系统（TM system）来监控客户账户活动，通过评估 客户往来交易或账户状态，并针对不同类型客户账户设定特定阈值。 企业可选择采用单一监控系统或多个独立系统来追踪交易活动。对于大型客户（如企业或 金融机构）完成的交易，可采用同一监控系统进行追踪，但需根据不同场景设置不同的阈 值标准。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 328 Transaction monitoring Transaction monitoring controls Organizations apply transaction monitoring controls to manage ongoing risks. Transaction monitoring systems generate alerts when customer activity or behavior is beyond normal parameters for the customer profile. The alerts are reviewed to assess whether unusual behavior can be explained or if it is potentially suspicious. Transaction monitoring controls are typically automated, but staff can still raise alerts manually, when needed. Traditionally, rules-based systems were used. However, organizations are increasingly adopting AI-based controls to improve suspicious activity detection. A manual alert might be, for example, a report raised by the front office when a cash deposit is made in a bank branch. However, an automated control might be more targeted and more specific—for example, identifying and alerting on all transactions in a particular currency for citizens of a particular jurisdiction. This might be needed where currency control restrictions are applied. A threshold is criteria for behavior. A TM system might be applied to monitor customer account activity, assessing transactions to and from customers, or checking accounts, with specific thresholds for different types of customer accounts. An organization might choose to use one monitoring system or separate systems to monitor transactions. Transactions completed by larger customers, such as corporations or financial institutions, might be monitored by the same system, but using different scenarios and thresholds.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第329页 交易监控与支付筛查 组织机构通过交易监控与支付筛查来预防和侦测金融犯罪，并确保合规性。尽管这两个流程 常被混淆，但其时间节点与适用范围存在差异。 交易监控是指在客户完成开户后持续追踪其交易行为，以识别异常或非法活动及其对组织可 能造成的风险。该机制有助于发现可能涉及洗钱、逃税或其他金融犯罪的复杂交易模式。例 如，当出现大额交易、频繁转账或涉及高风险司法管辖区的交易时，系统会自动触发警报以 启动进一步调查。 若发现异常或可疑活动并确认可能涉及洗钱行为，则必须提交可疑交易报告（SAR）。 制裁措施、PEP（预防性暴露计划）及负面媒体报道筛查在入职前实施，并持续进行。交 易监控仅在入职后启动。 交易监控功能可在交易发生期间或之后检测异常或可疑活动。支付筛查可识别高风险个人 及实体，包括机构客户与交易对象 交易完成前的交易对手方 筛查方法有多种类型，包括： • 姓名筛查可识别可能具有较高金融犯罪参与风险的个体。该筛查通过将客户姓名与包 含制裁名单的观察名单进行比对实现。筛查在客户入行前实施，并通过批量筛查持续 进行。 • 支付或交易筛查会对客户支付的款项及收款情况进行审核，同时核查制裁名单上当事 方的收支款项。若发现匹配记录，将立即暂停相关交易并保留至调查完成。 • 负面媒体筛查是指对客户、受益所有人、股东或关联方的负面新闻进行审查，例如监管 罚款或调查事件。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 329 Transaction monitoring versus payment screening Organizations use transaction monitoring and payment screening to prevent and detect financial crime and ensure regulatory compliance. While these two processes are often confused, they differ in timing and scope. Transaction monitoring is the continuous observation of customer transactions after onboarding to identify unusual or illicit activity and the risk it might have to the organization. It helps detect complex patterns that might indicate money laundering, tax evasion, or other financial crimes. For example, large transactions, frequent transfers, or transactions involving high-risk jurisdictions might trigger alerts for further investigation. If unusual or suspicious activity is detected and confirmed as potential money laundering, a SAR must be submitted. Sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening occur before onboarding and continue on an ongoing basis. Transactions monitoring begins only after onboarding. Transaction monitoring detects unusual or suspicious activity during or after transactions occur. Payment screening identifies high-risk individuals and entities, including the institution’s customers and the transaction counterparties, before transactions are completed. There are several types of screening, including: • Name screening identifies individuals who might be at higher risk for involvement in financial crime. It screens customers’ names against watchlists including sanctions lists. It occurs prior to onboarding and on an ongoing basis through batch screening. • Payment or transaction screening reviews payments made and received by customers. It reviews payments made to or from parties on sanctions lists. If a match is detected, it is stopped and held until investigations are complete. • Adverse media screening reviews negative news about a customer, beneficial owner, shareholder, or associated party, such as regulatory fines or investigations.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第330页 • PEP筛查会审查客户姓名、支付详情、不良媒体报道以及与PEP的关联情况。 交易监控技术解决方案 金融机构正积极寻求并实施创新解决方案，通过生成更具价值的预警信息来减少误报导致的 资源浪费。他们持续提升金融犯罪风险管理能力，通过合理配置资源精准应对真实威胁。例 如，智能情境分析系统采用二元规则进行判断：当交易金额超过设定阈值且符合附加条件时 即触发警报。这些附加条件可能包括客户行为与历史记录及同业数据的差异性变化，或是客 户涉及高风险行业领域交易等特征。 网络分析技术能识别客户网络中受益者及其他成员之间的关联模式，从而揭示那些可能被忽 视的潜在联系。该工具可自动分析交易数据，无需人工干预即可发现客户间的隐性关联，通 过省去人工追踪相关交易环节，显著节省时间成本。这些自动化系统能够实时处理海量数 据，通过分析电子邮件域名、电话号码、地址等常见数据特征，精准识别企业账户间的关联 关系。若采用人工核查方式，不仅耗时费力，更难以高效完成。人工智能技术的进步显著优 化了这一流程，为合规团队提供了更强大的工具，助力打击金融犯罪。 人工智能驱动的交易监控技术正在彻底改变企业防范和侦测欺诈行为的方式。通过运用先进 算法与机器学习技术，这些系统可实时分析海量交易数据，帮助企业识别可能涉及欺诈或洗 钱活动的可疑交易模式与异常行为。 随着交易监控技术的不断发展，AFC（自动外汇清算）从业者需持续关注人工智能、机器 学习及数据分析领域的最新进展。通过与IT部门协作、参加行业会议及参与培训项目，从 业者可有效提升专业能力。主动监控
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 330 • PEP screening reviews customer names, payment details, adverse media, and connections to PEPs. Technology solutions for transaction monitoring Organizations are actively seeking and implementing solutions that generate more useful alerts that reduce wasteful efforts caused by false positives. They continuously improve their ability to manage financial crime risk by assigning resources to mitigate genuine threats to the business. For example, intelligent contextual analysis operates on a binary rule to check if a transaction exceeds a threshold and meets additional criteria. These criteria might include changes from a customer’s past behavior compared to their history and their peers, or if the customer is transacting in a higher-risk industry sector. Network analysis detects patterns among beneficiaries and others in a customer's network, helping uncover connections that might otherwise go unnoticed. These tools can automatically analyze transactions and identify hidden links between customers without manual intervention. This saves a significant amount of time by eliminating the need to manually track and trace related transactions. These automated systems can check vast amounts of data instantly. They can identify connections between corporate accounts based on common data features, such as email domains, phone numbers, and addresses. Manual checks of this data would be time consuming and labor intensive. Technology developments in AI have improved this process, equipping compliance staff with better tools in the fight against financial crime. AI-powered transaction monitoring is revolutionizing how organizations prevent and detect fraud. By leveraging advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques, these systems analyze vast amounts of transaction data in real time. This helps organizations identify suspicious patterns and behaviors that might indicate fraud or money laundering. As transaction monitoring technologies evolve, AFC professionals should stay informed about advances in AI, machine learning, and data analytics. These professionals benefit from collaborating with IT, attending industry conferences, and participating in training programs. Actively monitoring

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第331页 技术发展将助力其采用有效解决方案、提升检测能力，并适应新兴欺诈及洗钱风险。 实施人工智能解决方案存在固有风险。必须通过多样化数据集进行测试以消除偏见，同时 确保方案具备可解释性、透明度，并与组织具体情境相契合。只要采取恰当措施并保持严 谨态度，人工智能完全能够有效支持金融犯罪风险管理。 事务监控系统调优 交易管理系统调优是指对特定检测逻辑规则或场景的参数及阈值进行精细化调整的过程。 这些场景旨在识别可疑活动及异常交易行为，例如洗钱、欺诈等非法活动。调优具有重要 意义，因其： • 确保TM系统能有效检测可疑活动。 • 降低假阳性率 • 确保资源使用效率。 • 该系统助力企业有效管控金融犯罪风险及日常业务运营中的各类变更。 • 确保法规合规性。 调校包含四个关键要素：场景设定、客户 分段、阈值设定及频率 场景设置需要根据以往可疑活动经验及实际案例，创建、修改或删除检测规则与应用场景。 阈值设定用于确定触发交易警报所需的最低活动水平，例如报告CTR（客户交易率）的阈值 可设定为任何超过1万美元的货币交易。调整阈值能提升系统灵敏度与识别准确性，减少误 报率是阈值设置的核心目标，从而实现资源优化配置。阈值调整频率需根据实际需求确定， 可能受业务战略调整、异常事件、监管政策更新或市场变化等因素影响。系统应具备动态调 整能力，重大事件或趋势出现时需触发专项评估机制。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 331 technology developments will help them adopt effective solutions, enhance detection, and adapt to emerging fraud and money laundering risks. Implementing AI solutions comes with its own risks. These solutions must be tested with diverse data sets to help eliminate bias. They should also be explainable, transparent, and relevant to the organization’s specific context. With proper care and diligence, AI can support effective financial crime risk management. Transaction monitoring system tuning TM system tuning is the process of refining and adjusting parameters and thresholds of specific detection logic rules, or scenarios. Scenarios are designed to detect suspicious activities and abnormal transaction behaviors, such as money laundering, fraud, or other illicit activities. Tuning is important because it: • Ensures the TM system effectively detects suspicious activity. • Reduces false positives. • Ensures efficient resource use. • Allows organizations to manage changes in financial crime and in their business operations. • Ensures regulatory compliance. Tuning involves four key components: scenario setting, customer segmentation, threshold setting, and frequency. Scenario setting involves creating, modifying, or removing detection rules and scenarios based on previous experiences with suspicious activity and actual incidents. Threshold setting defines the minimum level of activity required for a transaction to trigger an alert. For example, the threshold for reporting a CTR might be any currency transaction that exceeds US$10,000. Adjusting thresholds refines sensitivity and accuracy. Reducing the number of false positives is a key goal in setting thresholds to make the most efficient use of resources. The frequency determines how often tuning should occur. The frequency might also be influenced by changes in business strategy, anomalies, regulatory updates, or market changes. Tuning should be dynamic, with special assessments triggered by significant events or trends.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第332页 在进行调校练习时，分析师需综合考量并整合多个数据点： • 配置参数：该部分包含规则相关的关键信息，包括创建日期、应用场景、目标识别类 型、预设阈值及警报触发频率。当企业性质、产品组合或潜在风险发生变化时，相关 应用场景及系统配置也可能随之调整。 • 警报生产效率与转化率：包括警报的数量、频率及重要性，或导致调查及可疑 活动报告的警报数量。 • 客户交易模式趋势分析：历史交易数据可揭示异常现象及趋势，提示潜在风险，使 企业能够调整风险识别标准。 • 行业信息与执法指导：这包括来自同行机构关于新兴风险及不同监测策略有效性的信 息。同样，执法机构与监管机构共享的指导文件、建议意见及反馈信息，可为调校工作 提供参考依据。 • 无论是新场景还是现有场景，系统均采用线上测试（ATL）与线下测试（BTL）相结合 的方式对交易模型（TM）规则进行评估与微调。ATL测试专门检测系统需要标记的交 易行为，BTL测试则针对未达阈值、本应被忽略的交易进行分析。这两种方法既能有效 识别潜在的误报与漏报情况，又能为规则参数优化提供有力支持。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 332 To perform a tuning exercise, analysts consider and consolidate several data points: • Configuration: This refers to information related to the rule, including the creation date, purpose, typology or scenarios it attempts to identify, established thresholds, and alert frequency. Changes in the nature of the business, products offered, and associated risks can also affect relevant scenarios and system configurations. • Alert productivity and conversion rates: These include the volume, frequency, and materiality of the alerts, or how many alerts result in investigations and suspicious activity reports. • Trends of customer transaction patterns: Historical transaction data can reveal anomalies and trends that suggest emerging risks, allowing organizations to adjust detection criteria. • Industry information and law enforcement guidance: This includes information from peer institutions on emerging risks and the effectiveness of different monitoring strategies. Similarly, guidance, advisories, and feedback shared by law enforcement agencies and regulatory bodies can inform tuning efforts. • For both new and existing scenarios, above-the-line (ATL) and below-the- line (BTL) testing are used to evaluate and fine tune TM rules. ATL testing examines transactions that should be flagged by the system. BTL testing looks at transactions that fall below the threshold and would not be flagged. Both methods help identify potential false positives and false negatives, and support the optimization of rule parameters.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第333页 警报生成 可能触发警报的典型场景 交易监控场景通过分析行业规模、管辖区域及客户活动等因素来设置警报。场景类型可从基 础级到复杂级不等。 传统系统设计通常较为简单，仅通过有限或特定信息来触发警报。例如，某条规则会自动识 别所有金额超过设定阈值的交易记录。如今，企业普遍采用人工智能和机器学习等技术，基 于复杂海量数据集构建智能警报系统。当客户行为与预期模式出现偏差时，系统就会更有可 能触发警报。 常见的交易监控应用场景示例如下： • 为规避检测而拆分为小额的结构性交易 • 超过特定金额门槛（通常为1万美元）的大额现金交易 • 大额交易记录，例如超过客户历史最高交易金额的交易 • 高周转交易或高速度汇款：指交易金额或交易频率超过客户同业客户群体平均水平的 交易行为 • 与该客户类型预期使用量相比，特定渠道的过度使用，例如现金支付相对于电子支 付的高使用率 • 往返交易：汇款发送后立即或随后不久以收到汇款形式退回 • 一对多或多对一：汇款发送给多个当事人，或反之，但缺乏合理解释
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 333 Alert generation Typical scenarios that would generate an alert Transaction monitoring scenarios analyze factors such as industry size, jurisdiction, and customer activity to set alerts. Scenarios can range from basic to more complex. Traditionally, scenarios were simple, focusing on limited or specific information to generate alerts. For example, one rule identified all transactions above a specific monetary amount. Currently, organizations use technologies, such as AI and machine learning, to implement scenarios that create more meaningful alerts based on complex and voluminous data sets. If a customer’s activity deviates from the expected pattern, an alert is more likely to be generated. Some examples of frequently used transaction monitoring scenarios include: • Structured transactions that are broken up into smaller amounts to avoid detection • Large cash transactions that exceed a specific threshold, usually US$10,000 • Large deposits, such as transactions that exceed the customer’s previous peak transaction value • High-turnover transactions or high-velocity remittance: Transactions that exceed the value or velocity of the customer’s peer group of customers • Excessive use of a particular channel compared to what is expected for that customer type, such as high use of cash over electronic payments • Round trip transactions: A sent remittance returned as a received remittance immediately or shortly afterward • One to N parties or N parties to One: A remittance sent to multiple parties, or vice versa, without a logical explanation

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第334页 警报审查程序 在大型组织中，交易监控警报的审核流程通常包含多层级审查与信息收集环节。小型组织则 可能采用一键式系统，由单一分析师负责从警报生成到提交系统分析报告（SAR）的全流程 处理。 当采用多层级审核机制时，一级审核（即初始审核阶段）会在交易管理系统触发警报时启 动。分析师通过评估多项数据指标来验证警报有效性，包括警报性质、交易类型、客户画 像、账户历史记录及历史警报记录等要素。该分析过程有助于判断异常交易是否符合预期客 户行为模式。若交易行为呈现异常特征或超出预设阈值，警报将升级至二级审核进行深入调 查；若未发现异常，则分析师可判定为误报，并需提供充分的结论依据进行书面记录。 在二级审查（即调查阶段），分析师会对预警信息及初步审查数据进行深入分析，以判断 异常行为是否可能构成金融犯罪。该阶段通常包括以下内容： • 分析交易模式与频率。 • 评估资金来源与去向 • 审查KYC 信息及客户风险概况。 • 收集额外记录，例如客户与机构之间的通信日志，以及与客户或账户相关的任何既 往调查。 • 开展开源研究，涵盖社交媒体、新闻报道、公共记录、执法部门及监管机构发布的公 告、预警或指导文件，以形成对升级活动的研判意见。 随后，分析人员将根据所收集的数据，判断该活动是否可疑，并提供充分的依据。 对于高度可疑案件或涉及大量交易及敏感情况的案件，应上报至三级审查阶段或复杂 分析阶段。高级分析师或合规官将开展全面评估，评估内容可能涵盖跨部门协作。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 334 Procedures for alerts review In larger organizations, the process for reviewing transaction monitoring alerts typically involves multiple levels of review and information gathering. Smaller organizations might use a one-touch system, where a single analyst handles the alert from generation through the submission of a SAR. When multiple levels of reviews are used, Level 1 review—or the initial review stage—occurs when a TM system generates an alert. An analyst examines the alert’s validity by evaluating various data points, including the alert's nature, transaction type, customer profile, account history, and previous alert history. This analysis helps determine if the activity aligns with expected customer behavioral patterns. If the activity appears abnormal or exceeds accepted thresholds, the alert escalates to Level 2 review for further investigation. If not, the analyst can dismiss it as a false positive, and document sufficient rationale for arriving at that conclusion. During the Level 2 review, or investigation stage, analysts perform a detailed analysis of the alert and data from the initial review to establish whether the unusual behavior could indicate a financial crime. This stage typically includes: • Analyzing transaction patterns and frequency. • Assessing the source and destination of funds. • Reviewing KYC information and the customer risk profile. • Gathering additional records, such as communication logs between the customer and institution, and any prior investigations related to the customer or account. • Conducting open-source research to include social media, news articles, public records and notices, alerts, or guidance issued by law enforcement and regulatory agencies, to inform their opinion on the escalated activity. Analysts then determine whether the activity is suspicious, providing a robust rationale based on the data collected. Highly suspicious cases or those that involve numerous transactions or sensitive situations should be escalated to Level 3 review, or the complex analysis stage. Senior analysts or compliance officers conduct this comprehensive assessment, which might include cross-department

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第335页 协作机制、复杂风险评估以及交易网络的精细分析。 在整个流程中，分析师会细致记录每个步骤，并在必要时向监管机构提交可疑活动报告 （SAR），确保报告包含所有相关信息及依据。提交后，持续监控至关重要，既能避免问 题进一步恶化，又能及时发现新的犯罪活动。 分析师通常建议通过加强客户监控或实施账户限制作为预防措施。 其他调查来源 AML调查可能源自多种渠道，不仅限于交易监控系统。这些来源包括内部及外部转介、交 易对手方或代理银行的信息请求、负面新闻、监管机构的调查结果与建议，以及执法部门 的问询。 内部举报线索可来自多个部门，包括反欺诈部门、代理银行、分支机构、数字部门及电话团 队等，这些部门具备识别可疑活动的专业优势。内部热线电话及举报人投诉同样可作为反洗 钱调查的重要信息来源。 外部转诊来自组织外部渠道，例如关注社区事务的市民和商业合作伙伴，这些转诊信息 通过其面向客户的员工或其他渠道传递。 来自交易对手方或代理银行的信息请求（RFI）是针对可能源于多种场景（如客户尽职调 查和交易监控）的澄清、数据或补充细节的正式请求。 以美国为例，《美国爱国者法案》第314a条和第314b条允许金融机构及政府机构共享潜在 洗钱信息。该条款通过接入更广泛的信息网络，显著提升了可疑活动的侦测能力，并可及 时启动审查程序。 收到此类请求可能触发额外的内部调查。 持续运行的负面新闻筛查程序与系统能够识别促使开展审查并生成调查线索的信 息。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 335 collaboration, complex risk assessments, and intricate analysis of transaction networks. Throughout this process, analysts meticulously document each step and, if required, file SARs with regulatory authorities, ensuring they include all pertinent information and rationale. Following the filing, ongoing monitoring is critical to mitigate further issues and identify additional criminal activities. Analysts often recommend enhanced customer monitoring or account restrictions as preventive measures. Other sources of investigation AML investigations might originate from a wide range of sources beyond transaction monitoring systems. These sources include internal and external referrals, requests for information from counterparties or correspondent banks, negative news, regulatory findings and recommendations, and law enforcement requests. Internal referrals, can come from various departments—such as fraud, correspondent banks, branches, digital, and telephony teams—which are well- positioned to identify suspicious activities. Internal hotlines and whistleblower complaints also serve as sources for AML investigations. External referrals come from sources outside the organization—such as concerned citizens and business partners—through their customer-facing employees or other channels. Requests for information (RFI) from counterparties or correspondent banks are formal requests for clarification, data, or additional details that can arise from multiple contexts, such as customer due diligence and transaction monitoring. For example, in the US, Sections 314a and 314b of the USA PATRIOT Act allow financial institutions and government agencies to share potential money laundering information. They allow access to a broader information network, enhancing the ability to detect suspicious activities and initiate reviews. Receiving such a request can trigger an additional internal investigation. Ongoing negative news screening programs and systems can identify information that prompts reviews and generates investigative leads.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第336页 监管发现与建议有助于识别额外风险并启动审查程序。 执法机构（LEA）可采用法律文书要求金融机构为调查提供文件或信息。此类文书包 括： • 法院命令：法官可指令相关机构披露与正在进行的调查相关的账户信息或交易记 录。 • 传票：法律要求迫使组织提供与案件相关的特定通信或记录。 • 搜查令：这类由法院签发的许可文件授权执法机构对场所及文件进行搜查。通过搜查 令获取的信息亦可能成为潜在可疑活动的线索来源。 • 其他：执法部门的直接询问可促使金融机构调查可能与犯罪活动相关的行为。 鉴于这些调查来源极可能涉及重大事项且敏感性极高，必须格外谨慎处理。尤其要避免向潜 在调查对象泄露信息。在某些情况下，泄密行为可能构成重罪，导致涉事员工面临刑事指 控。因此，组织应建立完善的调查管理程序，以最大限度降低信息泄露风险。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 336 Regulatory findings and recommendations can help identify additional risks and initiate reviews. Law enforcement agencies (LEA) may use legal instruments that require financial institutions to provide documents or information for investigations. These instruments include: • Court orders: A judge may direct the institution to release account information or transaction records related to an ongoing investigation. • Subpoenas: Legal requests compel the organization to produce specific communications or records relevant to a case. • Search warrants: These court-issued permissions allow law enforcement agencies to search premises and documents. Information gathered from search warrants could also be sources of potentially suspicious activity. • Other: Direct inquiries from law enforcement can prompt a financial institution to investigate activities possibly linked to criminal activities. Given the high likelihood of materiality and sensitivity, these investigation sources must be handled with extra care. It is particularly important to avoid tipping off a potential subject of an investigation. In some cases, tipping off is a felony that can result in criminal charges against the employee. For this reason, organizations should have robust procedures for the management of investigations that minimize the risk of information leaks.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第337页 调查 调查所采取的步骤 在启动调查程序以核实并上报可疑交易前，分析师需先明确可疑交易的性质，并判断该交易 是否存在合理解释。同时应核查同一账户或客户过往交易记录中的规律性特征。通过入职培 训收集的信息与历史交易数据可提供重要背景依据。最后，所有调查结果必须形成完整文 档，明确标注缺失的关键信息（如有）。 信息收集 收集充分信息对于确定警报的有效性和/或开展调查至关重要。负责审查和调查警报的员工 应综合运用内部与外部信息以做出决策。 内部信息是指由组织维护且审阅者可访问的数据。关键内部数据点包括： • KYC 数据：客户档案、风险因素及历史行为记录。 • 交易数据：包含历史交易详细记录的警报上下文信息。 • 警报与调查历史记录：基于先前针对同一客户或交易模式的警报所获得的洞察。 • 账户历史记录与活动：用于区分典型行为与异常行为的账户使用情况及趋势 分析。 外部信息是指存在于组织外部的数据。它为内部信息提供了额外背景信息，并有助于识 别警示信号。外部信息来源包括： • 公开来源：新闻文章、公共记录及其他在线资源。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 337 Investigations Steps applied to an investigation Before escalating an investigation to confirm and report suspicion, an analyst is expected to understand the nature of the suspicion and determine whether there is a possible explanation for the transaction. Any patterns of previous transactions from the same account or customer should also be reviewed. Information gathered during onboarding, along with historical transaction data, can provide helpful context. Finally, all research should be clearly documented, indicating what information—if any—is missing. Information gathering Gathering sufficient information is important to determine an alert’s validity and/or conduct investigations. Employees responsible for reviewing and investigating alerts should use both internal and external information to make decisions. Internal information is data maintained by the organization and accessible to the reviewer. Key internal data points include: • KYC data: Customer’s profile, risk factors, and historical behavior. • Transaction data: Context for the alert with detailed records of past transactions. • Alert and investigation history: Insights from previous alerts concerning the same customer or transaction pattern. • Account history and activity: Account usage and trends that help distinguish between typical and unusual behavior. External information is data that exists outside the organization. It provides additional context to the internal information and can help identify red flags. External information sources include: • Open sources: News articles, public records, and other online resources.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第338页 • 社交媒体资料：来自社交媒体的信息，可为客户提供或相关方提供额外背景信息。 • 合作伙伴及合作机构：财务合作伙伴共享的信息可能揭示可疑关联或交易行为。 • 执法机构：与监管机构及执法部门的合作可能提供关于已知欺诈活动或网络的关键信 息。 • 信息请求（RFI）：金融机构用于收集触发警报交易详细信息的正式流程，这些交易可 能表明可疑活动。该流程有助于发现和调查潜在金融犯罪，并在往来机构之间的反馈 机制中发挥关键作用。 分析师通过综合分析内部与外部信息来源，以确定后续行动方案。 在记录警报调查过程时，需明确记载所执行的搜索操作、已识别或缺失的相关信息，以及 支持决定是否撤销或升级警报的关键数据点。必须包含信息来源、获取或提供日期，以及 （如可获取）用于后续跟进的来源联系信息。此类文档可确保建立完整的审计追踪记录， 并在警报升级或重新启动时为后续调查提供支持或便利。 多少研究量才算合理？ 监管机构常采用“合理”这一术语。通过深入研究可能发现更多警示信号。在评估组织的政 策、流程及程序时，监管机构通常不会仅依据单一事件进行评判，而是重点考察该整体方案 在风险识别方面的有效性是否达到合理标准。 关于何时信息量充足，通常缺乏明确答案。 然而，若基于研究内容、文献依据及实施步骤，他人能够认为所得结论具有合理性，则 可认为该研究工作是“合理的”。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 338 • Social media profiles: Information from social media that might provide additional context about a customer or related parties. • Partners and collaborating institutions: Information shared by financial partners might reveal suspicious connections or transactions. • Law enforcement agencies: Cooperation with regulatory bodies and law enforcement might provide critical information about known fraudulent activities or networks. • Request for information (RFI): A formal process used by financial institutions to gather more details about transactions that have triggered alerts and might indicate suspicious activity. It supports the detection and investigation of potential financial crime and plays a key role in the feedback loop between correspondent and respondent institutions. Analysts review both internal and external information sources holistically to reach a determination on any next steps. When documenting an alert investigation, clearly record the searches that were performed, the relevant information that was identified or missing, and the key data points that support the decision to either dismiss or escalate the alert. It is necessary to include the source of information, the date it was accessed or provided, and—when available—the source’s contact information for follow-up. This documentation ensures an adequate audit trail and supports or facilitates future investigations if the alert is escalated or reopened. How much research is reasonably enough? Regulators often use the term “reasonable.” Conducting in-depth research might uncover additional red flags. In evaluating an organization’s policies, processes, and procedures, regulators usually don’t judge based on a single incident. They investigate whether the overall program is reasonably effective at identifying risk. There is often no clear answer as to when there is enough information. However, it might be said that the work is “reasonable” if, based on the content, documentation, and steps followed, another person would find the conclusions justifiable.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第339页 FATF 指出，金融机构必须采用基于风险的方法，并采取合理措施核实受益所有人身份。 对于法人实体及安排，应包括了解客户的所有权与控制结构。 反洗钱计划应为企业制定最低标准，这些标准需经过合理设计以确保符合所有适用法律法 规。可结合各业务部门或法律实体的政策流程进行补充完善，针对私人银行业务、贸易融 资、现金管理、机构银行业务、财富管理及调查等特定领域制定针对性措施。合规计划还应 涵盖公司治理机制，并对洗钱及恐怖主义融资风险实施整体管控。 举例而言，若贵公司能为持有客户10%及以上股权的所有最终受益人留存经核实的原始文 件，该做法可被视为合理合规。但若仅通过公开媒体报道进行网络检索（且未经过核实）， 则无法满足合理尽职调查标准，此类信息将被视为不充分。 从理论上讲，任何金融机构都不可能合理地察觉客户的所有不当行为，包括洗钱活动。 但若金融机构建立系统与流程来识别、监控并上报高风险客户及交易，便能有效规避犯 罪分子的侵害，同时降低遭受政府制裁与处罚的风险。 沟通渠道与预警机制 负责交易监控、风险评估及反洗钱调查的分析师可能需要获取内部数据或公开渠道无法提供 的信息。这些信息可能涉及异常客户交易记录、KYC 数据变更、客户商业发票或运营文件 等关键资料。客户关系经理或一线员工可通过联系客户本人、机构合作伙伴（如其他金融机 构）或代理分行获取相关信息。客户关系经理与一线团队最擅长开展客户沟通工作，并将调 查结果及时反馈给分析师。工作人员必须严格保密，切忌提前泄露客户信息。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 339 According to FATF, financial institutions must use a risk-based approach and take reasonable measures to verify the identity of the beneficial owner. For legal persons and arrangements, this should include understanding the ownership and control structure of the customer. The AML program should establish minimum standards for the enterprise that are reasonably designed to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. It may be supplemented by the policies and procedures of various lines of business or legal entities that address specific areas, such as private banking, trade finance, cash handling, institutional banking, wealth management, or investigations. Compliance programs should also include corporate governance and overall management of money laundering and terrorist financing risks. As an example, having on file primary, verified documentation for all ultimate beneficial owners holding 10% or more of your customer could be considered reasonable by your organization. However, an online search of public media that reports ownership only, and is not verified, would be considered insufficient. It would not pass the reasonable due diligence test. In theory, no financial institution can reasonably be expected to detect all wrongdoing by customers, including money laundering. But if a financial institution develops systems and procedures to detect, monitor, and report the riskier customers and transactions, it will increase its chances of staying out of harm’s way from criminals and government sanctions and penalties. Communication channels and tipping off Analysts responsible for transaction monitoring alert reviews and AML investigations might require information that is not available through internal data or publicly available sources. This information could be related to unusual customer transactions, changes in KYC data, the customer’s business invoices or operation documentation, or other relevant data. Relationship managers or front line staff can obtain this information by contacting the customer, organizational partners, such as other financial institutions, or correspondent branches. Relationship managers and front line staff are best positioned to conduct customer outreach and communicate findings to analysts. Staff must remember to maintain confidentiality and avoid tipping off the customer.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第340页 在开展外联工作前，分析师需确认所请求的信息对做出明智决策至关重要，且该信息既不为 内部所知也不对外公开。若两项条件均满足，分析师应选择最优外联方式并制定相应计划。 外联过程中，所有与客户沟通的人员均需注意以下事项： • 保密性：确保敏感信息仅通过安全渠道与授权方共享。 • 清晰度与精确性：表述需清晰准确，以避免误解或误读。 • 专业性：在所有沟通中保持专业语气，以确保可信度并体现组织标准。 • 如何避免泄露线索：泄露线索是指调查人员故意或无意中向被调查对象透露其活动正 受到监控的情况，尤其涉及洗钱或金融犯罪嫌疑时。根据反洗钱法规，泄露线索属于 违法行为，可能引发严重后果，包括刑事责任、监管处罚及声誉损害。 • 法规遵从性：遵守涉及敏感信息通信的法律法规指南，例如数据保护法。 • 文档记录：完整保存所有沟通内容、日期、时间及讨论事项，以满足问责与审计需求。 与客户沟通 在某些情况下，可能需要与客户进行沟通以收集额外信息，用于尽职调查或调查目的。通 常由客户关系经理等面向客户的员工主持此类会议，因为他们可能已与客户建立了业务关 系。 部分司法管辖区要求企业必须提前告知客户其将收集的信息类型。即便无此强制要求，提 供此类通知仍具必要性，可有效避免客户产生企业提出非必要问题的误解。同时建议明确 说明数据使用目的，因客户通常对个人信息泄露持谨慎态度。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 340 Before conducting outreach, the analyst should ensure that the requested information is critical for making an informed determination, and not available internally or externally. If both conditions are met, analysts should consider the best outreach methods and plan accordingly. During outreach, anyone who communicates with the customer should consider: • Confidentiality: Ensure that sensitive information is shared securely and only with authorized parties. • Clarity and precision: Be clear and precise to avoid misunderstandings or misinterpretation. • Professionalism: Maintain a professional tone in all communications, for credibility and to reflect the organization’s standards. • How to avoid tipping off: Tipping off occurs when an investigator intentionally or unintentionally alerts the subject of an investigation that their activities are being monitored, particularly with suspicions of money laundering or financial crimes. Tipping off is prohibited under AML regulations and can have severe consequences including criminal liability, regulatory sanctions, and reputational damage. • Compliance with regulations: Adhere to legal and regulatory guidelines, such as data protection laws, that govern communications involving sensitive information. • Documentation: Record all communications, dates, times, and the content discussed for accountability and audit purposes. Communicating with customers At times it will be necessary to engage with customers to gather additional information for due diligence or investigative purposes. Customer-facing employees, such as relationship managers, typically conduct these meetings, as they might already have a relationship with the customer. Some jurisdictions require advanced notification to customers that the organization will collect information. Even if not required, providing this notice is advisable, as it helps reduce the impression that the organization is asking unnecessary questions. It is also advisable to tell the customer how the data will be used. Customers are often wary of giving out personal information

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第341页 因为他们认为该信息将被用于营销、转售或以其他方式泄露。匿名性与谨慎性之间 存在区别。 谨慎行事是明智之举，也是客户普遍所求，因此需向其保证：机构将严格遵守相关数据法 规，妥善处理其数据。 具备良好的人际交往能力并采用轻松对话方式，比将会议变成审讯式对话更能有效缓解客 户紧张情绪。工作人员应给予客户充分的发言空间。使用标准化模板和脚本可确保收集到 所有必要信息，并保持适当的细节程度。但需特别注意，工作人员必须时刻留意客户的反 馈，及时识别需要跟进或澄清的事项。 若工作人员使客户感到安心，但客户却表现不合作，这可能引发怀疑。虽然并非所有不 合作的客户都在洗钱，但若能及早提出怀疑，许多违规行为本可避免。 最后，确保会议提供的可靠细节足以通过其他来源验证信息。应尽快以书面形式记 录会议详情，以确保记录完整且准确。 调查组织内部人员 在组织内部调查相关人员时，需要综合考量多个因素：保密性、保护组织与员工权益、协调 其他利益相关方、规范档案管理以及证据保存。调查人员的核心职责是收集、整理、评估并 保存与指控相关的证据，随后将案件材料提交至相关部门进行正式审查。根据指控性质及调 查范围，可能需要对同事、上级主管及涉事员工等证人进行访谈。所有操作必须严格遵守法 律法规及组织内部规章制度。 指控内容将指导调查过程中需采取的步骤。制定调查计划需明确调查目标、达成目标所需 的证据、调查范围与局限性以及潜在信息来源。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 341 because they believe it will be used for marketing, resold, or otherwise compromised. There is a difference between anonymity and discretion. Discretion is good, and commonly sought by customers, so assure them that the organization will treat their data with care and in adherence with relevant data regulations. Having good interpersonal skills and engaging in a conversational manner is more likely to put the customer at ease, as opposed to making the meeting feel like an interrogation. The staff member should allow the customer to speak freely. Using a template and script ensures that all required information is collected with an appropriate level of detail. However, it is important for the staff member to remain alert to customer responses that might require follow-up or clarification. If the staff member puts the customer at ease, but that customer is uncooperative, this might raise suspicions. While not every uncooperative customer is laundering money, many violations could have been prevented had suspicions been raised earlier. Finally, ensure the meeting provides enough reliable detail to verify the information through other sources. Record the details of the meeting in writing as soon as possible to ensure a complete and accurate record. Investigating someone inside the organization Investigating someone in the organization requires consideration of a number of factors: confidentiality, protection of the organization and the employee, engagement of other stakeholders, proper recordkeeping, and preservation of evidence. The role of the investigator is to collect, collate, assess, and preserve evidence relating to the allegations and present a case to the appropriate department for formal consideration. Depending on the allegations and scope of the investigation, there might be a need to interview witnesses, such as coworkers and supervisors, and the suspected employee. All actions taken must be within the law and the organization’s policies. Allegations will guide the steps to be taken for the investigation. Creating an investigation plan sets the goal of the investigation and the evidence required to reach that goal, scope and limitations, and potential sources of information.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第342页 为保护组织及员工权益，调查负责人可能需与人力资源部门协作，因在调查结束前暂停涉 事员工职务属合理处置措施。若需获取电子邮件、语音记录或系统访问日志等数据，调查 人员须获得信息技术部门的支持。 证人陈述通常构成调查的基础。证人陈述是指该证人对事件所作的陈述版本，必须注意 避免引导证人。 所有员工访谈必须严格遵守法律法规及组织政策。可能需要安排独立第三方或人力资源代表 在场监督。制定访谈计划有助于规范访谈流程，并作为问题引导手册以实现目标。访谈应以 敏感方式进行；调查人员并非用于评判目的。 保密性与规范的记录保存是成功调查的基本要素。 信息分析 在交易监控警报审查及反洗钱调查全流程中，分析师与调查人员会从内外部渠道收集并整理 数据。但调查人员的工作远不止于信息采集与记录，他们还需通过数据分析将信息转化为可 操作的情报与洞见。 通过分析交易记录、客户画像及监管警示信息，分析师可验证疑点并判断是否需要开展进 一步调查、提交报告或采取行动。调查过程中，调查人员需着力厘清业务关联关系及资金 流动情况。 调查人员需识别并绘制个人与实体之间的关联关系图谱，涵盖客户、交易对手、实际控制 人、亲属受益人以及母公司与子公司等主体。网络分析技术可直观呈现复杂关系网络与交 易流向，使反洗钱（AFC）专业人员能够通过可视化图表展示关联性、识别行为模式，并 厘清与洗钱活动相关的复杂关系。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 342 To protect the organization and the employee, the person in charge of the investigation might need to engage the HR department, because suspending the employee until the conclusion of the investigation might be an appropriate action. If there is a need to secure emails, voice recordings, or systems access logs, the investigator will need the support of the IT department. Witness statements often form the basis of the investigation. A witness statement is a version of the events given by that witness, and care must be taken not to lead the witness. All employee interviews must be conducted within the law and the organization’s policies. There might be a requirement to have an independent third party or an HR representative present. Preparing an interview plan will assist with structuring the interview and serve as a question guide to achieve the goal. Interviews should be conducted in a sensitive manner; the investigator is not there to judge. Confidentiality and proper recordkeeping are the fundamental elements of a successful investigation. Analysis of information Throughout the transaction monitoring alert review and AML investigation processes, analysts and investigators collect and document data from internal and external sources. However, investigators must go beyond merely gathering and recording this information. They analyze the data to transform it into actionable intelligence and insights. By examining transaction histories, customer profiles, and regulatory alerts, analysts can validate suspicions and decide if further investigation, reporting, or action is warranted. During the investigation, investigators must seek to understand relationships and cash and fund flows. Investigators identify and map relevant relationships between individuals and entities, such as customers, counterparties, beneficial owners, relatives and beneficiaries, and parent companies and subsidiaries. Network analysis helps visualize complex relationships and transaction flows. It allows AFC professionals to represent connections graphically, identify behavioral patterns, and clarify complicated relationships associated with money laundering.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第343页 分析现金及资金流动有助于评估交易合法性并识别潜在非法活动。该过程需追踪资金在账户 及金融机构间的流转情况。关键考量因素包括： • 交易模式分析：通过评估交易频率、交易量及交易时间特征，识别异常交易激 增现象或与预期行为的偏离情况，尤其针对向高风险司法管辖区进行的大额交 易。 • 资金来源与去向：明确资金的来源及流向，确保资金来源与客户画像及业务需求相匹 配。 • 交易层级化现象：识别可能掩盖基金流向的复杂交易层级结构。 • 与外部信息的整合：将现金流分析结果与外部数据（如公开记录或制裁名单）相结 合，以提供背景信息并进行验证。 通过可视化现金流及其关联关系，分析师能够更清晰地把握交易动态，并及时发现 需要进一步核查的异常情况。 在深入分析过程中，研究者可能会发现该病例比预期更为复杂。新发现的信息可能揭示出先 前未知或被忽视的网络关系与行为模式。识别这些关联性将显著改变调查方向，进而发现更 广泛的可疑活动网络。在此类情况下，分析师应立即与AFC合规团队沟通，明确如何处理新 信息以避免不必要的延误。早期介入能确保调查方向清晰明确，强化调查力度，并为满足监 管时限要求建立明确路径。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 343 Analyzing cash and fund flows helps assess transaction legitimacy and identify potential illicit activity. This process involves tracing the movement of funds across accounts and financial institutions. Key considerations include: • Transaction patterns: Evaluate the frequency, volume, and timing of transactions to identify unusual spikes or deviations from expected behavior, especially large transactions to high-risk jurisdictions. • Source and destination of funds: Determine where funds originate and where they are sent. Ensure that sources align with the customer’s profile and business. • Layering transactions: Identify complex transaction layering that might obscure the fund trail. • Integration with external information: Combine cash flow findings with external data, such as public records or sanctions lists, for context and validation. Visualizing cash flows and relationships can help analysts comprehend transaction dynamics and detect irregularities that may require further scrutiny. During in-depth analysis, investigators might discover that the case is more complicated than expected. New information may be discovered that reveals previously unknown or overlooked networks or patterns. Identifying these connections can significantly reshape the investigation and uncover broader networks of suspicious activity. In such cases, analysts should promptly consult their AFC compliance team to determine how to proceed with the new information and avoid unnecessary delays. Early engagement ensures clarity and direction, strengthens the investigation, and establishes a clear path to meet regulatory timelines.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第344页 可疑活动升级流程 如果调查人员已完成研究并发现无法缓解的风险指标，可能需要将该客户升级至更高层级进 行进一步调查。根据所在司法管辖区和组织政策的不同，最终结果可能是向金融情报单位 （FIU）提交特别报告（SAR）。依据组织流程，可能需要由一名或多名人员对研究结果进 行复核，再决定是否向主管部门提交报告。用于上报调查结果的内部流程至关重要——这可 能涉及法律和监管后果。因此必须充分了解相关政策和流程规范。 在研究过程中，调查人员始终依赖他人的研究成果与技术支持。部分人员可能曾参与前期研 究工作，例如在编制客户档案或分析历史交易警报时。另有人员则提供了其掌握的客户个人 资料。调查人员对信息进行筛选、整理与优先级划分，并综合运用所有来源数据，最终形成 完整的案件记录文档。 目前其他相关方将共同参与下一步行动方案的决策制定。 由于各司法管辖区及组织机构具有独特性，相关人员的角色分工及采用的流程程序均存 在差异。若未严格遵循相关流程，可能导致法律及监管后果。因此，需审慎提问、学习 并推进工作。 下一步可能的举措是提交内部升级报告。这类报告存在多种名称：有人称之为异常活动报 告（UAR），也有人称其为内部可疑活动报告（SAR）。但术语选择至关重要，特别是在 那些要求必须向监管机构报告异常活动的司法管辖区。因此，务必掌握所在机构的正确报 告名称并严格使用。在记录过程中，切忌随意使用“异常”或“可疑”等表述。部分司法 管辖区对金融机构提交可疑活动报告的时间有明确规定，具体要求取决于可疑活动被判定 的时间节点。 根据调查结果，MLRO 可能会向该国金融情报单位（FIU）提交特别访问请求 （SAR），以便执法部门获取相关信息。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 344 Suspicious activity escalation process If investigators have completed the research and identified risk indicators that cannot be mitigated, they might need to escalate this customer for additional investigation. Depending on the jurisdiction and organizational policies, the end result might be filing a SAR to the FIU. Based on the organization's processes, one or more additional people might review the research before choosing whether to file a report with authorities. The internal process used to escalate findings is important—and can have legal and regulatory consequences. It is important to know the policy and process well. Throughout their research, investigators have been relying on the work and support of others. Some might have done previous research, perhaps when preparing a customer profile or researching previous transaction alerts. Some might have provided the information they personally know about the customer. Investigators filtered, organized, and prioritized. They relied on all of those sources and adequately documented the case. Now others will collaborate in the decision regarding next steps. Because each jurisdiction and organization is unique, the roles of people involved and the processes they use will differ. Failing to follow the process carefully can lead to legal and regulatory consequences. So, ask, learn, and move thoughtfully. One potential next step is to file an internal escalation report. This has many names. Some call it an unusual activity report (UAR). Some call it an internal SAR. But language is important, especially in jurisdictions where any unusual activity must be reported to authorities. So, learn the correct report name for the organization and use only that name. Don’t be casual in referring to something as "unusual" or "suspicious", especially when documenting. Some jurisdictions have timing requirements for when a financial institution should file a SAR based on when it was determined to be suspicious. Based on the investigative results, the MLRO might file a SAR with the country’s FIU, so law enforcement can gain access to the information.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第345页 记录你的研究 为证明组织已开展有效研究以防范金融犯罪，建立审计追踪体系至关重要。这意味着需要完 整记录团队为向审计师及监管机构展示合规措施所采取的所有步骤，并详细说明如何解决数 据不准确或错误匹配问题。部分记录可能较为直接，例如某数据源因年代久远而可靠性较 低。应根据组织档案保存政策，通过PDF文档、纸质打印或其他方式留存记录。完善的文档 记录能为组织的风险管控策略提供有力支撑。即便未能完整采集所有相关信息，整个流程本 身仍具备可追溯性。完成记录后，必须妥善存储研究资料以确保隐私保护和数据安全，严格 遵守相关法律法规。 内部审计师、监管机构及执法部门可对已记录的调查结果进行审查，且执法部门 可在法庭上引用这些证据。 在研究实施时记录研究过程至关重要。今日进行的检索结果可能与数月前执行检索时的结果 存在显著差异，尤其是在决策受到质疑的情况下。即使检索未产生目标或相关匹配项，也应 记录相应的日期和时间戳。 需记录搜索字符串、逻辑及关键词。有时生成搜索结果的方法与逻辑与结果本身同等重要。 文档记录有助于证明团队遵循了基于风险的方法论。 需充分了解数据隐私法规与数据安全协议。某些研究工具、数据库及方法可能在一个机构 中被认可，但在其他机构或司法管辖区可能不被接受。应建立规范流程，在信息收集过程 中对研究进行文档记录，以确保数据完整无遗漏。制定研究笔记与标准化模板可提高所需 信息被完整采集的概率。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 345 Documenting your research To demonstrate that an organization has undertaken appropriate research to prevent financial crime, it is important to create an audit trail. This means documenting all steps the team has taken to demonstrate compliance efforts to auditors and the supervisory authorities. Include how any inaccuracies or false matches were resolved. Some of this will be straightforward, as one source may be older and therefore less reliable than another source. Save documentation as PDFs, printed out, or collected in some other manner according to the organization’s record retention policy. Thorough documentation provides a record to support your organization’s risk-based approach. So, even if you fail to capture every relevant piece of information, the process itself is defensible. Once documented, your research should be properly and securely stored to respect privacy laws and data security. Internal auditors, regulators, and law enforcement might review the documented findings, and law enforcement might use them in court. It is important to document the research at the time it is performed. A search today might turn up very different results than a search performed in several months, when a decision is being questioned. Even those searches that do not produce target or relevant matches should be documented with appropriate date and time stamps. Document the search strings, logic, and keywords. Sometimes the method and logic behind generating search results can be as important as the results themselves. Documentation will help demonstrate that the team has followed a risk-based approach. Be aware of data privacy laws and data security protocols. Tools, databases, and methods for research that may be acceptable for one organization may not be acceptable in another organization or jurisdiction. A process should be in place to document the research as information is collected, so nothing is lost or forgotten. Developing research notes and a standard template increases the likelihood that all required information will be captured.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第346页 提交SAR的决定 可疑活动报告（SAR）是义务方在发现可疑或潜在非法活动时必须向其金融情报单位 （FIU）提交的文件。提交SAR报告是组织反洗钱与反恐融资计划（AFC计划）的关键 环节，也是打击洗钱及恐怖主义融资活动的重要措施。 MLRO 、被提名官员或同等职务人员通常负责监督组织的AFC合规计划，并对SAR申报作出 最终决策。在决定提交SAR前，组织可能需要开展进一步研究以获取补充信息。这一需求在 SAR审核过程中尤为明显。MLRO 或指定的二级审核员会审阅SAR报告，并可能向调查人员 提出疑问，从而确保SAR叙述具有连贯性且内容充分可靠。因此，MLRO（主要责任官员） 及调查团队应制定内部调查与审核时间表，以便及时收集反馈意见并开展补充研究。 各司法管辖区均设有报告规则及提交报告的截止日期。例如，在美国，金融犯罪执法网络 （FinCEN）要求在首次警报发出后30个日历日内提交可疑活动报告（SAR）。若初步检测 未发现可疑病例且需进一步调查，则可额外允许30个日历日。但对于高风险活动，可能适用 加速备案要求，需立即上报。 当金融机构发现复杂或相互关联的可疑活动时，可能需要提交多份可疑活动报告 （SAR）。这种情况可能由多种原因导致，包括： • 多实例情况：同一个人或实体可能参与多项独立的可疑交易，这些交易无法归入单一可 疑活动报告（SAR）。每笔交易可能引发独立的警示信号，需分别进行报告。 • 协同行动机制：一个网络或由多个个人/实体组成的团体可能参与更大规模的犯罪计 划，各参与者分别执行行动的不同环节。金融机构需为每个涉案主体单独提交可疑活 动报告（SAR），以全面反映调查范围——尤其当相关活动在不同时间点被发现时。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 346 Decision to file a SAR A SAR is a document that obliged parties must file with their FIU when they detect suspicious or potentially illicit activity. Filing SARs is a key part of an organization’s AFC program and a vital element in combating money laundering and terrorism financing. The MLRO, nominated officer, or equivalent is usually the individual responsible for overseeing the organization's AFC compliance program and making the final decision on SAR filing. Before deciding to file a SAR, the organization might need to conduct further research to obtain additional information. This need becomes evident during the SAR review process. The MLRO, or designated secondary reviewer, reads the SAR and might raise questions for the investigator. This ensures the SAR narrative is cohesive and sufficiently robust. Therefore, MLROs and investigation teams should create internal investigation and review timelines that allow for feedback and additional research. Jurisdictions have reporting rules and deadlines for submitting reports. For example, in the US, FinCEN requires SARs to be filed within 30 calendar days of the initial alert. If the initial detection does not identify a suspect and further investigation is required, an additional 30 calendar days might be permitted. However, for high-risk activities, expedited filing requirements might apply, necessitating immediate reporting. When financial institutions detect complex or interconnected suspicious activities, they might need to file multiple SARs. This can occur for several reasons, including: • Multiple instances: A single individual or entity might be engaged in several distinct suspicious transactions that do not fit into a single SAR. Each transaction might raise separate red flags that warrant individual reporting. • Coordinated activities: A network or group of individuals or entities might be involved in a larger scheme, with each participant executing different parts of the operation. Financial institutions might need to file separate SARs for each individual or entity to capture the full scope of the investigation, especially if the activities are detected at different times.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第347页 • 不同司法管辖区：当可疑活动跨越州界、国界或国际边界时，金融机构可能需根据各 相关司法管辖区的具体法律规定提交多份可疑活动报告（SAR），以确保获得适当的监 管监督。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 347 • Different jurisdictions: When suspicious activities span state, national, or international borders, financial institutions might need to file multiple SARs under the specific laws of each relevant jurisdiction to ensure appropriate regulatory oversight.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第348页 调查终结与执法部门协调 引言 引言：调查结论与执法部门协调 完成调查工作并与执法部门保持有效沟通，是打击金融犯罪的关键环节。本模块将指导您如 何通过编制清晰详实的可疑活动报告（SAR），以及掌握与金融情报单位（FIU）及执法机 构沟通的技巧细节，来完善调查流程。及时上报可疑交易行为不仅能确保金融机构遵守反洗 钱法规，还能显著提升其反洗钱工作的成效。通过实践这些操作规范，您将助力所在机构成 为金融犯罪侦破、预防及打击领域的主动合作伙伴。 病例研究：报告未提交失败 2023年3月，德国联邦金融监管局（BaFin）对德意志银行股份公司处以17万欧元罚款，因其 未按时提交可疑交易报告（STR）。该行政命令具有终局性和约束力。 银行须对涉及洗钱或恐怖主义融资的可疑交易进行调查，并及时向金融情报单位（FIU）报 告。巴伐利亚金融监管局（BaFin）发现，德意志银行延迟提交证券转让协议（STRs），这 阻碍了执法部门侦破和预防犯罪的能力，导致非法活动持续时间延长。该监管机构指出
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 348 Concluding Investigations and Coordinating with Law Enforcement Introduction Introduction: Concluding investigations and coordinating with law enforcement Concluding investigations and liaising with law enforcement are critical tasks in combating financial crime. In this module, you will learn how to finalize investigations by preparing clear, comprehensive SARs and understanding the nuances in communicating with the FIU and law enforcement agencies. Reporting suspicious activity helps maintain compliance with AFC regulations and enhances the effectiveness of a financial institution’s AFC efforts. By applying these practices, you will help ensure that your organization becomes a proactive partner in detecting, preventing, and disrupting financial crimes. Case study: Failure to file report In March 2023, the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority of Germany (BaFin), fined Deutsche Bank AG €170,000 for failing to submit suspicious transaction reports (STR) on time. The administrative order was final and binding. Banks are required to investigate and promptly report suspicious transactions linked to money laundering or terrorist financing to the FIU. BaFin discovered that Deutsche Bank delayed filing STRs, which hindered law enforcement's ability to detect and prevent crime, prolonging illicit operations. The regulator

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第349页 强调及时提交STRs可使当局迅速采取行动并向执法机构传递信息。 奥地利金融监管局（BaFin）同时指出，该银行未能及时提交可疑交易报告（STRs）的行 为，对金融体系的诚信度及打击非法金融活动的整体成效具有重大影响。这种拖延行为让 犯罪分子获得了时间优势，导致非法资金在金融系统中暗流涌动且未被察觉，最终导致更 多非法所得被洗白。BaFin对德意志银行采取的执法行动，生动展现了违规行为在现实中的 严重后果。及时上报是合规经营的核心要求，对于从源头遏制金融犯罪具有关键作用。 根据FATF 建议20，金融机构（FI）必须对任何可疑交易进行调查并上报，当存在合理理由 怀疑资金系犯罪活动所得或与恐怖主义融资相关时。此类报告出于善意进行，并不构成刑事 责任。FATF 对建议20的解释性说明明确指出，所有可疑交易（包括未完成交易）均须上 报，且不考虑交易金额大小。 沃尔夫斯贝格集团在《关于可疑活动有效监测的声明》中强调，政府机构与金融机构在提 交可疑交易报告（STR）过程中需加强协作。随着金融犯罪类型不断演变，新兴技术和新 型交易方式也持续涌现。 这将带来新的挑战，使得强有力的协作比以往任何时候都更为重要。 关键要点 • 及时调查可疑交易并上报有助于打击金融犯罪。 • 延迟性证券转让（STR）对金融机构造成严重后果，阻碍执法工作，并为犯罪分子洗钱 提供便利。 • 未遵守STR报告要求可能导致经济处罚。 • 银行与监管机构之间开展强有力的合作，对于应对需要警惕的新兴威胁、技术及分类 体系至关重要。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 349 emphasized that the timely submission of STRs allows authorities to act quickly and forward information to law enforcement agencies. BaFin also stated that the bank's failure to submit STRs promptly has serious implications for the integrity of the financial sector and the broader efforts to combat illicit financial activities. This delay gave criminals the advantage of time and allowed illicit funds to flow through the financial system undetected, ultimately enabling more of the illicit profits to be laundered. BaFin’s enforcement action against Deutsche Bank highlights the real-world consequences of noncompliance. Timely reporting is a matter of compliance and is critical for preventing financial crime at its source. Under FATF Recommendation 20, financial institutions (FI) must investigate and report any suspicious transactions when there are reasonable grounds to suspect the funds are proceeds of criminal activity or linked to terrorist financing. This reporting is done in good faith and does not equate to criminal liability. FATF’s Interpretive Note to Recommendation 20 specifies that all suspicious transactions, including attempted transactions, should be reported regardless of the transaction amount. The Wolfsberg Group’s Statement on Effective Monitoring for Suspicious Activity highlights the need for closer collaboration between government agencies and financial institutions in the STR filing process. As financial crime typologies evolve, emerging technologies and new transaction methods create additional challenges, making strong cooperation more important than ever. Key takeaways • Timely investigation and reporting of suspicious transactions help combat financial crime. • Delayed STRs cause serious consequences for financial institutions, hinder law enforcement, and enable criminals to launder funds. • Noncompliance with STR reporting requirements can lead to financial penalties. • Strong cooperation between banks and authorities is essential to address emerging threats, technologies, and typologies that require vigilance.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第350页 完成调查及可疑活动报告 调查期间保护组织 执法部门、检察机关或监管机构对某组织展开调查可能出于多种原因。调查对象既可能包 括该组织的客户或员工，也可能针对组织本身。此类调查可能源于员工实施的欺诈行为， 但更常见的情况是由于该组织反洗钱（AFC）计划存在漏洞或失效所致。这些缺陷会显著 增加洗钱、恐怖主义融资及规避制裁的风险。 为降低这些风险，该组织必须建立并维持强有力的政策与程序。 企业必须明确界定并清晰传达与调查相关的职责分工。这意味着当外部机构对组织或其客 户展开调查时，全体人员都应清楚自身应尽义务。及时且全面地回应执法部门的任何问询 至关重要，否则可能给企业带来不必要的风险或损失。 同样重要的是，需明确何时应聘请外部法律顾问，例如在涉及重大、重要或严重调查的情 况下。该组织开展的调查及任何内部文件均不受律师-客户特权保护。然而，由外部法律顾 问实施的调查则可使该组织享有律师-客户特权的保护。 该组织应建立明确的流程与治理机制，设立专项委员会以监督组织对外部调查的应对工作。 委员会成员应包括法律、审计、风险及合规等领域的相关人员。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 350 Concluding an investigation and suspicious activity reporting Protecting the organization during an investigation Investigations by law enforcement, prosecutors, or regulatory authorities involving an organization can occur for various reasons. They can be against customers or employees of the organization or against the organization itself. They might result from fraud by its employees. More often, they occur because the organization has a weak or failing AFC program. Such failures increase the risk of money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions evasion. To mitigate these risks, the organization must establish and maintain strong policies and procedures. Organizations must identify and clearly communicate the roles and responsibilities related to investigations. This means when there is an external investigation into the organization or its customers, everybody should know what to do. It is important to respond quickly and completely to any law enforcement requests. Failure to do so could cause unnecessary risk or damage to the organization. It is also important to know when to engage external legal counsel, such as in large, important, or serious investigations. Investigations performed by the organization and any internal documentation would not fall under the attorney-client privilege. Investigations conducted by external legal counsel, however, would protect the organization under attorney-client privilege. The organization should have a clear process and governance for establishing ad-hoc committees overseeing the organizational response to external investigations. The committees should comprise stakeholders, such as personnel working in the areas of legal, audit, risk, and compliance.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第351页 该组织还应确保建立清晰的汇报体系、升级流程以及内部与媒体沟通机制。此类规 划将有助于避免混乱局面。 大型组织可能会开展模拟突袭行动（即未事先通知的检查），以确保流程、沟通及升级 机制正常运行。 报告义务 若金融机构怀疑客户涉嫌金融犯罪，必须依法向监管部门报告。多数国家明确规定金融机 构负有举报金融犯罪的个人责任，未履行义务者将面临罚款或监禁等法律处罚。但金融机 构通常会制定明确的政策流程，确保举报内容清晰准确，并为相关人员提供保护措施。全 球范围内，金融机构普遍设有专职反金融犯罪（AFC）项目负责人，专门处理金融犯罪举 报事务。相关职位头衔可能包括首席合规官、反贿赂与腐败专员、反洗钱专员、洗钱举报 专员、首席执行官助理、首席反洗钱合规官，或根据所在司法管辖区的具体命名规范。 在许多国家，对于未举报金融犯罪或涉嫌金融犯罪的个人，法律会施加相应处罚。处罚范围 从高额罚款到监禁不等。部分司法管辖区甚至会以“故意隐瞒”罪名起诉涉案人员，具体定 罪需综合考量交易背景及被告行为。法院将“故意隐瞒”定义为“蓄意回避事实认知”，并 认定该行为等同于明知资金非法来源或金融犯罪交易中客户的真实意图。 企业必须建立相关政策与流程，确保员工能够向指定合规专员报告可疑情况。需对员工进行 规范培训，以确保其个人及企业均能履行报告义务。指定合规专员将负责评估信息内容，并 决定需采取的应对措施。该流程可能在可疑活动升级后终止，因为合规官认为该活动或解释 已足够充分。若事实表明存在外部报告
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 351 The organization should also ensure there are clear reporting lines and processes for escalation, as well as a process for internal and press communications. This planning will help to avoid chaos. Larger organizations might conduct mock dawn raids, which are unannounced inspections, to ensure that the process, communication, and escalation lines are working. Duty to report If an organization suspects that a customer is committing financial crime, it has a duty to report it to the authorities. In many countries, there is a personal liability to report financial crime, and there are legal penalties of fines and imprisonment for failing to do so. However, an organization will have clearly defined policies and procedures to ensure reporting is clear and factual and to protect the relevant employees. Around the world, organizations appoint officers to be responsible for AFC programs and to report suspicions of financial crime. The title might be chief compliance officer, anti-bribery and corruption officer, AML officer, money laundering reporting officer, principal officer, chief anti-money laundering compliance officer, or a title reflective of the jurisdiction. In many countries, there are legal consequences for individuals who fail to report financial crime or are suspected of financial crime. These range from heavy fines to imprisonment. In some jurisdictions, an individual can be prosecuted for “willful blindness,” which will be judged on the circumstances surrounding the transaction and the defendant’s conduct. Courts define willful blindness as the “deliberate avoidance of knowledge of the facts” and have held that willful blindness is the equivalent of actual knowledge of the illegal source of funds or of the intentions of a customer in a financial crime transaction. It is important that organizations implement policies and procedures to enable staff to report their suspicions to an assigned compliance officer. Staff must be properly trained in these procedures to ensure that both they and your organization meet the duty to report requirement. The assigned compliance officer will be responsible for assessing the information and deciding what actions must be taken. The process might stop following the escalation of the potentially suspicious activity because the compliance officer considers the activity or explanation to be sufficient. If the facts indicate an external report

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第352页 若需采取行动，最常见的做法是向管辖区域的相关主管部门提交可疑活动报告。在约定时限 内完成报告，可确保个人与组织切实履行其职责。部分司法管辖区除要求报告可疑活动外， 还可能要求报告异常活动。 可疑活动报告相关法规 关于可疑活动报告（SAR）或可疑交易报告（STR）的提交规定因机构和司法管辖区而 异，但普遍要求调查人员遵守时限要求并限制信息获取渠道。SAR的提交必须及时有效。 警报生成后即可立即启动调查程序。一旦发现可疑活动，即刻启动报告流程，且必须在监 管机构规定时限内提交SAR。SAR中包含的信息无需证明存在非法活动，但必须阐明将该 活动认定为可疑的具体依据。严重事故报告（SAR）不得在金融机构外部及法定执法机构 之间共享，否则可能影响调查工作的开展。即使在金融机构内部，SAR的处理也需谨慎， 因为并非所有人员都应有权获取此类信息。 可疑活动报告（SAR）的监管规定因司法管辖区而异，但普遍遵循相似的法律框架和要求。 常见规定要求调查人员在怀疑存在犯罪活动时建议提交SAR报告，需以事实依据支持调查假 设，并避免向客户或其他未经授权方泄露SAR信息。在欧洲，欧盟反洗钱指令与FATF 建议 保持一致。美国则依据《银行保密法》规定了提交SAR的义务。当发现或怀疑某人涉及洗 钱、恐怖主义融资或其他犯罪活动时，应立即建议提交SAR报告。根据美国法律规定，可疑 活动发现后30个自然日内必须提交SAR报告，若无法锁定嫌疑人，可申请延长30个自然日的 期限。 然而，各司法管辖区具有不同的报告要求，这些要求从“在合理可行的情况下”到“在确 立怀疑后特定天数内”不等。可疑活动报告（SAR）中的信息必须符合要求。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 352 must be made, the most usual action is the submission of a suspicious activity report to the relevant authority in the jurisdiction. Reporting within agreed timelines ensures that the individual and the organization effectively discharge their responsibilities. Some jurisdictions may require unusual activities to be reported, in addition to those that are deemed suspicious. Regulations related to suspicious activity reporting The regulations for filing a suspicious activity report (SAR) or suspicious transaction report (STR) vary by institution and jurisdiction, but there are common regulations throughout that call for investigators to follow timelines and limit information access. SAR filing must be timely and effective. As soon as the alert is generated, the investigation can start. Once an activity is deemed suspicious, the reporting timeline begins, and a SAR must be filed within the timelines set by the regulator. The information included in the SAR does not need to demonstrate the occurrence of illegal activity, but it does need to demonstrate the reason for identifying the activity as suspicious. A SAR should not be shared outside the financial institution and required law enforcement agencies, as this could compromise the investigation. Even within a financial institution, SARs should be handled with care, as not everyone should have access to such information. SAR regulations vary by jurisdiction, but all have similar laws and requirements. Common regulations call for investigators to recommend a SAR upon suspicion of criminal activity, use factual information to support suspicions, and avoid "tipping off" or disclosing a SAR to the customer or other unauthorized parties. In Europe, the EU AML directives align with FATF recommendations. In the US, the obligation to file a SAR derives from the Bank Secrecy Act. You should recommend a SAR as soon as you suspect, or know, that a person is engaged in money laundering, terrorist financing, or other criminal activity. In the US, a SAR must be filed within 30 calendar days of the detection of suspicious activity, with the possibility of a 30-calendar-day extension in cases where no suspect can be identified. However, each jurisdiction has its own reporting requirements, which vary from “when reasonably possible” to a specific number of days after suspicion has been established. The information in a SAR must be appropriate,

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第353页 报告内容必须完整且基于事实。您需要提供客户信息、金融机构提供的服务、交易活动记 录、可疑行为的成因分析以及所有支持性证据。虽然无需提供完整的犯罪证据来证明犯罪事 实，但必须提供证据说明为何该行为被认定为可疑。根据法规要求，金融机构不得向非指定 执法机构披露可疑交易报告（SAR）或任何可能表明已提交SAR的信息。向客户泄露SAR内 容将构成“举报协助”违法行为。未及时提交SAR可能导致金融机构面临巨额罚款、监管限 制甚至监禁等处罚。请务必遵守所在司法管辖区的法规要求，因各地法规存在差异。 可疑活动报告结构 可疑活动报告（SAR）是向执法部门通报可疑活动的主要方式。完成可疑交易报告（SAR） 需收集所有涉事方信息，包括姓名、出生日期、住址、税务识别号或国民身份证号码及联 系电话。应详细记录可疑交易日期与相关凭证，包含分支机构员工报告、ATM机交易视频 及重要纸质文件影像资料。 SAR表格需提供以下信息： • 备案机构 • 可疑活动发生地点，例如分支机构 • 调节器 • 执法部门调查期间使用的联络点 叙述部分——即对可疑活动的书面描述——是可疑活动报告（SAR）最重要的组成部 分。其包含引言段、背景段、交易段及结论段。 该组织将制定符合金融情报单位（FIU）及其监管机构要求的可疑活动报告（SAR）归 档政策、流程及程序。 严格遵守相关标准并准确填写所有必填项，对于向执法部门通报您所发现和调查的可疑 交易及潜在犯罪活动至关重要。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 353 complete, and factual. You should include information about the customer, services offered by the institution, transaction activity, rationale for suspicions, and any supporting evidence. You do not need to supply complete evidence to demonstrate the crime occurrence, but you do need evidence to support why the activity has been deemed suspicious. Regulations prohibit financial institutions from disclosing a SAR, or any information that would indicate a SAR was filed, to anyone except certain law enforcement agencies. Disclosing the SAR or its contents to a customer would result in a prohibited offense called "tipping off." Failure to file a SAR can lead to substantial penalties for the financial institution, including fines, regulatory restrictions, or even imprisonment. Make sure you follow the regulations in your jurisdiction, as regulations vary. Suspicious activity report structure The suspicious activity report (SAR) is the primary method of communicating suspicious activity to law enforcement. Completing the SAR requires gathering information about all parties involved, including names, birthdates, addresses, tax identification numbers or national identification numbers, and phone numbers. Include dates and documentation of the suspicious activity, reports from branch staff, video from automated teller machines, and images of relevant paper items. The SAR form requires information about: • The filing institution • The suspicious activity location, such as the branch • The regulator • A point of contact for law enforcement’s use during an investigation The narrative—a written description of the suspicious activity—is the most important part of the SAR. It includes the introduction, background, transaction, and conclusion paragraphs. The organization will develop policies, processes, and procedures for filing SARs consistent with the requirements set by the FIU and its regulator. Compliance with these standards and accurately completing all required fields are crucial for communicating to law enforcement the suspicious transactions and possible criminal activities you identified and investigated.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第354页 SAR表格首先要求填写报告类型（初始或持续性）及提交步骤。机构通常会提供内部控制编 号，该编号可用于执法部门参考，以及后续在数据库中定位文件或为持续性活动提交SAR报 告。表格还需包含涉及受试者的人口统计学信息。若受试者身份不明，应在SAR表格及叙述 段落中明确说明该情况。 该组织应提供关于主要监管机构及活动地点（包括分支机构、总部办公室、自动取款机或 多个地点）的相关信息。SAR（安全评估报告）应在表格及叙述部分包含主要病例调查员 的姓名及联系方式。 完成SAR报告的人员应注明与执法部门的任何接触情况。若组织在收到传票或判决书 后提交SAR报告，该报告应明确指定签发执法机构。 SAR（病例报告系统）最重要的组成部分是叙述部分，该部分回答了病例的“谁、什么、哪 里、何时、为什么以及如何”等核心问题。引言句（或称影响陈述）旨在促使执法部门采取 行动或作出回应，是叙述结构的关键要素。 案例示例：家族信托的SAR分析 北岸银行市中心分行发现公民家庭信托账户存在异常交易活动，包括在三周内累计提取数百 万美元的大额资金。这些交易目的不明且与客户常规操作模式不符。巨额快速提款行为叠加 高风险资金来源（或称暴利来源），提示可能存在洗钱嫌疑。客户申报的财富来源与账户行 为存在明显矛盾。该机构此前从未针对该客户提交过可疑交易报告（SAR）。 该MLRO 收集的信息将纳入初始SAR报告中： • 客户姓名及出生日期：Lola Citizen 1965年3月25日出生；Malik Citizen 1964年1月15 日出生 • 地址、电话号码 • 税号
