items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 450 strategies, and explainability metrics to demonstrate compliance with AML regulations. Proper documentation ensures transparency, regulatory adherence, and defensibility in case of scrutiny from regulators, auditors, or legal authorities. A well-documented governance framework helps institutions detect, report, and adapt to evolving money laundering risks in an increasingly complex financial environment.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第451页 调查技术 辅助调查技术 下表汇总了各类技术解决方案： 技术解决方案 描述 可视化 • 识别模式 • 检测异常 • 网络暴露 • 映射关系 社会网络分析 • 识别关系，核心人物 • 揭示活动簇 网络分析 • 检测异常交易模式 • 基于共同特征对个体和实体进行分组 开放源代码解决方案 • 提供以下访问权限： o 不良媒体的公开来源 o 政府维护的观察名单 • 启用初始尽职调查
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 451 Technology for investigations Technology to assist investigation The table below summarizes different categories of technology solutions: Technology solution Description Visualization • Identifies patterns • Detects anomalies • Uncovers networks • Maps relationships Social network analysis • Identifies relationships, central figures • Uncovers activity clusters Network analysis • Detects unusual transaction patterns • Groups individuals and entities based on shared characteristics Open-source solution • Provides access to: o Public sources of adverse media o Government-maintained watch lists • Enables initial due diligence

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第452页 基于订阅的解决方案 • 整合全球媒体报道 • 提供自动化风险评估 • 提高调查效率 公开可用的监控清单可提供基础合规性核查功能。付费解决方案将筛查机制深度整合到案 件管理流程中，具备实时风险评分与持续监测能力。基于人工智能的监控工具（尤其是企 业级解决方案中的产品）能检测金融交易中的异常行为模式，自动标记高风险操作以供后 续审查。虽然免费工具可辅助调查工作，但付费方案在风险识别方面具有更强的扩展性、 自动化程度及精准度优势。 确定调查中的自动化程度需要在机器驱动效率与人工监督之间取得平衡。例如，自动化交 易监控系统会标记异常活动，但必须由人工分析师对警报进行审核验证，以避免误报。 自动化技术通过优先处理高风险病例来简化调查流程，但过度依赖机器生成的输出结果可能 导致忽视仅能通过人工判断评估的背景因素。反之，完全依赖人工调查则效率低下且资源消 耗巨大。采用平衡策略，通过技术手段自动化重复性任务，同时保留专家对最终决策的监 督，可确保准确性、合规性及风险管控效果。金融犯罪调查团队通过整合免费与订阅制调查 工具，既能优化工作流程，又能提升合规监管水平。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 452 Subscription-based solution • Aggregates global media coverage • Offers automated risk assessments • Enhances investigative efficiency Publicly available watchlists offer basic compliance checks. Paid solutions integrate screening into case management workflows with real-time risk scoring and ongoing monitoring. AI-driven monitoring tools, particularly those in enterprise solutions, detect behavioral anomalies in financial transactions, flagging high-risk activities for further review. While free tools can support investigative efforts, paid solutions provide scalability, automation, and enhanced accuracy in risk identification. Deciding the level of automation in an investigation requires balancing machine-driven efficiency with human oversight. For example, automated transaction monitoring systems flag unusual activity, but human analysts must review and validate alerts to avoid false positives. Automation streamlines investigations by prioritizing high-risk cases, but overreliance on machine-generated outputs can overlook contextual factors that only human judgment can assess. Conversely, fully manual investigations are inefficient and resource intensive. A balanced approach, using technology to automate repetitive tasks while maintaining expert oversight for final decisions, ensures accuracy, compliance, and effective risk mitigation. By combining free and subscription-based investigative tools, financial crime teams can optimize their workflows and enhance regulatory compliance efforts.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第453页 交易监测中的网络分析解决方案 在网络分析技术应用于AML（反洗钱）监管工作中，可为交易监控提供多项显著优势。网 络分析是一套用于描绘参与者间关系并分析这些关联重复性的技术手段。例如，假设客户 A每次收到大额存款时，与其无关联的客户X总会通过不同账户进行多次交易，且每次接收 金额相同。 在网络分析技术的应用中，我们可以精准锁定需要深入调查的关键关联节点。这种技术不仅 能有效识别异常行为模式和可疑集群，还能实现实时数据分析功能，使调查人员能够及时监 测并应对新出现的威胁。通过综合考量交易行为的整体背景而非孤立分析，网络分析能为金 融活动提供全景式洞察。更重要的是，通过精准绘制关系网络图谱，该技术可有效降低误报 率，从而优化调查流程并提升资源配置效率。这一全面视角有助于组织机构全面了解潜在洗 钱活动的全部范围。 网络分析通过自动化收集内部及外部数据点，大幅减少了人工调查环节。该技术能有效识 别可疑交易模式，例如快速高频交易、资金循环流动或为规避报告阈值而设计的结构化存款 等洗钱活动迹象。同时，它还能通过分析客户关系网及社交金融互动建立关联，从而强化客 户尽职调查（CDD）能力，精准识别与高风险个人或实体的潜在联系。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 453 Network analysis solutions for transaction monitoring Network analysis in AML efforts offers several significant advantages for transaction monitoring. Network analysis refers to a set of techniques that depicts relationships among actors and analyzes the recurrence of these connections. For example, imagine that every time Customer A receives a large deposit, Customer X, who is unrelated to Customer A, always receives the same amount but through multiple transactions from different accounts. Network analysis in this scenario could identify the link for further investigation. Network analysis makes it easier to identify irregular patterns or suspicious clusters. It enables real-time analysis, allowing investigators to promptly monitor and respond to emerging threats. It also provides a holistic view of financial activities by considering the broader context of transactions rather than evaluating them in isolation. Finally, by accurately mapping relationships and interactions, network analysis helps reduce false positives, streamlining investigative efforts and resource allocation. This comprehensive perspective helps organizations understand the full scope of potential money laundering schemes. By automating the collection of internal and external data points, network analysis reduces manual investigation steps. It helps identify suspicious transaction patterns that might indicate money laundering activities such as rapid, high-volume transactions, circular money flows, or structured deposits designed to evade reporting thresholds. It also enhances CDD by building connections via customer relationships and social and financial interactions to reveal associations with high-risk individuals or entities.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第454页 网络分析技术能揭示看似无关实体间的隐性关联，并将其整合为直观易懂的网络结构。该技 术可揭示传统监控手段可能忽略的复杂风险机制。金融机构可运用这些分析能力，主动识别 潜在风险并完善反洗钱合规体系。 然而，在反洗钱（AML）调查中实施网络分析存在诸多挑战。金融机构需解决数据准确性问 题，整合分散的数据源，并运用先进分析工具处理大规模交易数据。同时，需要专业分析师 来解读复杂的网络结构并提炼可操作性分析结论。 将网络分析技术融入反洗钱策略，是打击金融犯罪的重要优势。通过深入解析交易关系与 模式，金融机构可获得有效预防和侦测洗钱活动所需的工具。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 454 Network analysis uncovers hidden relationships between seemingly unrelated entities and compiles them into easy-to-understand networks. This exposes complex schemes that traditional monitoring methods might overlook. Financial institutions can use these capabilities to proactively address potential risks and strengthen their AML compliance frameworks. However, implementing network analysis in AML investigations presents challenges. Financial institutions must address issues related to data accuracy, integrate disparate data sources, and use advanced analytical tools to process large-scale transaction data. Skilled analysts are needed to interpret complex network structures and derive actionable insights. Integrating network analysis into AML strategies represents a significant advantage in combating financial crimes. By providing a deeper understanding of transactional relationships and patterns, it equips financial institutions with the tools necessary to prevent and detect money laundering activities more effectively.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第455页 辅助病例管理的技术 技术强化了全球反洗钱合规框架，尤其在案件管理领域。现代反洗钱解决方案采用基于网 络的平台架构，可集中管理客户与账户数据，满足KYC 监管要求并支持风险评估。这些系 统整合多源信息，实现风险评级自动化，实时监控客户动态，并使调查人员能快速获取数 据。 这些平台内置的案件管理工具通过实时追踪可疑活动、标记高风险交易、整理案件档案以满 足监管报告要求，显著提升了调查效率。通过整合高级分析技术和机器学习算法，系统实现 了数据驱动的风险评估流程，有效降低了误报率，使合规团队能够集中精力处理真正可疑的 案件。这些工具通过减少调查人员手动筛选数据的需求，大幅缩短了数据整理与汇总所需时 间，从而让案件管理工作变得更加高效。 此外，现有工具可用于帮助管理病例的整个生命周期。这些工具包括用于自动化工作 流程、促进协作、追踪病例状态与进展，以及管理文档存储、检索与检索功能的工 具。 这些平台通过自动化生成SAR报告流程并确保合规措施有充分文档记录以应对审计审查， 从而有效提升监管合规性。与现有合规系统无缝对接，使金融机构能在保持反洗钱策略一 致性的同时避免运营中断。 从调查工作的角度来看，现代案件管理工具通过系统化整理风险相关情报、消除信息孤岛 和部门壁垒，显著提升了决策效率。调查人员可借助标准化工作流程高效推进案件处理。 自动化流程确保合规团队能精准调配资源，使其能够集中精力处理高优先级案件，减少不 必要的人工复核环节。内置的协作工具有效促进合规团队间的沟通协调，为复杂调查工作 提供有力支持。 随着金融犯罪手段不断演变，运用先进的案件管理技术不仅能确保合规性、降低运营风 险，还能有效强化机构防范金融犯罪的能力。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 455 Technology to assist case management Technology strengthens global AML compliance frameworks, particularly in case management. Modern AML solutions are web-based platforms that centralize customer and account data, supporting KYC requirements and risk assessments. These systems consolidate information from various sources, automate risk ratings, monitor ongoing customer activity, and allow investigators to access data more quickly. Case management tools within these platforms streamline investigations by tracking suspicious activities, flagging high-risk transactions, and organizing case files for regulatory reporting. Integrating advanced analytics and machine learning ensures data-driven risk assessment processes, reduces false positives, and enables compliance teams to focus on genuinely suspicious cases. These tools make the management of cases more efficient by reducing the need for investigators to manually sort through data, reducing the time required to collate and assemble such data. Additionally, tools are available to help manage cases throughout their life cycle. These include tools to automate workflows, facilitate collaboration, track case status and progress, and manage the storage, searching, and retrieval of documentation. These platforms also improve regulatory compliance by automating the process to produce SARs and ensuring that compliance actions are sufficiently documented to withstand the scrutiny of an audit. Seamless integration with existing compliance systems helps financial institutions maintain consistency in their AML strategies without operational disruptions. From an investigative standpoint, modern case management tools optimize decision-making by organizing risk-related insights systematically, eliminating silos and information islands. Investigators can efficiently escalate cases through defined workflows. Automating processes ensures that compliance teams allocate resources effectively. This allows them to focus on high- priority cases and reduce unnecessary manual reviews. Built-in collaboration tools facilitate communication among compliance teams, improving coordination in complex investigations. As financial crime tactics evolve, leveraging sophisticated case management technology ensures regulatory compliance, reduces operational risks, and strengthens institutional defenses against financial crime.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第456页 区块链溯源技术 区块链溯源技术助力企业与监管机构打击非法金融活动。分布式账本技术是一种去中心化安 全数据库系统，多方参与者无需中央机构即可共享访问权限，其中区块链技术是最具代表性 的形式。该技术能为交易行为提供透明且不可篡改的记录，这种记录的确定性既是优势也是 隐患，尤其对企图利用数字资产从事非法活动的犯罪分子而言。 虽然区块链交易具有匿名性，但受监管的数字资产平台和货币代理机构需要KYC 验证。这 使得监管机构能够将区块链地址与现实身份关联起来，同时帮助金融机构和监管机构追踪可 疑交易并有效执行合规措施。 犯罪分子采用隐私增强工具、混合服务及跨链转账等复杂技术手段，以掩盖非法资金的 来源与去向。此类技术需要先进的区块链追踪技术支持。为追踪数字资产流动情况，企 业可采用创新性区块链分析解决方案，包括： • 链上分析技术通过分析直接交易数据，涵盖钱包地址、交易记录及智能合约交互等信 息。 • 离链分析技术通过整合监管申报文件、社交媒体活动及暗网情报等外部数据源，可 更全面地识别可疑行为。 • 先进的机器学习算法可帮助识别与洗钱及制裁规避相关的交易模式，并对高风险活动进 行标记以供进一步调查。 这些技术使研究人员能够追踪数字资产交易，即使资金被分割为更小金额并分散在多个钱 包或区块链网络中。 随着涉及数字资产的金融犯罪迅速演变且日趋复杂，区块链溯源技术的发展速度几乎与 之同步。犯罪分子不断开发新的系统利用方法，但数据分析技术
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 456 Technology for blockchain tracing Blockchain tracing technology helps organizations and regulators in the fight against illicit financial activities. Distributed ledger technology is a decentralized secure database system in which multiple participants share access without a central authority. Blockchain is its most prominent form. This technology provides a transparent and immutable record of transactions. This certainty of record is both a strength and a weakness, particularly for criminals attempting to exploit digital assets for illicit purposes. While blockchain transactions are pseudonymous, regulated digital asset platforms and currency agents require KYC verification. This allows authorities to link blockchain addresses to real-world identities. It also enables financial institutions and regulatory bodies to trace suspicious transactions and enforce compliance measures effectively. Criminals use sophisticated techniques such as privacy-enhancing tools, mixing services, and cross-chain transfers to obscure the origins and destinations of illicit funds. These techniques require advanced blockchain tracing technologies. To track digital asset movements, organizations could use innovative blockchain analytics solutions, including: • On-chain analytics, which examine direct transaction data, including wallet addresses, transaction histories, and smart contract interactions. • Off-chain analytics, which integrate external sources such as regulatory filings, social media activity, and dark web intelligence to provide a more comprehensive view of suspicious behavior. • Advanced machine learning algorithms, which help detect transaction patterns associated with money laundering and sanctions evasion, flagging high-risk activities for further investigation. These technologies enable investigators to follow digital asset transactions, even when funds are fragmented into smaller amounts and dispersed across multiple wallets or blockchain networks. As financial crimes involving digital assets rapidly evolve and become more sophisticated, blockchain tracing technology continues to evolve almost as rapidly. items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第457页 为识别和解密非法资金流动，相关解决方案正持续优化升级。 全球范围内，监管机构强制要求金融机构采取交易监控、风险评估及信息共享框架等合规 措施，以确保其有效降低风险。通过将区块链溯源技术融入合规体系，金融机构与监管机构 能够提升透明度、更高效地识别可疑交易行为，并在数字化经济日益发展的背景下维护金融 系统的完整性。 报告技术 AML（反洗钱）与制裁合规工作对执法机构及涉事个人均构成重大民事与刑事责任。若缺乏 完整记录，再周密的合规措施也无法形成有效证据。该原则强调必须对所有反洗钱相关流程 （包括交易监控、调查及报告机制）进行详尽文档化管理。金融机构及其从业人员应确保 为识别、调查及报告可疑活动所采取的每一步措施均得到充分记录，以证明合规性并避免 潜在法律后果。 鉴于金融交易规模庞大且监管要求严苛，建立有效的报告机制是证明反洗钱（AML）合规 性及制裁合规性的关键要求。若缺乏结构化文件支持，合规计划可能无法向监管机构提供尽 职调查所需的必要证据。为此，金融机构采用 通过案例管理系统和高级报表功能实现数据量管理，助力合规团队高效追踪、分析及记录 案件信息。 大多数报告技术已集成于交易监控解决方案套件中。但当前部分解决方案专注于工作流与 案例管理功能，可替代或补充现有系统中缺失的这些要素。自动化系统能处理海量数据 集、识别异常情况并生成合规报告，既可降低人工操作强度，又能确保符合监管要求。这 些技术解决方案还可帮助机构最大限度减少错误、提高效率，并增强其合规工作的透明 度。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 457 solutions are continuously improving to identify and de-anonymize illicit financial flows. Globally, regulatory bodies mandate compliance measures such as transaction monitoring, risk assessment, and information-sharing frameworks to ensure financial institutions mitigate risks effectively. By integrating blockchain tracing technologies into compliance frameworks, organizations and regulators can enhance transparency, detect suspicious activity more efficiently, and protect the integrity of financial systems in an increasingly digital economy. Technology for reporting AML and sanctions compliance carry significant civil and criminal legal liabilities for organizations and individuals responsible for enforcement. Without proper records, even the most diligent compliance efforts cannot be evidenced. This principle emphasizes the importance of maintaining thorough documentation of all AFC-related processes, including transaction monitoring, investigations, and reporting. Financial institutions and their employees should ensure that every step taken to identify, investigate, and report suspicious activities is well documented to demonstrate regulatory adherence and avoid potential legal consequences. Given the massive scale of financial transactions and regulatory requirements, maintaining effective reporting mechanisms is a significant requirement in demonstrating AML and sanctions compliance. Without structured documentation, compliance programs might fail to provide regulators with necessary evidence of due diligence. To address this, financial institutions use case management systems and advanced reporting to manage data volumes, helping compliance teams efficiently track, analyze, and document cases. Most reporting technologies are included in transaction monitoring solution packages. However, some solutions now focus exclusively on workflow and case management, either replacing or supplementing existing systems that lack these elements. Automated systems process large datasets, detect anomalies, and generate compliance reports. This reduces manual effort while ensuring regulatory expectation compliance. These technological solutions also help institutions minimize errors, improve efficiency, and enhance transparency in their compliance efforts.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第458页 众多反洗钱及制裁合规解决方案将报表功能深度整合至客户数据库与交易监控系统中。这 种无缝集成机制确保解决方案能系统化记录警报事件、案件进展、调查过程及监管报告。 通过自动化处理与集中管理合规记录，这些方案为监管机构提供了清晰的审计追踪路径， 使金融机构能够快速应对问询与法律审查。联合国开发的goAML创新性报表解决方案，为 金融机构提供了标准化平台，用于收集、分析并共享反洗钱相关报告。 机构在决定通过报表解决方案增强现有系统时，需综合评估多重因素。考量要点包括：监管 要求的复杂性、现有系统的可扩展性、对工作流管理优化的需求，以及部署独立报表系统与 升级现有平台的成本效益分析。 随着监管要求持续演变，金融机构应善用技术手段记录合规措施，以降低风险、保障员工安 全并维护金融体系的完整性。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 458 Many AML and sanctions compliance solutions integrate reporting features within customer databases and transaction monitoring systems. This seamless integration ensures that the solutions systematically document alerts, cases, investigations, and regulatory reports. By automating and centralizing compliance records, these solutions provide a clear audit trail for regulators. This enables institutions to respond swiftly to inquiries and legal scrutiny. The UN developed goAML, an innovative reporting solution, which provides a standardized platform for FIUs to collect, analyze, and share AML- related reports. Institutions should evaluate various factors when deciding to augment existing systems with a reporting solution. Considerations include the complexity of regulatory requirements, scalability of current systems, need for enhanced workflow management, and cost-benefit analysis of implementing standalone reporting solutions versus upgrading existing platforms. As regulatory expectations continue to evolve, financial institutions should leverage technology to document compliance efforts to mitigate risk, protect their employees, and uphold the integrity of the financial system.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第459页 数据收集与准备 引言 引言：数据收集与准备 AFC合规系统日趋复杂且效能提升，对数据质量改进的需求持续增长。本模块明确指出， 数据治理、数据准备、数据管理及质量控制是金融犯罪合规系统的核心要素。内部与外部 数据源在合规系统上线部署、风险筛查及实时监控环节中发挥着关键作用。本模块系统阐 述了企业内部数据迁移与利用的技术方案及工具应用。通过验证与测试流程可有效识别异 常数据，确保数据完整性、准确性、完整性和一致性。同时深入解析提升数据可靠性、支 持监管合规要求以及优化金融犯罪检测系统所需的关键流程。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 459 Data Collection and Preparation Introduction Introduction: Data collection and preparation AFC compliance systems have become more complex and effective, increasing the demand for improved data. As this module shows, data governance, preparation, management, and quality control are essential in financial crime compliance systems. Internal and external data sources play key roles in compliance onboarding, screening, and monitoring. This module covers the techniques and tools for moving and using data within the organization. Validation and testing processes help detect anomalies and maintain data integrity, accuracy, completeness, and consistency. This module also examines the processes needed to enhance data reliability, support regulatory compliance, and optimize financial crime detection systems.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第460页 案例示例：为新TM系统识别数据 某中型银行金融犯罪分析师莎拉受委托为新交易监控系统（TM系统）确定所需数据。该系 统旨在有效识别可疑交易行为，同时兼顾操作可行性与监管要求。 她将核心交易数据视为关键要素，包括客户账号、交易时间戳、交易金额、交易对手方 及地理位置信息。随后，莎拉会与合规部门及IT团队协作，评估有助于风险识别的客户 画像数据，具体涵盖客户风险评级、账户类型、预期交易行为模式及历史交易记录等维 度。 随后，Sarah审阅了最新的年度风险评估报告，以识别TM系统需控制的风险。她通过产品风 险评估确保全面掌握所有产品的反洗钱（AML）风险。接着，她将TM系统现有场景与风险 进行映射分析，以评估风险覆盖范围，并确定可能需要补充的其他场景。 每种特定风险均具有与相应数据点相匹配的属性，这些数据点构成了TM系统的基础。以快 速资金转账这类风险为例，需要采集包括入站与出站支付时间戳在内的数据点，并根据风 险特征设定可接受阈值、交易金额阈值，以及基于不同风险特征的金额阈值。必要时，她 会将这些数据补充至现有的核心交易数据和客户风险特征数据中。 随后，Sarah着手筛选补充数据源以优化警报系统并提升调查效率。她考虑纳入媒体负面筛 查记录、PEP（预防性执行程序）状态及SAR（可疑交易报告）备案数据，并探索整合行 为指标——例如客户交易规模或交易频率的异常波动等特征。 不过，莎拉明白数据筛选绝非简单增加变量就能解决。她深知不应将这个过程当作机械清 单来操作，而应与已识别的风险和现有数据保持一致。她需要评估银行是否能持续稳定地 获取各数据集、是否符合隐私保护和监管要求，以及是否契合银行的具体风险特征。同时 还要考量数据与现有系统是否兼容。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 460 Case example: Identify data for a new TM system Sarah, a financial crime analyst at a mid-sized bank, has been asked to identify data needed for a new TM system. The goal is to ensure the system effectively detects suspicious activity while balancing operational feasibility and regulatory requirements. She identifies core transactional data as essential components, including customer account numbers, transaction time stamps, amounts, counterparties, and geographic locations. Sarah then consults with compliance and IT teams to assess customer profile information that can enhance risk detection. This includes customer risk ratings, account types, expected transaction behaviors, and historical activity. Next, Sarah reviews the latest annual risk assessment to identify risks that the TM systems should control. She conducts a product risk assessment to ensure that the AML risks of all products are understood. She then maps the existing scenarios of the TM system against the risks to examine coverage and to understand what additional scenarios may be needed. Each specific risk has attributes that match corresponding data points that form the foundation of the TM system. For example, a risk such as rapid fund transfers requires data points, including inbound and outbound payment time stamps, acceptable thresholds based on risk profiles, transaction amounts, and thresholds for amounts based on different risk profiles. Where necessary, she adds these to available core transactional and customer risk profile data. Sarah then identifies supplemental data sources to refine alerts and improve investigative efficiency. She considers including data on adverse media screenings, PEP status, and SAR filings. She also explores integrating behavioral indicators, such as sudden deviations from a customer's usual transaction size or velocity. However, Sarah understands that selecting data is not just about adding more variables. She knows she should avoid treating this process as a checklist. This process should align with the identified risks and available data. She evaluates whether the bank has consistent, reliable access to each dataset, whether it meets privacy and regulatory requirements, and whether it aligns with the bank’s specific risks. She also assesses the data’s compatibility with existing

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第461页 格式与系统的处理能力。这确保了额外数据字段在增强检测效果的同时，不会过度消耗资源 或产生过多假阳性结果。 通过采用基于风险的数据筛选方法，Sarah确保新交易管理系统（TM系统）兼具高效性与有 效性，在满足银行合规要求的同时，能够智能利用现有数据资源。 关键要点 • 确定新贸易管理系统（TM系统）的数据以检测可疑活动，同时平衡运营与监 管要求。 • 关键数据源包括核心交易数据、客户档案信息、与数据点匹配的风险属性以及补充数 据。 来源 • 审查最新风险评估报告，以将特定风险与相应数据点进行匹配。 • 开展产品风险评估，并识别现有场景未涵盖的任何缺陷。 • 确保数据与已识别风险保持一致，符合隐私保护及监管标准，具备可访问性，并与系 统处理能力相匹配，以避免资源过度负荷或产生过多假阳性结果。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 461 formats and the system’s processing capacity. This ensures that additional data fields enhance detection without overwhelming resources or generating excessive false positives. By taking a risk-based approach to data selection, Sarah ensures that the new TM system is both effective and efficient, aligning with the bank’s compliance needs while leveraging available data intelligently. Key takeaways • Identify data for new TM systems to detect suspicious activity while balancing operational and regulatory requirements. • Key data sources include core transactional data, customer profile information, risk attributes matched to data points, and supplemental data sources. • Review the latest risk assessment to match specific risks with corresponding data points. • Conduct a product risk assessment and identify any gaps that existing scenarios do not cover. • Ensure the data is aligned with identified risks, meets privacy and regulatory standards, is accessible, and fits the system’s processing capacity to avoid overwhelming resources or generating excessive false positives.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第462页 数据作为解决方案的输入 了解您的数据 合规系统需要特定类型的数据才能正常运行。 数据必须与组织正在缓解的合规风险相关。每项风险均需设定相应的控制措施，且每项控制 措施必须明确列出其有效运行所需的数据。 诸如筛查与监测解决方案等控制措施可能需要不同的数据集。采用人工智能（AI）的解决 方案通过更大规模的数据集来构建客户的整体画像。因此，数据需求需根据控制措施的具 体特性进行定制化设计。 数据分类法是一种将数据划分为层级结构的离散系统。通过整理和分类数据构建数据分类 法，有助于为识别资产风险分类（AFC）及其他风险管理流程所需数据项提供统一框架。 数据可分为静态数据和动态数据。静态数据是客户固定属性，例如KYC 信息；动态 数据则通过观察客户行为（如交易记录或其他账户活动）采集。 组织机构从内部及外部来源获取数据。内部信息源是指企业通过收集或观察获取的客户信 息及其交易对象数据，例如交易对手方。外部信息源则指其他机构掌握的关于企业客户的信 息，例如负面媒体报道数据和受益所有人登记信息。外部信息源还为企业内部控制机制的运 行提供必要数据支持，例如来自监管机构及其他政府或国际组织的名单。这些名单包含受制 裁和禁运限制的实体，以及已知的犯罪分子和恐怖分子等敏感信息。 组织 由于数据可能采用不同格式或具有其他特性，数据整合是该流程中的关键环节。当数据流 入合规系统时，会依据系统技术专家与业务合作伙伴共同制定的数据字典填充表格，从而 确保数据一致性。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 462 Data as an input for solutions Understanding your data Compliance systems require particular types of data to function properly. Data must be relevant to the compliance risk that an organization is mitigating. Each risk has an intended control, and each control must list the data it needs to operate effectively. Controls such as screening and monitoring solutions might require different datasets. Solutions utilizing AI leverage a larger dataset to build a holistic view of the customer. Therefore, data requirements are tailored to the specifics of the control. Data taxonomy is a discrete system for classifying data into hierarchical structures. Curating and classifying data into a data taxonomy can help provide a consistent framework for identifying data items that are needed for AFC and other risk management processes. Data can be static or dynamic. Static data is the fixed attributes of the customer, such as KYC details. Dynamic data is collected from observing customer behaviors, such as transactions or other account activity. Organizations obtain data from internal and external sources. Internal sources are what organizations collect or observe about their customers and those with whom they interact, such as counterparties. External sources refer to information that other organizations have about a given organization's customers, such as data from adverse media reports and beneficial ownership registers. External sources also provide data needed for the operation of a control, such as lists from regulators and other government or international agencies. These lists include entities subject to sanctions and embargoes, as well as known criminal and terrorist individuals and organizations. Since data may be in different formats or have other characteristics, integrating data is an important step in the process. As data flows into the compliance system, it populates tables in accordance with a data dictionary that system technologists and business partners create. This ensures that the

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第463页 该系统能准确且一致地将多源数据映射至表格中的对应字段。例如，使用“街道地址” 标签的源数据将无法与使用“地址”标签的第二源数据兼容；同理，“受益人”标签的 数据也无法与标注为“接收者”的数据兼容。 已完成或已填充的数据表将控制操作所需数据与来自内部及外部来源的可用数据进行 比对。 覆盖率和缺口评估 覆盖率与缺口评估可识别缺失、不准确或不一致的数据，同时确定错误使用的数据类型及现 有数据对合规解决方案需求的覆盖程度。 数据缺失可能源于数据馈送不完整或文件损坏。此外，源系统可能未包含所需数据，例如 KYC 文件中缺少客户所需信息。 数据不准确可能源于信息过时，例如客户新地址未及时更新。也可能指错误属性被分配给客 户或客户群体。 数据不一致且未按统一标准规范，未能符合约定的数据字典要求。这意味着合规系统缺失 部分必要数据。例如，数据中可能包含非标准国家代码，导致系统无法识别某些国际客户 或交易记录。 错误使用的数据往往难以识别，因为数据本身可能准确无误。例如，某交易监控系统采用行 业代码对客户进行分类时，所有具有相同代码的客户会被归为一类并接受统一监控。这种方 案未能利用营业额、市场规模、产品类型及销售渠道等其他特征，导致客户细分缺乏深度与 精准度。 数据缺失、不准确、不一致或使用不当，并不会直接导致合规系统无法运行，但会显著削 弱解决方案的实际效果，甚至降低整体风险覆盖水平。开展风险覆盖与缺口评估的核心目 标，正是要精准定位这些问题的发生节点及其对管控体系运行可能产生的影响。合规系统
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 463 system accurately and consistently maps data from multiple sources to the correct field within the table. For example, data from one source that uses a label of "street address" will not be compatible with data from a second source with the label "address." Similarly, data with the label "beneficiary" will not be compatible with data labeled "recipient." Completed, or populated, data tables compare data required for control operation with available data from internal and external sources. Coverage and gap assessment A coverage and gap assessment identifies data that is missed, inaccurate, or inconsistent. It also identifies incorrectly used data and the extent to which the available data covers compliance solution requirements. Missing data might be due to an incomplete data feed or a corrupted file. Or, source systems might not contain the required data, such as a KYC file that does not contain the required details for a customer. Inaccurate data might be out of date, such as when a customer’s new address is not updated. It can also mean an incorrect attribute is allocated to a customer or group of customers. Inconsistent data is not standardized to conform to an agreed-upon data dictionary. This means the compliance system does not have all the required data. For example, data might include nonstandard country codes, which might cause the compliance system to fail to identify some international customers or transactions. Incorrectly used data can be difficult to identify because the data itself might be accurate. One example is when a transaction monitoring solution uses industry codes to segment customers. This means all customers with the same code are segmented together and are subject to equal monitoring. This solution fails to use other attributes such as turnover, scale, products, and channels to complete a more detailed and accurate segmentation. Missing, inaccurate, inconsistent, or inaccurately used data does not always prevent compliance systems from operating. However, it does distort the effectiveness of the solution. It might also reduce the overall risk coverage. The purpose of the coverage and gap assessment is to identify where this occurs and the likely impact on control operation. Since compliance systems

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第464页 即使在数据质量较差或缺失的情况下仍能正常运行，需评估数据质量的容差水平。合 规官应了解合规系统中数据质量容差水平的相关要求。 审查人员与监管机构还会通过数据覆盖率及缺口评估，将金融机构与行业标准进行对标 分析，以判断其系统是否能够满足最低法定要求。 为技术解决方案提供干净的数据 干净数据具有完整性、一致性、准确性及无错误性。这类数据能有效支持分析工作，有 助于提升合规系统输出结果的准确性，同时还能通过合规系统显著提高数据处理的效率与 效果。数据清洗过程即指数据净化或数据清理操作。 数据清洗流程： • 删除重复项。 • 数据标准化 • 验证或确认数据准确性。 • 管理数据异常值。 • 识别并修复损坏的数据集。 数据专业人员通常使用特定软件进行数据清洗。其角色属于技术团队或外部数据供应商及服 务提供商中的专业职能。在部署新技术方案或升级现有系统前，必须进行数据清洗工作。数 据专家可通过原地清洗技术（即在数据存储环境中直接处理）来清除异常数据，该技术能通 过扫描数据集识别异常值。他们还可采用批量清洗方案，通过执行系列脚本程序来检测并标 记异常数据。此外，数据清洗也可借助专业防火墙系统实现，该系统如同智能过滤器般运 作，同样能达到预期效果。 数据清洗流程必须持续进行。组织应根据治理协议报告相关指标，并采取纠正措施。 必要的 数据清洗有多种形式，包括剔除空数据字段、无效条目或缺失记录。例如，若KYC 记录 中未包含出生日期，系统可能会将其从筛选数据集中移除。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 464 still operate with poor or missing data, a tolerance level for data quality is assessed. The compliance officer should understand the data quality tolerance level for the compliance systems. Examiners and regulators also use data coverage and gap assessments to benchmark financial institutions against the industry and gauge whether systems are capable of meeting minimum legal requirements. Clean data for technology solutions Clean data is complete, consistent, accurate, and error-free. Clean data assists with analytics and helps improve or maintain accuracy in compliance system outputs. It also increases the efficiency and effectiveness of data processing through compliance systems. The process of cleaning data is referred to as data cleansing or data cleaning. Data cleansing processes: • Remove duplicates. • Standardize data. • Verify or validate data accuracy. • Manage data outliers. • Identify and fix corrupted data sets. Data professionals usually clean data using specific software. Their role is a specialist function within technology teams or external data vendors and service providers. Data cleansing occurs before implementing a new technology solution or upgrading an existing one. Data professionals can clean data in situ, or where it resides, via technology that searches a data set for irregularities. They can also clean data in batches by running a series of scripts to identify and highlight anomalies. Additionally, they can send the data through a specialist firewall that acts like a filter to achieve the same result. The data cleansing process must be ongoing. Organizations should report metrics under governance protocols and take corrective actions as necessary. There are different forms of data cleansing, including discarding empty data fields, null entries, or missing records. For example, if a KYC record does not contain a date of birth, the system might remove it from a screening dataset

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第465页 并将数据返回源系统进行修正处理。有时需要改变以往不良操作习惯。例如当客户出生日 期未知时，可能存在用“01/01/1900”替代空白日期字段的做法。系统可能需要调整其他记 录，比如根据客户地址位置自动验证或添加国际区号。另一项修正措施是系统对地址进行 标准化处理，将街道缩写St替换为Street，道路缩写Rd替换为Rd等缩写形式。 数据处理过程中需平衡数据洁净度与原始数据真实性。数据清洗往往成本高昂且耗时费 力。企业应审慎判断数据是否具备可使用的洁净度，而非追求永远无法实现的100%洁净度 标准。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 465 and return it to the source system for remediation. Sometimes, previous poor practices need to be changed. For example, in cases where the customer's date of birth is unknown, there may be a practice of inserting "01/01/1900" instead of leaving the date of birth field blank. The system might adjust other records, such as when it automatically verifies or adds an international area code for a customer phone number based on the address location. Another example of remediation is when the system standardizes addresses and changes abbreviations such as St for street or Rd for road. There should be a balance between data that is clean and data that remains true to the source data. Data cleansing can be expensive and time- consuming. Organizations need to discern when data is clean enough to use and not strive for 100% cleanness, which they will never be able to achieve.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第466页 数据收集 内部数据与外部数据对比 数据来源可分为内部数据与外部数据。企业通常通过客户KYC 及其他入行资料获取内部数 据。内部数据示例包括账户性质与用途、所需产品类型以及客户计划开展业务的国家。此 外，内部数据还可包含企业为客户分配的属性信息，例如风险评级、唯一标识符、账户详情 及账户状态。 内部数据中的一种类型是观测数据，包含记录客户行为及其互动对象的交易记录。 此外，还包括关系经理、客服专员、调查人员及其他与客户接触的员工所进行的观察 记录。 此外，内部数据包含需规避的客户名单，例如因合规要求已退出合作的客户。同时收录了 经机构调查后判定为金融犯罪低风险的客户名单。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 466 Data collection Internal versus external data Data sources are internal or external. Organizations obtain internal data from customer KYC and other onboarding details. Some examples of internal data are the nature and purpose of the account, the type of products required, and the countries where the customer intends to operate. Internal data can also include attributes the organization assigns to the customer, such as a risk rating, unique identifier, account details, and account status. One type of internal data, observed data, includes transaction records showing what customers do and with whom they do it. It also shows observations from relationship managers, customer service operators, investigators, and any other employee who interacts with the customer. In addition, internal data includes lists of customers to avoid, such as those the organization previously exited for compliance reasons. It further includes lists of customers the organization investigated before and deemed low risk for financial crime.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第467页 外部数据指组织外部获取的数据，主要分为两类。第一类是特定客户专属数据，包括负面媒 体报道、法院判决、商业登记记录、UBO 数据库、选民登记册等公开渠道信息，这类数据 有助于企业开展必要的尽职调查。第二类是企业用于客户筛查的标准数据，涵盖制裁名单、 禁运名单、恐怖组织及重大犯罪集团名单，以及重点实体（PEPs）名单。 合规系统通过整合内部与外部数据（通常采用网络分析技术）来管控金融犯罪风险。例 如，这类系统会结合客户提供的KYC 信息、观测到的交易数据以及往来交易数据，从而识 别可能被忽视的潜在风险。另一典型应用是筛查系统，其需要将静态客户KYC 信息与来自 名单提供商及其他机构的外部数据相结合。 内部数据通常采用结构化格式，这有助于组织机构进行有效管控。外部数据来源于多种不 同渠道，可能导致其结构化程度不足或与合规系统存在兼容性问题。非结构化数据指未采 用固定格式的数据形式，例如评论字段中呈现的自由文本。这类数据需要额外处理才能转 化为可用格式。 内部静态数据 内部静态数据是指客户提供的数据或第三方机构为客户分配的数据，在收集后保持不变。客 户提供的数据包括姓名、地址、出生日期、企业注册号等KYC 信息，以及护照号码、车牌 号等唯一标识符。这些信息虽会随时间推移而变更，但由于客户始终持有此类数据（如姓名 或出生日期），故被视为静态数据。企业董事、签署人及公司实益所有者亦属静态数据范 畴。 企业在客户入职流程或定期审查周期中获取客户数据。客户也可在变更发生时及时提供相 关信息。同一企业内部可能存在多个客户或客户关系。当这种情况发生时，该组织可能会 将客户数据存储在独立系统中，并仅对静态数据所在位置进行更新。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 467 External data is data found outside the organization. There are two types. The first type is data specific to a particular customer. This includes adverse media reports, court rulings, business registries, UBO databases, voter registers, and other publicly available sources. This data helps organizations complete appropriate due diligence. The second type is data the organization screens all customers against. This includes lists of entities for sanctions and embargoes, terrorists and major criminal groups, and PEPs. Compliance systems manage financial crime risk by combining internal and external data, often using network analysis. For example, systems combine customer-provided KYC data, observed transactional data, and data from correspondent transactions to identify potential risks that would otherwise go unnoticed. Another example is screening systems, as they require a combination of static customer KYC details and external data from list providers and other agencies. Internal data is often in a structured format, which makes it easier for the organization to control. External data originates from many diverse sources, which might make it unstructured or incompatible with compliance systems. Unstructured data is data that is not provided in a fixed format, such as free text that appears in a comment field. This requires additional work to refine it into a usable format. Internal static data Internal static data is data a customer provides or another entity attributes to a customer that remains the same after it is collected. The data the customer provides includes KYC details such as name, address, date of birth, business registration number, and unique identifications such as passport or license numbers. These details can change over time but are treated as static data because customers always have this type of data, such as a name or date of birth. Business directors, signatories, and beneficial owners of a company are also examples of static data. Organizations obtain data from the customer during the onboarding process or regular review cycle. The customer can also provide changes as they occur. Customers might have multiple products or relationships within an organization. When this happens, the organization might hold customer data in separate systems and make any updates to the static data where it resides.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第468页 受监管实体亦可将数据归因于客户。归因数据包括： • 客户识别编号 • 所申请产品类型，例如储蓄账户、外币账户、信用卡或商业贷款。 • 使用类型包括个人交易、商业融资或国际贸易等。 • 交易渠道包括互联网、移动支付、SWIFT、美国银行汇款（ACH）或现金。 • 账户状态包括新建、现有、活跃或休眠。 有时数据可能出现错位现象，原因在于客户可能关联着组织的不同部门。例如，某公司董事 同时是拥有个人账户的私有客户。又如，某客户在业务部门被标记为休眠状态，但在其他部 门仍保持活跃状态。 企业应当将客户提供的基础数据与关联数据相结合，从而为尽职调查和风险评估流程提供完 整视角。例如，两家商业客户可能具有相似的静态数据（如企业名称、地址及所有者信 息），但若补充产品类型和所属司法管辖区等关联数据，则可能形成截然不同的风险特征。 可能需要对数据进行进一步分析以实现准确分类。 内部观察数据 内部观测数据是指企业内部系统生成、采集并处理的交易行为数据。这类数据来源多样，包 括交易记录、调查报告、客户关系经理及运营人员提供的信息。数据可能基于客观事实或主 观判断，也可能源于员工无法联系到客户的情况。观测数据可表现为交易记录、客服记录中 的标记选项或叙述性文本。企业应当将观测数据转化为可整合的数据元素，纳入合规管理系 统。例如，当调查人员发现客户交易行为模式与基于历史数据预测的预期行为存在显著差异 时，就需要对这些数据进行标准化处理。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 468 Regulated entities may also attribute data to a customer. Attributed data includes: • Customer identification numbers. • Type of products requested such as savings account, foreign currency account, credit card, or business loan. • Type of usage such as personal transactions, business financing, or international trade. • Transaction channels such as internet, mobile, SWIFT, ACH, or cash. • Account status such as new, existing, active, or dormant. Sometimes data might be misaligned due to the customer being associated with different parts of the organization. For example, the director of a company is also a private customer with a personal account. Another example is when a customer is flagged as dormant in one part of the business but is still active in another. Organizations should combine data the customer provides with attributed data. This helps provide a complete view for due diligence and risk assessment processes. For example, two commercial customers might have similar static data, such as business name, address, and owner. However, adding the attributed data, such as products and jurisdictions, might result in a different risk profile. Further analysis of the data might be needed to correctly classify it. Internal observed data Internal observed data refers to transactional or behavioral data that an organization’s internal systems generate or capture and process. It has multiple sources, including transaction records, investigations, relationship managers, and operations staff. The data can be objective or based on opinion. It can also be based on the inability of staff to contact a customer. Observed data can take the form of transaction data, flags or checkboxes in customer service records, or narrative. Organizations should convert observed data into a data element to incorporate it into a compliance system. For example, if an investigator finds that a customer is conducting transactions in a pattern that differs from the expected behavior based on the

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第469页 根据金额、地点、行业及声明的预期值，调查员会为需要审查的客户临时提升风险评级， 并设置相应标识。此举将触发关系经理进行审查。 观测数据的一个典型实例是调查所得数据。若调查未发现金融犯罪证据或嫌疑，机构可将客 户风险评级调低，以便持续开展监控与筛查工作。机构应定期重新评估修订后的评级，确保 其适用性。 内部观察数据通常指受监管实体为客户或客户群体分配或归属的数据。这与内部静态数据 形成对比，后者可由组织从客户处收集或分配给客户。 观察数据未经独立验证或确认。其具有时效性特征，即数据仅在观测时刻具有真实性。 鉴于这种主观性和时效性特征，组织在合规系统中使用观察数据时需谨慎。 组织机构将观察数据与静态数据进行比对。例如，某客户在某国登记的地址属于静态数 据，但监控系统显示其所有交易均发生于不同国家，这属于动态观测数据。类似地，某零 售客户自称是受薪员工，但持续账户监控显示其交易模式与个体商户特征高度吻合。在这 两种情况下，客户风险评级均需进行相应调整。 利用内部平台数据 组织内部的数据来源五花八门，因此数据标签、结构形式以及准确性和完整性水平各不相 同。例如，监控系统和支付审核系统会从单一数据源获取客户账户信息，并尝试与支付系 统的交易数据进行比对。由于这些不同系统间的数据标签可能存在差异，合规系统必须在 实际应用前对这些标签进行标准化处理。 合规系统若需使用内部数据，必须首先根据通用数据字典或术语表中的定义将数据组织成 表格。系统需求决定了数据表结构。例如，若合规系统需填写三个字段：<姓名>、<地址> 及<日期>
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 469 amount, location, industry, and stated expectations, the investigator assigns a flag for required review to temporarily increase the risk rating of the customer. This triggers a review by a relationship manager. An example of observed data is data resulting from an investigation. When an investigation finds no evidence or suspicion of financial crime, the organization might adjust the customer’s risk profile to a reduced risk rating for ongoing monitoring and screening. The organization should frequently reassess the revised rating to ensure it remains appropriate. Internal observed data is typically data a regulated entity assigns or attributes to a customer or group of customers. This is in contrast to internal static data, which an organization may either collect from or assign to a customer. Observed data is not independently verified or validated. It is time-based, which means the data is only true at the time of observation. Organizations should be careful when using observed data in a compliance system due to this subjective and time-based nature. Organizations compare observed data with static data. For example, a customer has an address in one country, which is static data, but the monitoring system indicates all transactions occur in a different country, which is observed data. Similarly, a retail customer claims to be a salaried employee, but ongoing account monitoring shows a transaction pattern resembling a small business. In both examples, the customer risk rating might require adjustment. Leveraging data from internal platforms Data comes from many different sources in the organization. Therefore, it has different labels, structures, and levels of accuracy and completeness. For example, monitoring and payment screening systems receive customer account data from one data store and attempt to match it with transactional data from payment systems. The data labels across these disparate systems likely vary, and therefore the compliance system must standardize them before use. For a compliance system to use internal data, it must first assemble the data into tables in accordance with definitions from a common data dictionary or glossary. System requirements dictate data table structures. For example, if a compliance system requires three fields, <name>, <address>, and <date of

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第470页 若为出生数据，则数据表将包含三个对应这些标签的列。 合规系统仅消耗与系统运行相关的数据，因此源系统中的部分数据不会填充至数据表中。 这是因为数据表过度填充会降低合规系统的运行效率。对于集成人工智能解决方案的系统 而言，情况更为复杂——其所需数据表通常具有更全面、更包容的特性。 由于命名规范与存储协议已发生变更，旧系统数据可能无法与新系统兼容。跨司法管辖区 及语言边界的操作更会加剧数据处理复杂性。为此，合规系统会在将数据导入最终数据表 前，对暂存表中的数据进行组装、清洗、增补及标准化处理。 数据使用可分为被动使用与主动使用两种类型。被动使用指数据本身具有固有价值的情形， 例如“国家代码”字段，该字段无需额外操作即可承载固有价值。 主动式应用具有交互性，例如合规系统通过比对两个数据字段来识别交易活动偏离该用户 画像预期模式的情况。通过对比这些数据要素，合规系统既能检测需要进一步调查的异常 情况，也可应用额外的主动数据字段。 案例示例：人工智能在洗钱检测中的应用 埃里克是诺瓦资本银行的数据科学家。该银行采用传统交易监控系统，该系统通过预设规 则组合来识别风险。埃里克已向银行高层领导层表达了对该系统的担忧。他指出，系统在 执行所有规则时，仅能利用部分内部数据进行客户风险监控。 例如，该银行设有自动向政府机构报告现金交易的阈值标准。这包括系统规则要求监测现 金交易时需包含特定数据要素，且该阈值标准仅略低于法定报告要求。

Compliance systems only consume data that is relevant to the operation of the system, so some data in the source systems will not populate in the data tables. This is because overpopulated data tables reduce the efficiency of compliance systems. This is more complicated for systems incorporating AI solutions, in which required data tables are more comprehensive and inclusive. Data from older systems may not be compatible with newer systems, as naming conventions and storage protocols have changed. Crossing jurisdictional and language boundaries complicates these processes further. To address this, the compliance system assembles, cleans, enriches, and standardizes the data in staging tables before populating it into final data tables. Data use is either passive or active. Passive use refers to instances in which the value of the data is inherent, such as the "country code" field, which holds inherent value without further action. Active use is interactive, such as when the compliance system compares two data fields to identify instances in which transaction activity deviates from the expected pattern for that profile. Comparing these data elements allows the compliance system to either detect an anomaly that requires further investigation or apply additional active data fields. Case example: AI for money laundering detection Erik is a data scientist working at Nova Capital Bank. The bank uses a conventional transaction monitoring system that has a defined series of rules to match pre-identified risks. Erik has expressed concerns about this system to the senior leaders of his organization. He explained that, across the spectrum of all rules within the system, the system only uses a subset of available internal data for monitoring customers. For example, the bank has a threshold for automatically reporting cash transactions to government agencies. This includes system rules requiring specific data elements to monitor cash transactions just below the reporting

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第471页 银行监管要求必须提供交易详细信息，包括“交易类型”、“交易金额”、“交易地 点”、“交易渠道”、“资金流向（入账/出账）”以及“存款人信息”等要素。然而在 实际操作中，系统往往不使用或仅部分采用“资金来源”、“资产来源”、“关联方信 息”、“交易对手方”及“交易地点”等关键数据要素来满足特定场景和监管要求。这 种数据处理方式可能为犯罪分子提供可乘之机，使其能够通过账户渠道进行现金交易而 不被察觉。 经过数月的测试，并充分考虑了组织内人工智能委员会的指导建议后，埃里克最终说服团队 采用人工智能技术，通过内部数据提升金融犯罪检测的效率与精准度。新系统摒弃了传统风 险定义与数据映射模式，转而尽可能整合海量数据，构建客户画像的全景视图。这些大幅增 加的数据点需要更强的处理能力，才能基于多维度指标快速生成客户风险评分。此外，系统 具备“自我学习”功能，使其效能与效率随时间推移持续提升。 新资本银行迅速见证了这项升级技术的实际成效。短短数周内，系统便能识别出行为模式 偏离常规的客户，提示可能存在金融犯罪风险。该系统通过分析海量数据，发现了客户与 先前被标记实体之间的关联性——这种关联性是传统规则系统很可能忽略的。随着调查深 入，凭借埃里克新开发的检测系统以及新资本银行丰富的内部数据资源，银行最终确认该 客户涉嫌洗钱活动。 普遍预期是人工智能系统部署旨在提升人力效率。以Erik为例，其目标是使生态系统在 金融犯罪检测方面更具效能，这一目标已实现。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 471 threshold. The bank’s rules require transaction details such as "type," "value," "location," "channel," "inbound or outbound," and "depositor.” However, the system either does not use or only partially uses data elements such as "source of funds,” "source of wealth,” "connected parties,” "counterparties," and "location" for specific scenarios and rules. This could potentially allow criminals to process cash through their accounts undetected. After several months of testing and considering the guidance of the AI council within his organization, Erik finally convinces his organization to employ AI technologies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of financial crime detection using internal data. Rather than defining a prescriptive risk and then mapping data points to it, the new system collates as much data as possible and uses it to construct a holistic view of the customer. These greatly increased data points require augmented processing power to quickly provide a customer risk score based on multiple indicators extracted from the data. Additionally, the system can "self-learn," which increases its effectiveness and efficiency over time. Nova Capital Bank quickly witnesses the results of this updated technology. Within weeks, the system flags a customer whose patterns deviate from established normal behavior, indicating potential financial crime. The system analyzes large volumes of data, recognizing a relationship between the customer and a previously flagged entity that the conventional rules-based system would have likely missed. This discovery escalates, and the bank ultimately concludes that the customer is laundering money, thanks to Erik, the new detection system, and Nova Capital Bank's extensive internal data. A common expectation is that AI systems are deployed to yield head count efficiencies. In Erik’s case, the goal was to make the ecosystem more effective at detecting financial crime, which was achieved.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第472页 关键要点 • 当组织充分利用所有可用内部数据时，检测系统效能将得到提升。 • 处理海量数据需要额外的计算能力，这虽可提升系统运行速度，但也可能增加运营 成本。 • 在经过充分测试并负责任地部署后，人工智能可用于识别异常行为及复杂网络。 外部数据 外部数据指来自组织外部来源的信息。企业在使用这类数据前，必须完成数据采集、整 理、清洗及预处理等关键环节。在将外部数据整合至合规系统时，同样需要经过上述流程 处理。第三方机构也可提供外部数据，例如用于筛查目的的名单、政府机构的情报资料， 或注册系统中的身份识别信息。 外部数据能够丰富并提升内部数据的价值。例如，企业通过导入商业注册信息来优化KYC 流程和尽职调查程序。同样，来自法院记录及其他政府机构的数据也具有重要参考价值。 企业还会利用外部数据来实现特定功能，例如名单筛查。对于大型金融机构而言，其数据源 通常来自第三方供应商，这些供应商会整合多方数据并提供预配置的统一数据集。另一个典 型应用场景是负面媒体筛查，相关数据源既可自动获取也可人工填报。 组织机构在使用外部数据时需谨慎行事，须对系统准确性承担相应责任。应对外部提供 的数据进行准确性、可靠性、兼容性及一致性的验证与测试。这一要求在使用开源或公 开可获取记录时尤为重要。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 472 Key takeaways • Detection system effectiveness increases when organizations leverage all available internal data. • Processing large volumes of data requires additional processing power, which increases the speed of the system but may also increase operational costs. • AI is useful for identifying anomalous behavior and complex networks when deployed responsibly following sufficient testing. External data External data refers to information from sources outside the organization. It is important that organizations source, collate, clean, and prepare external data before using it. It is essential that organizations source, collate, clean, and prepare external data before incorporating it into their compliance systems. Third parties can also provide external data, such as lists for screening purposes, intelligence from government agencies, or identification details from registries. External data enriches and enhances internal data. For example, organizations import business registration details to improve KYC and due diligence processes. Similarly, data from court records and other government agencies can be valuable. Organizations also use external data to perform a specific function, such as list screening. For larger financial institutions, data sources are usually third-party providers who collate data from multiple sources and provide a single preconfigured dataset. Another example of a specific function for external data is adverse media screening, which sources can supply automatically or manually. Organizations should take care when using external data. They are accountable for system accuracy. Organizations should validate and test externally provided data for accuracy, reliability, compatibility, and consistency. This is particularly relevant when using open-source or publicly available records.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第473页 企业在整合外部数据时，需重点考量数据来源的可靠性，并评估是否需要额外验证流程来 确保数据质量，或筛查可能存在的恶意数据及虚假信息（例如不实负面媒体报道）。虽然 人工智能产品能提供有价值的信息，但其输出结果仍需像所有外部数据一样经过核实。更 合理的做法是借助AI技术筛选原始数据源，再通过人工核查确保信息准确性。在将外部数 据纳入合规系统时，企业应建立完善的系统测试机制，及时发现数据质量问题及可能引发 的负面影响。 此外，企业应当评估自身是否具备合法使用数据的权利，并确认是否存在数据存储与保留限 制。例如，多数司法管辖区都制定了相关法律法规，明确规定数据的使用范围及存储、删除 要求。当前企业正通过隐私增强技术等工具，在遵守当地数据法规的前提下，扩大数据在金 融犯罪领域的应用范围。 整合来自不同来源的数据 组织机构从多种内部及外部来源收集数据。随后，他们将数据整合至数据仓库或 数据湖等数据存储系统中。 从多个数据源收集信息时，数据点可能在内容上相似但格式各异。例如，某数据源可能将出 生日期标注为<dd/mm/yyyy>并使用<出生日期>标签，而另一数据源则可能采用<yymmdd>格 式并使用<dob>标签。这种情况下，相同数据点会呈现不同的记录顺序和标签形式。 在整合此类数据时，组织需采取恰当存储方式，既要确保原始数据完整无损，又要保证数据 准确性与一致性以适配下游系统需求。若多个下游系统采用不同的数据字段和标签，将使数 据整合过程面临更大挑战。 在数据集成过程中，企业需要对数据进行合并、丰富或增强处理。基础集成模式要求企业 将数据集中存储，并根据具体系统需求，通过有序的暂存流程进行数据流转。该暂存流程 能确保不同源系统中的数据实现有效整合，从而满足终端用户系统的具体需求。由于
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 473 Organizations should consider the source of external data and whether additional checks are needed to validate its quality or assess potential malicious data or misinformation, such as incorrect adverse media reports. AI products provide useful information, but AI responses should be verified like any external data. It is more appropriate to use AI to locate primary sources, which can then be verified for accuracy. Organizations should require additional system testing when incorporating external data into compliance systems to check for poor quality and negative performance impacts. Additionally, an organization should consider whether it has a legal right to use the data. Consider whether storage and retention restrictions apply. For example, many jurisdictions have laws and regulations governing what data may be used for and how organizations must store or delete it. Organizations are using privacy-enhancing technologies and other tools to broaden the availability of data for financial crime purposes while adhering to local data regulations. Integrating data from various sources Organizations collect data from a variety of sources, both internal and external. They then collate the data into a data store such as a data warehouse or data lake. Collecting data from multiple sources means the data points might be similar in content but different in format. For example, one source might provide the date of birth as <dd/mm/yyyy> with the label <date of birth>, while another source might provide it as <yymmdd> with the label <dob>. In this example, the data points have different sequences and different labels for similar data. When integrating this data, organizations need to store it in a way that ensures no original data is lost and that the data is correct and consistent for any downstream systems. Multiple downstream systems that use different data fields and labels can complicate this process even more. With data integration processes, organizations need to merge, enrich, or enhance data in some way. The basic form of integration requires organizations to store data together and move it through a staging process in a coherent sequence as needed for a particular system. The staging process ensures that data from one source system merges or combines with other source data to meet the requirements of the end-user system. Because

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第474页 当组织需要持续进行数据迁移、检索、更新及验证时，该流程可能效率低下且易出错。 最新技术可使数据保留在原始数据源中。组织机构在需要时可通过专用集成工具检索数 据，这些工具实现数据源与终端用户系统的连接，并包含确保数据有效性、一致性及连 贯性的流程机制。

More recent technologies allow data to remain with the original source. Organizations retrieve the data via dedicated integration tools when they need it. These tools connect the source and the end-user system. The tools include processes to ensure the data is valid, consistent, and coherent.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第475页 数据准备 数据质量 有效的合规系统需要高质量数据。加载至合规系统中的数据可包括： • 客户详细信息，如姓名及地址。 • 属性，例如企业类型及所持账户类型。 • 客户活动，例如发送和接收的交易内容以及涉及的其他人员。 合规专家还可能选择调取外部信息，例如已知罪犯与恐怖分子名单、负面媒体报道及其他 有用资料，以帮助系统更有效地识别客户群体或交易基础中的潜在风险。 数据质量是决定组织在合规系统及流程中运用数据要素效果的关键因素。原始数据往往存在 错误、不一致性和信息缺失等问题。不准确或不完整的数据可能导致犯罪风险漏判。虽然高 质量数据无需追求完美，但必须符合实际应用场景需求。在反金融犯罪合规领域，从业者需 要依托优质数据来根据客户风险承受能力进行监控筛查，并以令人满意的精准度识别金融犯 罪风险发生的潜在环节。 企业应当通过定性和定量指标来评估数据质量，包括完整性、准确性、一致性、时效性和有 效性等维度。在数据全生命周期中，企业需要完成数据采集、整理、存储、检索、处理、分 析、迁移、合并、拆分等全流程操作，并对数据进行质量管控。每次进行数据修改或迁移 时，企业都应执行质量核验与质量对账流程——即将预期质量标准与实际质量数据进行比 对，确保数据质量的一致性。 专业人员应将这些指标纳入管理报告中，作为持续治理的一部分，以确保能够随时评估数 据质量，从而评估合规系统输出的质量。这些数据
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 475 Data preparation Data quality Effective compliance systems require high-quality data. Data loaded into compliance systems can include: • Customer details, such as name and address. • Attributes, such as type of business and type of accounts held. • Customer activity, such as what transactions are sent and received and who else is involved. Compliance specialists may also decide to source external information such as lists of known criminals and terrorists, adverse media reports, and other useful material to help systems better detect risk within their customer or transactional base. Data quality is a determinant of how well organizations can use data elements within compliance systems and processes. Raw data often contains errors, inconsistencies, and missing information. Inaccurate and incomplete data can lead to missed instances of criminal risk. While high-quality data does not need to be perfect, it should be fit for its purpose. For AFC compliance, professionals need good data to monitor or screen customers in alignment with their risk appetite and determine where financial crime risk occurs to a satisfactory level of accuracy. Organizations should measure data quality against qualitative and quantitative metrics, such as completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and validity. Throughout the data’s life cycle, organizations can collect, collate, store, retrieve, manipulate, analyze, move, merge, strip, and subject it to many other processes. Organizations should check data for quality and reconcile it— meaning compare its expected quality against its actual quality for consistency—each time they alter or move it. Professionals should include these metrics in management reporting as part of ongoing governance to ensure that they can assess the quality of data, and therefore the quality of the compliance system output, at any time.
