items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第513页 守门员 在金融体系、市场或服务领域中发挥关键作用、为资金流动提供便利或保障的个人或机构被 称为“守门人”。这类专业人员包括律师、公证人、会计师、投资顾问以及信托与公司服务 提供商，他们通常身居要职且享有决策权。守门人需履行尽职调查、交易监控及专业咨询等 职责，在识别、防范和举报洗钱行为方面具有特殊作用。部分国家对守门人实施的尽职调查 要求，与金融机构的监管标准高度相似。 GDPR 通用数据保护条例 GenAI 生成式人工智能 GPML 全球反洗钱计划 授予或 转移财产或资产所有权或所有权的当事人。在信托关系中，通常指设立或出资设立信 托的人。 码砖 未经授权访问计算机系统或网络，意图窃取或篡改数据、中断服务或获取敏感信息。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 513 Gatekeeper An individual or entity that plays a crucial role in facilitating or enabling access to financial systems, markets, or services. Gatekeepers are professionals such as lawyers, notaries, accountants, investment advisors, and trust and company service providers. They often hold positions of trust and authority. They are responsible for conducting due diligence, monitoring transactions, or providing advice and are deemed to have a particular role in identifying, preventing, and reporting money laundering. Some countries impose due diligence requirements on gatekeepers that are similar to those for financial institutions. GDPR General Data Protection Regulation GenAI Generative artificial intelligence GPML Global Programme Against Money Laundering Grantor The party who transfers title or ownership of property or assets. In a trust, typically the person who creates or funds the trust. Hacking Unauthorized access to computer systems or networks with the intent to steal or manipulate data, disrupt services, or gain sensitive information.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第514页 Hawala 这种非正式资金转账体系在中东、北非及印度次大陆地区广泛存在。该系统独立于传统银行 体系运作，无需现金实体流转即可完成资金转移。其基本运作模式为：客户联系哈瓦拉达尔 （hawaladar）并交付待转账款项，由哈瓦拉达尔联系收款人所在地的对应方，后者随后向收 款人汇付相应金额。各哈瓦拉达尔之间会实时记录净转账金额。参见替代性汇款系统 （ARS）。 香港企业管理协会 香港财政局 香港特别行政区 中国香港特别行政区 海涅曼医学研究中心 英国皇家税务与海关署 人力资源 人力资源 汇丰银行 香港上海汇丰银行 人口走私 非法跨境人员流动通常指在缺乏合法授权或文件的情况下协助其入境。人口走私与人口 贩卖的区别在于，前者侧重于人员的入境或运输环节，而非剥削行为本身。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 514 Hawala An informal value transfer system common in the Middle East, North Africa, and the Indian subcontinent. The system operates outside traditional banking systems and is an informal method of transferring money without the physical movement of cash. In its basic form, a customer contacts a hawaladar and gives him or her money to be transferred to another person. The hawaladar contacts his or her counterpart where the second person lives, and the counterpart remits appropriate funds to that person. A running tally with net sums is kept between the hawaladars. See Alternative remittance system (ARS). HKMA Hong Kong Monetary Authority HKSAR Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China HMRC His Majesty’s Revenue and Customs HR Human resources HSBC Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Human smuggling The illegal movement of individuals across borders, typically involving the facilitation of their entry into a country without proper legal authorization or documentation. Human smuggling differs from human trafficking in that it focuses on the entry or transport, rather than the exploitation, of the person involved.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第515页 人口贩运 通过胁迫、欺骗或暴力手段剥削个体以谋取各种利益，包括强迫劳动、性剥削、奴役或其 他非法活动。人口贩卖是严重侵犯人权的行为，属于有组织犯罪范畴。由于贩运者获取巨 额利润且活动具有非法性质，该行为被视为重大金融犯罪。该犯罪行为亦被称为人口贩 卖。 工业空气动力学信息服务部 国际保险监督官协会 印度农业研究委员会 国际资产追回中心 黄疸 信息和通信技术 IEEPA 国际紧急经济权力法 n.髂骨 投资连结保险 中介燃料 国际货币基金组织 积分 在经典洗钱流程中，第三个也是最后一个阶段是洗钱者将洗白资金重新注入金融体系，使 其具备合法性的表象，从而将资金重新投入经济体系。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 515 Human trafficking The exploitation of individuals through coercion, deception, or force for various purposes, including forced labor, sexual exploitation, servitude, or other illegal activities. Human trafficking is a severe human rights violation and a form of organized crime. It is considered a significant financial crime due to the profits the traffickers generate and the illicit nature of the activities involved. Also known as trafficking in persons. IAIS International Association of Insurance Supervisors ICAR International Center for Asset Recovery ICT Information and communications technology IEEPA International Emergency Economic Powers Act ILI Investment-linked insurance IMF International Monetary Fund Integration The third and last stage of the classic money laundering process, in which the money launderer places laundered funds back into the economy by re- entering the funds into the financial system and giving them the appearance of legitimacy.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第516页 国际货币基金组织（IMF） 国际货币基金组织（IMF）是一个由190多个成员国组成的国际金融机构，作为国际金融体 系的核心机构，致力于促进经济稳定、推动国际贸易发展并减少贫困。通过提供资金支持与 政策指导，IMF协助各国应对经济挑战，同时倡导全球经贸治理的合作模式。 IO 即刻结局 国际证券委员会组织 国际证券委员会组织 初次公开上市股票 首次公开发行 伊斯兰国 伊拉克和叙利亚伊斯兰国 信息技术 信息技术 国际电视会议业务 非正式价值转移系统 J5 全球税务执法联合首脑会议 JMLIT 联合反洗钱情报工作组 JMLSG 联合反洗钱指导小组
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 516 International Monetary Fund (IMF) An organization of more than 190 member countries and a key institution in the international financial system, helping to promote economic stablity, facilitate international trade, and reduce poverty. By providing financial resources and policy guidance, the IMF supports countries in addressing economic challenges and fosters a cooperative approach to global economic governance. IO Immediate outcome IOSCO International Organization of Securities Commissions IPO Initial public offering ISIS Islamic State of Iraq and Syria IT Information technology IVTS Informal value transfer system J5 Joint Chiefs of Global Tax Enforcement JMLIT Joint Money Laundering Intelligence Taskforce JMLSG Joint Money Laundering Steering Group

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第517页 了解你的客户（KYC） 金融机构及特定受监管企业为核实客户身份而采取的一系列措施与流程。KYC 流程对于防 范欺诈、洗钱、恐怖主义融资及其他金融犯罪至关重要。该流程有助于机构与客户建立并维 持合作关系，同时确保符合法律法规要求。 了解你的员工（KYE） 企业为核实员工身份及背景所采取的措施，尤其适用于监管严格或易受金融犯罪侵害的行 业。此类行业包括银行业、金融业及其他涉及敏感信息处理的领域。这些措施有助于企业 预防和侦测金融犯罪行为。 关键业绩指标 关键绩效指标 KRI 关键风险指标 KYC 了解你的客户 黎巴嫩 了解你的员工 KYV 了解你的供应商 L/C 信用证
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 517 Know your customer (KYC) A set of measures and procedures that financial institutions and certain regulated businesses undertake to verify the identity of their clients. The KYC process is essential for preventing fraud, money laundering, terrorist financing, and other financial crimes. It helps institutions establish and maintain a relationship with their clients while ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements. Know your employee (KYE) The measures organizations implement to verify the identity and background of their employees, particularly in sectors that are highly regulated or vulnerable to financial crimes. These sectors include banking, finance, and other industries that handle sensitive information. These measures can assist organizations in preventing and detecting financial crime. KPI Key performance indicator KRI Key risk indicator KYC Know your customer KYE Know your employee KYV Know your vendor L/C Letter of credit

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第518页 分层 在经典三阶段洗钱流程中，第二阶段介于资金注入与整合之间。分层洗钱通过构建复 杂的金融交易层级，将非法所得与其来源隔离开来，旨在掩盖审计追踪痕迹并实现匿 名化。 LEA 执法机构 信用证 银行或金融机构代表买方（申请人）签发的金融文件，承诺在特定条件下向卖方（受益 人）支付款项。该文件作为国际贸易交易中的付款担保，通过降低拒付风险来促进商业往 来。 局部白细胞运动 大型语言模型 低层次结构规程 有限责任合伙 LOD 防线 M&A 并购 恶意软件 恶意软件是指专门用于渗透、破坏或使计算机、服务器或网络失效的程序。常见类型包 括病毒、蠕虫、勒索软件和间谍软件。 MAS 新加坡金融管理局
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 518 Layering The second stage of the classic three-stage money laundering process, between placement and integration. Layering involves distancing illegal proceeds from their source by creating complex levels of financial transactions designed to disguise the audit trail and provide anonymity. LEA Law enforcement agency Letter of credit A financial document a bank or financial institution issues on behalf of a buyer (the applicant) that guarantees payment to a seller (the beneficiary) under specified conditions. It serves as a payment assurance in international trade transactions, facilitating commerce by reducing the risk associated with nonpayment. LLM Large language model LLP Limited liability partnership LOD Line of defense M&A Mergers and acquisitions Malware Malicious software designed to infiltrate, damage, or disable computers, servers, or networks. Common types include viruses, worms, ransomware, and spyware. MAS Monetary Authority of Singapore

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第519页 MBML 以市场为基础的洗钱 谅解备忘录（MOU） 谅解备忘录（MOU）是两方或多方就特定行动或义务达成的正式协议，明确双方共识或合 作的具体条款与细节。在金融犯罪领域，监管机构、执法部门与金融机构常通过签署MOU 来加强协作、共享数据，并协同开展打击洗钱等犯罪活动。 洗钱、欺诈及其他金融犯罪。谅解备忘录（MOU）常被各国用于规范国际资产没收案 件中资产的共享事宜。 MFA 多因素认证 米卡 加密资产市场监管研究 MiFID II 《金融工具市场指令II》 矿工 矿工是指参与区块链网络交易验证与记录过程的个人或实体，这类网络常见于比特币等工作 量证明系统。他们通过计算处理能力解决复杂数学难题，在维护区块链安全性和完整性方面 发挥着关键作用。 ML 洗钱 现代语言能力测试 司法协助条约
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 519 MBML Market-based money laundering Memorandum of understanding (MOU) A formal agreement between two or more parties outlining the terms and details of a mutual understanding or cooperation regarding specific actions or obligations. In the context of financial crime, MOUs are often used between regulatory agencies, law enforcement, and financial institutions to facilitate collaboration, data sharing, and coordinated efforts in combating money laundering, fraud, and other financial crimes. An MOU is often used by countries to govern their sharing of assets in international asset forfeiture cases. MFA Multi-factor authentication MiCA Markets in Cryptoassets Regulation MiFID II Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II Miner An individual or entity that participates in the process of validating and recording transactions on a blockchain network, commonly found in proof-of- work systems such as Bitcoin. Miners play a crucial role in maintaining the security and integrity of the blockchain by solving complex mathematical problems through computational processing power. ML Money laundering MLAT Mutual legal assistance treaties

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第520页 MLR 2017 《2017年反洗钱、恐怖主义融资及资金转移（付款人信息）条例》 MLRO 洗钱报告官员 货币工具 旅行支票、可转让票据（如个人支票或商业支票）、正式银行支票、银行承兑汇票、本 票、汇票、担保凭证或无记名股票等金融工具均属货币类票据。根据多数国家的反洗钱法 规，此类票据通常与现金一同被纳入监管范围，金融机构必须对涉及这些票据的客户交易 活动进行报告并留存完整记录。 洗钱 洗钱是指通过隐藏或伪装非法所得财产或资金的存在、来源、流向、去向或非法用途，使 其看似合法化的过程。该过程通常包含三个环节：将资金注入金融系统；通过交易层叠结 构掩盖资金来源、所有权及存放地点；以及以看似合法的资产形式将资金融入社会。洗钱 的定义因各国将其认定为犯罪行为的法律体系而存在差异。 洗钱报告官员（MLRO） 金融机构或受监管实体中负责监督组织遵守反洗钱法律法规的指定人员。该MLRO 在预 防、发现和报告可能涉及洗钱、恐怖主义融资或其他金融犯罪的可疑活动方面发挥关键作 用。该角色类似于美国《银行保密法》中的官员。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 520 MLR 2017 Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing, and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017 MLRO Money laundering reporting officer Monetary instrument A traveler’s check, negotiable instrument—such as a personal or business check—official bank check, cashier’s check, promissory note, money order, security, or stock in bearer form. Monetary instruments are normally included, along with currency, in the AML regulations of most countries, and financial institutions must file reports and maintain records of customer activities involving them. Money laundering The process of concealing or disguising the existence, source, movement, destination, or illegal application of illicitly derived property or funds to make them appear legitimate. It usually involves a three-part system: placement of funds into a financial system; layering of transactions to disguise the source, ownership, and location of the funds; and integration of the funds into society in the form of holdings that appear legitimate. The definition of money laundering varies in each country where it is recognized as a crime. Money laundering reporting officer (MLRO) A designated individual within a financial institution or regulated entity who is responsible for overseeing the organization’s compliance with AML laws and regulations. The MLRO plays a key role in preventing, detecting, and reporting suspicious activities that may involve money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crimes. This role is similar to Bank Secrecy Act officer in the US.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第521页 洗钱类型学 指用于掩盖非法所得资金来源的手段或技术。这类分类体系（金融行动特别工作组采用的 专业术语）可帮助金融机构、执法机构及监管机构理解洗钱活动的多种表现形式，从而制 定更有效的预防与侦测策略。 金钱骡 骡子特指那些被招募（通常在不知情情况下）为他人转移非法所得资金的人员。其在洗钱活 动中充当中介角色，协助转移通过欺诈、贩毒或人口贩卖等非法手段获取的资金。 货币命令 汇票通常以现金形式购买，面额较小（一般低于500欧元）。无支票账户的用户常使用该票 据支付账单或购买商品时商家拒收个人支票的情况。由于汇票以开票机构而非个人账户为 凭证，因此可能被用于洗钱活动。 货币服务业务（MSB） 从事货币服务（包括外汇兑换及资金转账）的个人或实体，被视为需履行反洗钱义务的非银 行金融机构。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 521 Money laundering typology A method or technique used to disguise the illicit origins of illegally obtained funds. These typologies, a term used by the Financial Action Task Force, help financial institutions, law enforcement agencies, and regulatory bodies understand the various ways in which money laundering occurs, enabling them to develop more effective prevention and detection strategies. Money mule An individual who is recruited, often unwittingly, to transfer illicitly obtained funds on behalf of others. A mule acts as an intermediary in money laundering schemes, facilitating the movement of money that has been acquired through illegal activities such as fraud, drug trafficking, or human trafficking. Money order A monetary instrument usually purchased with cash in small (generally under €500) denominations. It is commonly used by people without checking accounts to pay bills or to pay for purchases in which the vendor will not accept a personal check. Money orders may be used for laundering because they represent an instrument drawn on the issuing institution rather than on an individual’s account. Money services business (MSB) An individual or entity engaged in money services, including foreign exchange and money transmission. It is deemed to be a nonbank financial institution subject to AML obligations.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第522页 汇款服务 金融服务是指接受现金、支票及其他货币工具的支付服务。这类服务能够将资金集中存储 于单一场所，并通过通信网络、消息传递、转账或清算系统，向异地受益人以现金或其他 形式支付相应金额。此类服务处理的交易可能涉及一个或多个中介机构及第三方最终结算 环节。资金转账服务可通过正规金融体系（如银行账户）由个人或法人提供，也可通过非 银行金融机构、商业实体等非正规渠道实现，甚至可在监管体系之外开展。在部分司法管 辖区，非正规系统被称为替代汇款服务或地下（平行）银行系统。该服务亦称价值转移服 务。参见替代汇款系统（ARS）。 MONEYVAL 反洗钱措施及恐怖主义融资评估专家委员会 MSB 货币服务业务 MTL 货币兑换许可证 司法协助条约（MLAT） 多边法律协助条约（MLATs）是两个或多个国家为收集和交换信息以实施民事或刑事法 律而达成的协议。这类条约有助于促进国际法律事务合作，特别是在应对涉及金融犯罪、 毒品贩运、恐怖主义及其他犯罪活动的调查、起诉和执法行动中的协助请求时。 多谱段扫描视频磁带 货币或价值转移服务
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 522 Money transfer service A financial service that accepts cash, checks, and other monetary instruments. It can store value in one location and pay a corresponding sum in cash or other form to a beneficiary in another location by means of a communication, message, transfer, or clearing network to which the money or value transfer service belongs. Transactions performed by such services can involve one or more intermediaries and a third-party final payment. A money or value transfer service may be provided by people (natural or legal) formally through the regulated financial system (such as bank accounts), informally through nonbank financial institutions and business entities, or outside of the regulated system. In some jurisdictions, informal systems are referred to as alternative remittance services or underground (or parallel) banking systems. Also known as value transfer service. See Alternative remittance system (ARS). MONEYVAL Committee of Experts on the Evaluation of Anti-Money Laundering Measures and the Financing of Terrorism MSB Money services business MTL Money transmitter license Mutual legal assistance treaty (MLAT) An agreement between two or more countries for the purpose of gathering and exchanging information in an effort to enforce civil or criminal laws. MLATs facilitate international cooperation in legal matters, particularly in response to requests for assistance in investigations, prosecutions, and enforcement actions related to financial crimes, drug trafficking, terrorism, and other criminal activities. MVTS Money or value transfer service

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第523页 非银行金融机构 非银行金融机构 NCA 国家主管机构 筑巢 该业务模式指被调查银行向其他金融机构提供下游代理服务，并通过自有代理账户处理这 些交易。代理银行在此过程中为金融机构处理交易，但未对其开展尽职调查。尽管这是代 理银行业务的常规环节，但代理银行仍需对其被调查机构实施强化尽职调查，并通过反洗 钱计划有效降低客户交易处理风险。 神经纤维缠结 非同质化代币 NGO 非政府组织 NHS 英国国家医疗服务体系 神经语言程序员 自然语言处理 提单账户 以一人名义（被指定人）持有但实际由另一人（受益所有人）拥有的金融账户。 非同质化代币（NFT） 一种独特的数字资产，用于记录艺术品或收藏品等特定物品的所有权，其所有权信息存储 于区块链上。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 523 NBFI Nonbank financial institution NCA National Competent Authority Nesting The practice whereby a respondent bank provides downstream correspondent services to other financial institutions and processes these transactions through its own correspondent account. The correspondent bank is thus processing transactions for financial institutions on which it has not conducted due diligence. Although this is a normal part of correspondent banking, it requires the correspondent bank to conduct enhanced due diligence on its respondent’s AML program to adequately mitigate the risk of processing the customer’s transactions. NFT Non-fungible token NGO Nongovernmental organization NHS The National Health Service NLP Natural language processing Nominee account A financial account that is held in the name of one person (the nominee) but is actually owned by another individual (the beneficial owner). Non-fungible token (NFT) A unique digital asset representing ownership of specific items, such as art or collectibles, recorded on a blockchain.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第524页 非政府组织（NGO） 非营利组织是指独立于政府影响运作的机构，通常致力于解决社会、人道主义、环境或倡 导领域的问题。这类组织可在地方、国家或国际层面开展活动，其运营资金主要来源于捐 赠、政府拨款及志愿者服务。值得注意的是，特别是在高风险地区或冲突区域开展工作的 非营利组织，可能成为犯罪分子的作案目标——他们利用这些组织进行洗钱活动，或将非 法资金转移用于支持恐怖主义行为。 非营利组织（NPO） 这类机构的运营目的并非为所有者或股东创造利润，而是将产生的盈余收入重新投入其 使命、活动或项目中，以造福社区或实现特定的社会、教育、慈善或环保目标。FATF 提出了一系列建议措施，旨在帮助监管机构保护那些为慈善、宗教、文化、教育、社会 或兄弟会宗旨筹集或分配资金的组织，防止其资金被恐怖主义资助者滥用或剥削。 NPO 非营利组织 来者不拒 国家风险评估 OCC 货币监理署 OCR 光学字符识别 ODD 正在进行的尽职调查 经合 经济合作与发展组织
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 524 Nongovernmental organization (NGO) A nonprofit organization that operates independently of government influence and is typically focused on addressing social, humanitarian, environmental, or advocacy issues. NGOs can operate locally, nationally, or internationally and often rely on donations, grants, and volunteer work to fund their activities. NGOs, especially those operating in high-risk jurisdictions or conflict areas, may be exploited by criminals to launder money or funnel illicit funds to support terrorist activity. Nonprofit organization (NPO) An entity that operates for purposes other than generating profit for its owners or shareholders. Instead, the organization reinvests any surplus revenue it generates into its mission, activities, or programs to benefit the community or pursue a specific social, educational, charitable, or environmental objective. FATF has suggested practices to help authorities protect organizations that raise or disburse funds for charitable, religious, cultural, educational, social, or fraternal purposes from being misused or exploited by financiers of terrorism. NPO Nonprofit organization NRA National risk assessment OCC Office of the Comptroller of the Currency OCR Optical character recognition ODD Ongoing due diligence OECD Organisation for Economic Co-Operation and Development

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第525页 外国资产管制处 外国资产管制办公室 离岸的 在涉及金融活动或实体时，通常会在个人或组织的本国以外地区设立，这些地区往往提供优 惠的税法、宽松的监管环境或完善的隐私保护措施。离岸账户和公司常被用于国际贸易、投 资等合法用途，但同时也可能引发洗钱、逃税等金融犯罪风险，甚至涉及其他非法活动。 境外银行牌照 由特定司法管辖区监管机构颁发的法律授权，允许金融机构在其本国境外以银行形式开展业 务。 离岸金融中心（OFC） 这类司法管辖区主要通过提供优惠的监管环境（包括低税率或零税率、简化监管程序及完善 的隐私保护措施）向非居民提供金融服务。个人和企业常利用此类中心开展税务优化、资产 保值、投资多元化及财富管理等多元化业务。离岸中心（OFCs）极易被用于洗钱、逃税及资 产隐匿等非法活动。为此，金融行动特别工作组等国际组织正持续加大监管力度，要求相关 机构提升透明度并完善监管标准。 发起人 向金融机构下达指令以执行电汇转账的交易方。 OSINT 开放源码情报 P2P 对等
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 525 OFAC Office of Foreign Assets Control Offshore In reference to financial activities or entities, being established outside of a person’s or organization’s home country, typically in jurisdictions that offer favorable tax laws, regulatory environments, or privacy protections. Offshore accounts and companies are often used for legitimate purposes, such as international trade or investment; however, they can also pose significant risks related to financial crime, including money laundering, tax evasion, and other illicit activities. Offshore banking license A legal authorization granted by a regulatory authority in a specific jurisdiction that allows a financial institution to operate as a bank outside its home country. Offshore financial center (OFC) A jurisdiction that provides financial services to nonresidents, primarily through a favorable regulatory environment, including low or zero taxes, minimal regulations, and privacy protections. These centers are often used by individuals and businesses for various purposes, such as tax optimization, asset protection, investment diversification, and wealth management. OFCs can be susceptible to misuse for illicit purposes, such as money laundering, tax evasion, and hiding assets. This has led to increasing scrutiny and pressure from international organizations, such as the Financial Action Task Force, to improve transparency and regulatory standards. Originator The party that places an order with a financial institution to perform a wire transfer. OSINT Open-source intelligence P2P Peer-to-peer

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第526页 透支账户（PTA） 交易账户是外国金融机构在存款机构开设的账户，其客户通过该账户开展银行业务及交易 活动。客户既可直接操作账户资金，也可通过子账户进行交易。无论采用何种方式，客户 均对账户资金拥有直接控制权。这类账户对持有机构存在风险，因为对最终使用PTA账户的 外国机构客户开展尽职调查可能存在困难。 支付服务提供商（PSP） 第三方支付服务提供商（PSP）为企业和消费者提供在线支付处理服务。其业务涵盖交易管 理、信用卡/借记卡支付网关搭建、移动支付功能支持以及替代支付方式兼容性等多元化服 务。 PBWM 私人银行与财富管理 PCMLTFA 《犯罪所得（洗钱）和恐怖主义融资法》 弹头信管 便携式文档格式 体育 私人股本 PEP 政治暴露人士 PET 隐私增强技术
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 526 Payable-through account (PTA) A transaction account a foreign financial institution opens at a depository institution through which the foreign institution’s customers engage in banking activities and transactions. This engagement may be either direct or through subaccounts. In any case, the customers have direct control over the funds in the account. These accounts pose risks to the depository institutions that hold them because it can be difficult to conduct due diligence on foreign institution customers who are ultimately using the PTA accounts. Payment service provider (PSP) A third-party company that facilitates online payment processing for businesses and consumers. PSPs offer various services including managing transactions, providing gateways for credit and debit card payments, enabling mobile payments, and supporting alternative payment methods. PBWM Private banking and wealth management PCMLTFA Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act PDF Portable document format PE Private equity PEP Politically exposed person PET Privacy-enhancing technology

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第527页 身体存在 指在某国境内实际设立实体办公场所并实施有效管理的机构，该场所需保存业务记录并接 受监管。仅存在当地代理人或基层员工并不构成实际存在。 PII 个人身份信息 pKYC 永久性KYC 放置 洗钱过程的第一阶段：非法活动所得资金的实物处置。 政治暴露人士（PEP） 根据金融行动特别工作组2012年修订版《40项建议》，被委派担任外国重要公职的人员（包 括国家元首、高级政要、政府高官、司法或军事官员、国有企业高管及重要政党官员）及其 家属和核心关联人员均属于重点监控对象。各国法规对“重点实体（PEP）”的定义存在差 异，该范畴既涵盖本国公民也包含外籍人士。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 527 Physical presence The existence of an actual brick-and-mortar location with meaningful management of the institution physically located within a country, where it maintains business records and is subject to supervision. The mere existence of a local agent or low-level staff does not constitute a physical presence. PII Personally identifiable information pKYC Perpetual KYC Placement The first stage of the money laundering process: the physical disposal of proceeds derived from illegal activity. Politically exposed person (PEP) According to the Finacial Action Task Force’s revised 40 Recommendations of 2012, an individual who has been entrusted with prominent public functions in a foreign country, such as a head of state, senior politician, senior government official, judicial or military official, senior executive of a state-owned corporation, or important political party official, as well as their families and close associates. Various country regulations define the term PEP, which may include domestic as well as foreign persons.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第528页 庞氏骗局 这种欺诈性骗局以意大利移民查尔斯·庞兹命名。他曾因诈骗4万人、骗取1500万美元资金， 在美国监狱服刑十年。庞氏骗局的核心特征是：通过新投资者投入的资金向早期投资者支 付回报，而非依靠合法经营产生的利润。这类骗局通常以虚假投资计划为幌子，以异常诱 人的回报承诺诱骗投资者入局。骗局操作者通过用新投资者的资金偿付早期投资者来维持 运作，直至骗局因资金链断裂而崩盘，或推广者携剩余资金潜逃。该模式亦被称为“金字 塔骗局”。 PPP 公私伙伴关系 PRA 审慎监管机构 从犯罪行 构成犯罪并产生犯罪所得（金融行动特别工作组已界定21项罪名）的潜在刑事犯罪行为， 可作为更严重指控（如洗钱或有组织犯罪）的依据。本质上，这些犯罪行为属于初期非法 活动，通过洗钱手段将非法所得伪装或注入金融系统。多数反洗钱法律对相关基础犯罪行 为均采用宽泛定义或列举方式。其中，基础犯罪有时被界定为重罪或“刑法典中所有罪 行”。 私人投资公司（PIC） 这类公司通常设立于保密法规严格的离岸司法管辖区，旨在保护所有者的隐私。在某些司法 管辖区，国际商业公司或豁免公司被称为私人投资公司，亦称个人投资公司。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 528 Ponzi scheme A fraudulent scheme named after Charles Ponzi, an Italian immigrant who spent 10 years in a US jail for a scheme that defrauded 40,000 people out of US$15 million. Ponzi’s name became synonymous with returns that are paid to earlier investors from the capital contributed by newer investors, rather than from profit earned by the operation of legitimate business. Ponzi schemes involve fake, nonexistent investment schemes in which investors are tricked into investing on the promise of unusually attractive returns. The operator of the scheme can keep the operation going by paying off early investors with the money from new investors until the scheme collapses under its own weight or the promoter vanishes with the remaining money. Also known as a “pyramid scheme.” PPP Public-private partnership PRA Prudential Regulatory Authority Predicate crime An underlying criminal offense that generates proceeds of crime (the Financial Action Task Force defined 21 offenses) and serves as the basis for more serious charges, such as money laundering or organized crime. In essence, these crimes are the initial illegal activities that produce illicit profits, which are then disguised or placed into the financial system through laundering efforts. Most AML laws contain a broad definition or listing of such underlying crimes. Predicate crimes are sometimes defined as felonies or “all offenses in the criminal code.” Private investment company (PIC) A type of corporation that is often established in an offshore jurisdiction with tight secrecy laws to protect the privacy of its owners. In some jurisdictions, an international business company or exempt company is referred to as a private investment company. Also known as a personal investment company.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第529页 程序段前缀 支付服务提供商 质量保证 质量保证 QC 质量控制 二维码 快速反应（代码） 危象适应并发症指数 负责任、问责制、征询意见和知情 勒索软件 恶意软件，它会阻止对系统的访问，直到支付赎金。请参阅网络犯罪。 RAS 风险偏好声明 RBA 基于风险的方法 红细胞 皇家加拿大银行公司总部所在地 RegTech 监管技术
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 529 PSP Payment service provider QA Quality assurance QC Quality control QR Quick-response (code) RACI Responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed Ransomware Malware that blocks access to a system until a ransom is paid. See Cybercrime. RAS Risk appetite statement RBA Risk-based approach RBC Royal Bank of Canada RegTech Regulatory technology

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第530页 调节器 政府机构负责对一类或多类金融机构实施监管。监管机构通常拥有制定法规、开展检查、 处以罚款与处罚、限制业务活动，甚至有时可吊销辖区内机构执照的权力。多数金融监管 机构在预防和侦破洗钱等金融犯罪方面发挥着关键作用。 汇款服务 指通过银行系统接收现金或其他资金并转至指定账户的企业。该账户由关联公司在境外 司法管辖区持有，资金最终可转移至指定收款人。此类机构亦称“往来账户托管机构” 或“外汇兑换所”。 复制犯罪 金融犯罪报告 声誉风险 在金融犯罪领域，金融机构等组织若涉及洗钱、欺诈或恐怖主义融资等非法或不道德行 为，或被认定与这些行为存在关联，其声誉可能遭受严重损害。此类风险可能源于实际事 件或市场及利益相关者中的负面认知。 被调查银行 金融机构若为其他银行代为处理交易或办理电汇等业务，通常被称为代理银行。 RFI 信息请求 日本里 信息请求
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 530 Regulator A government entity responsible for supervising and overseeing one or more categories of financial institutions. A regulator generally has authority to issue regulations, conduct examinations, impose fines and penalties, curtail activities, and, sometimes, terminate charters of institutions under its jurisdiction. Most financial regulators play a major role in preventing and detecting money laundering and other financial crimes. Remittance service A business that receives cash or other funds that it transfers through the banking system to another account. The account is held by an associated company in a foreign jurisdiction where the money is made available to the ultimate recipient. Also known as a giro house or “casa de cambio.” REP-CRIM Financial crime report Reputational risk In the context of financial crime, the potential for an organization, such as a financial institution, to suffer damage to its reputation as a result of being involved in or perceived as being associated with illegal or unethical activities, such as money laundering, fraud, or terrorist financing. This type of risk can arise from actual events or negative perceptions within the market or among stakeholders. Respondent bank A financial institution that provides services such as processing transactions and conducting wire transfers on behalf of another bank, typically referred to as the correspondent bank. RFI Request for information RI Requests for Information

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第531页 基于风险的方法（RBA） 该策略用于识别、评估和优先排序风险，从而有效配置资源并实施措施，以加强金融犯罪 风险管理。该方法侧重于高风险领域，使组织能够更高效、更有效地应对潜在威胁。 RPA 机器人流程自动化 安全港 该法律条款规定在特定情形下可免除责任或法律后果。若个人或组织出于善意向相关金融 调查部门举报可疑情况，即使对具体犯罪行为性质尚不明确，且无论是否存在违法行为， 均可避免处罚或法律追责。 SAFS 瑞士-亚洲金融服务有限公司 制裁 国家或国际组织为影响或限制特定国家、群体或个人行为而实施的惩罚性措施。此类 措施可采取多种形式。 安全分析报告 可疑活动报告 放映 通过审查和评估个人、实体或交易行为，以预防和发现与金融犯罪相关的活动。筛查机制有 助于识别风险、潜在欺诈行为或合规问题，对金融机构和企业遵守监管要求至关重要。 SDD 简化尽职调查
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 531 Risk-based approach (RBA) A strategy used to identify, assess, and prioritize risks to allocate resources and implement measures effectively in financial crime risk management. This approach emphasizes focusing on areas of higher risk, allowing organizations to address potential threats more efficiently and effectively. RPA Robotic process automation Safe harbor A legal provision that provides protection from liability or legal consequences under specific circumstances. It allows individuals or organizations to avoid penalties or legal repercussions if they report their suspicions in good faith to the relevant financial investigation unit, even if they did not know precisely what the underlying criminal activity was and regardless of whether illegal activity actually occurred. SAFS Swiss-Asia Financial Services Pte Ltd Sanctions Punitive measures imposed by countries or international organizations to influence or restrict the behavior of a specific country, group, or individual. These measures can take various forms. SAR Suspicious activity report Screening The process of reviewing and evaluating individuals, entities, or transactions to prevent and detect activities associated with financial crimes. Screening helps identify risks, potential fraud, or compliance issues and is essential for financial institutions and businesses to comply with regulatory requirements. SDD Simplified due diligence

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第532页 SDN 特别指定国家 证券交易委员会 证券交易委员会 资深外交政治人物 美国对外国政治敏感人物的称谓。参见政治敏感人物(PEP)。 立遗嘱人 指通过将资产转入信托并制定信托运作条款来设立信托的个人或实体。设立人需在信托契 约中明确信托资产的管理方式及受益人分配方案，亦称委托人、信托设立人或创建人。 穹窿下器官 英国严重欺诈办公室 壳银行 在获得牌照或宣称开展业务的国家境内，若某金融机构既无实体分支机构，也未开展实质性 业务，则属于此类机构。这类银行主要以促成交易为目的，却未从事真实银行业务，常被用 作洗钱及其他金融犯罪的工具。 壳牌公司 仅存在于纸面形式的法律实体，不具备实质性的实体运营、资产或活跃商业活动。此类实 体通常为特定目的而设立，例如获取税收优惠、保护隐私、融资需求以及便于监管合规。 壳公司常与洗钱、逃税及欺诈等非法活动相关联，因其能够掩盖金融交易与所有权结构。 SLA 服务级别协议
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 532 SDN Specially designated national SEC Securities and Exchange Commission Senior foreign political figure A US term for foreign politically exposed persons. See Politically exposed person (PEP). Settlor An individual or entity that establishes a trust by transferring assets into it and defining the terms under which the trust will operate. The settlor outlines how the trust’s assets will be managed and distributed to the beneficiaries as set out in the trust deed. Also known as a grantor, trustor, or creator. SFO UK Serious Fraud Office Shell bank A financial institution that has no physical presence or significant operations in the country where it is licensed or claims to operate. These banks primarily exist to facilitate transactions without genuine banking activities, often serving as vehicles for money laundering and other financial crimes. Shell company A legal entity that exists only on paper and has no significant physical operations, assets, or active business activities. It is often created for specific purposes, such as tax benefits, privacy, financing, and ease of regulatory compliance. Shell companies are frequently associated with illicit activities such as money laundering, tax evasion, and fraud, as they can obscure financial transactions and ownership structures. SLA Service level agreement

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第533页 SLP 苏格兰有限合伙企业 SMPC 安全多方计算 蓝精灵症 这是一种金融犯罪手法，通过将大额非法资金拆分成小额、低可疑度的交易来逃避监管， 通常交易金额低于报告阈值。该手法常与洗钱活动相关联——犯罪分子通过多次小额交易 而非一次性大额交易，试图掩盖非法所得资金的来源。“Smurfing”（斯莫夫手法）涉及 利用多人、多笔交易或两者结合的方式进行现金存款。专门从事此类交易的人员被称为 “斯莫夫”。详见结构化分析。 社会工程学 一种利用人类心理进行信息窃取、非法入侵或实施欺诈行为的操作手法。与依赖技术性黑客 手段不同，社会工程学通过诱骗手段使个体泄露敏感信息或执行危害安全的操作。 世界银行间金融电信协会（SWIFT） 一个全球性消息传输网络，旨在为金融机构提供安全标准化通信服务，用于处理国际汇 款及其他银行业务交易。 SOF 资金来源 特别目的载体 专用汽车 SRA 部门风险评估
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 533 SLP Scottish Limited Partnership SMPC Secure multiparty computation Smurfing A financial crime technique used to evade detection by breaking down large amounts of illicit funds into smaller, less suspicious transactions, usually under the reporting threshold. This approach is commonly associated with money laundering, in which individuals attempt to disguise the origins of illegally obtained money by conducting multiple small transactions instead of one large transaction. Smurfing involves the use of multiple individuals, transactions, or both for making cash deposits. Individuals hired to conduct the transactions are referred to as “smurfs.” See Structuring. Social engineering A manipulation technique that exploits human psychology to gain confidential information or unauthorized access or to execute fraudulent activities. Rather than relying on technical hacking methods, social engineering focuses on tricking individuals into revealing sensitive information or performing actions that compromise security. Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) A global messaging network that enables secure and standardized communication among financial institutions for the purpose of processing international money transfers and other banking transactions. SOF Sources of funds SPV Special purpose vehicle SRA Sectoral risk assessment

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第534页 智力严重逊常 社会保障号码 星 被盗资产回收 链 可疑交易报告 结构化 一种金融犯罪技术，用于将大量非法资金拆分为较小、可疑性较低的交易，以逃避检测、报 告要求或监管审查。例如，现金存款可能被拆分为较小金额或用于购买货币工具，以低于货 币报告阈值。参见Smurfing。 传票 由法院或其他授权机构签发的法律文书，要求个人或组织在司法程序中出庭作证或提交文 件、记录及证据。该文书是司法程序中用于强制证人参与或提供案件相关特定信息的工具。 SupTech 监控技术 可疑活动 任何引起警觉或表明可能参与洗钱、欺诈或资助恐怖主义等非法活动的行为、交易或交易 模式。请参阅异常活动或交易。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 534 SSN Social Security Number StAR Stolen Asset Recovery STR Suspicious transaction report Structuring A financial crime technique used to break down large amounts of illicit funds into smaller, less suspicious transactions to evade detection, reporting requirements, or regulatory scrutiny. For example, cash deposits may be split into smaller amounts or used to purchase monetary instruments to stay below a currency reporting threshold. See Smurfing. Subpoena A legal document issued by a court or other authorized entity that commands an individual or organization to appear and testify or produce documents, records, or evidence in a legal proceeding. It is a tool used in the judicial process to compel the participation of witnesses or the production of specific information relevant to a case. SupTech Supervisory technology Suspicious activity Any behavior, transaction, or pattern of transactions that raises red flags or indicates possible involvement in illegal activities, such as money laundering, fraud, or terrorist financing. See Unusual activity or transaction.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第535页 可疑活动报告（SAR） 金融机构及特定受监管企业若发现可疑或潜在非法活动，须向政府主管部门（通常为当地金 融情报部门）提交文件。此类活动可能涉及洗钱、欺诈、恐怖主义融资等金融犯罪行为。部 分司法管辖区将此类文件称为可疑交易报告。 SWF 主权财富基金 SWIFT 世界银行间金融电信协会 避税天堂 某些国家为外国投资者和存款人提供特殊税收优惠或避税便利。避税天堂通常实行低税 率或零税率政策，同时具备金融保密性及监管优势，因而成为实施避税和逃税计划的理 想场所。 TBML 以贸易为手段的洗钱 战术通信卫星计划 信托或公司服务提供商 恐怖主义融资 为参与恐怖活动的个人或团体提供资金支持的行为。此类资金既可能来自合法渠道，也可 能源自非法来源，主要用于资助恐怖主义相关活动，包括策划、招募、培训及实施恐怖袭 击等。资金支持可通过多种渠道提供，包括现金交易、银行转账、加密货币及非正式价值 转移系统。 法国南部 资助恐怖主义
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 535 Suspicious activity report (SAR) A document that financial institutions and certain regulated businesses are required to file with government authorities, usually the financial intelligence unit of the jurisdiction, when they detect suspicious or potentially illicit activity. Such activity may indicate money laundering, fraud, terrorist financing, or other financial crimes. Some jurisdictions call it a suspicious transaction report. SWF Sovereign wealth fund SWIFT Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication Tax haven A country that offers special tax incentives or tax avoidance to foreign investors and depositors. Tax havens typically provide low or zero tax rates, financial secrecy, and regulatory advantages, making them attractive locations for tax avoidance and evasion schemes. TBML Trade-based money laundering TCSP Trust or company service provider Terrorist financing The process of providing financial support to individuals or groups engaged in terrorist activities. This financing can come from both legal and illegal sources and is used to fund terrorism-related operations, such as planning, recruitment, training, and execution of terrorist acts. Financial support can be provided through various channels, including cash transactions, bank transfers, cryptocurrency, and informal value transfer systems. TF Terrorism financing

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第536页 钛 透明国际组织 TIN 税务识别号 提示 向个人或实体发出警告或通知，称其正在接受调查或其活动引起了怀疑，特别是涉及洗钱或 刑事调查等法律或监管事项时，属于不当或非法行为。参见信用证。 TJN 税收正义网络 TM 事务监控 TMS 事务监控系统 托尔 洋葱路由 基于贸易的洗钱（TBML） 一种洗钱方法，通过操纵贸易交易来掩盖非法资金来源。TBML 通常采用复杂的贸易手 段，通过虚高开票、虚低开票、虚构货物运输、商品信息虚假陈述及伪造发票等方式，使 非法所得资金看似合法。 TBML 具有检测难度，因其利用合法贸易惯例且常涉及多个司法管辖区，这使得监管机 构和金融机构在打击洗钱及确保符合反洗钱（AML）法规时面临重大挑战。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 536 TI Transparency International TIN Tax identification number Tipping off The improper or illegal act of alerting or notifying an individual or entity that it is being investigated or that its activities have raised suspicion, particularly in the context of legal or regulatory matters such as money laundering or criminal investigation. See Letter of credit. TJN Tax Justice Network TM Transaction monitoring TMS Transaction monitoring system TOR The Onion Routing Trade-based money laundering (TBML) A method of money laundering that involves manipulation of trade transactions to disguise the origin of illicit funds. TBML typically utilizes complex trade schemes to make illegal money appear legitimate by over- invoicing, under-invoicing, phantom shipments, misrepresentation of goods, and false invoicing. TBML is challenging to detect because it exploits legitimate trade practices and often involves multiple jurisdictions, making it a significant concern for regulatory authorities and financial institutions in efforts to combat money laundering and ensure compliance with AML regulations.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第537页 事务监控（TM） 通过系统化流程对金融交易及业务活动进行观察分析，以识别可疑行为、防范非法活动，并 确保符合法律法规要求。交易监控（TM）是反洗钱计划的核心组成部分，其通过审查客户 交易记录来识别异常或可疑模式、趋势以及不符合常规规律的异常交易。通常采用专业软件 进行交易监测，该软件会将交易行为与客户正常预期的基准值进行对比分析。 透明国际组织（TI） 该非政府组织成立于1993年，致力于打击腐败行为，并在社会各层面推动透明度、问责制与 廉洁建设。透明国际组织（TI）最著名的当属其年度《腐败感知指数》（CPI），该指数通 过评估各国公职人员腐败程度对各国进行排名。其《贿赂支付者指数》（BPI）则根据各国 行贿倾向对主要出口国进行排序。透明国际组织发布的年度《全球腐败报告》整合了CPI与 BPI数据，通过综合评估各国腐败总体水平进行排名。这些清单有助于金融机构评估特定司 法管辖区的相关风险。 信任 一种法律安排，其中一方称为委托人（或授予人），将资产转移给另一方（受托人），由 受托人代表第三方（受益人）管理这些资产。 受托人 指持有信托基金资产的专业人士、公司或个人（无论是否领取报酬），其资产与受托人自 身资产相互独立。受托人依据设立人信托契约对资产进行投资及处置，并充分考虑遗嘱中 的各项意愿条款。 对敌贸易法 《与敌交易法》评析 阿拉伯联合酋长国 阿拉伯联合酋长国
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 537 Transaction monitoring (TM) The systematic process of observing and analyzing financial transactions and activities to detect suspicious behavior, prevent illicit activities, and ensure compliance with laws and regulations. TM is a critical component of an AML program in which customer activity is reviewed for unusual or suspicious patterns, trends, or outlying transactions that do not fit a normal pattern. Transactions are often monitored using software that weighs the activity against a threshold of what is deemed normal and expected for the customer. Transparency International (TI) A nongovernmental organization founded in 1993 that aims to combat corruption and promote transparency, accountability, and integrity at all levels of society. TI is best known for its annual Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI), which ranks countries by perceived levels of corruption among public officials. Its Bribe Payers Index (BPI) ranks the leading exporting countries according to their propensity to bribe. TI’s annual Global Corruption Report combines the CPI and BPI and ranks each country by its overall level of corruption. The lists help financial institutions determine the risk associated with a particular jurisdiction. Trust A legal arrangement in which one party, known as the trustor (or grantor), transfers assets to another party (the trustee), who manages those assets for the benefit of a third party, known as the beneficiary. Trustee A paid or unpaid professional, company, or individual who holds the assets in a trust fund separate from the trustee’s own assets. The trustee invests and disposes of the assets in accordance with the settlor’s trust deed, taking into consideration any letter of wishes. TWEA Trading with the Enemy Act UAE United Arab Emirates

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第538页 UAR 异常活动报告 上身肥胖症 最终受益所有人 最终受益所有人（UBO） 最终拥有或控制公司或法律实体的个人或群体，即使其所有权未在公开文件中直接记载。 最终受益人（UBOs）是享有所有权权益的最终受益者，包括财务收益或对实体的控制权。 UBO 身份识别通常需要通过层层公司或实体追溯所有权结构，以确定最终从业务运营中获 益的个人。由于结构复杂，UBO 身份可能难以明确；在某些情况下，间接所有权的聚合可 能导致某人被认定为UBO 。 联合国 联合国 联合国安全理事会第1373（2001）号决议 该决议于2001年通过，旨在加强国际反恐合作，并制定全球范围内预防和打击恐怖活动的 措施。决议促使各成员国通过或修订相关法律法规，以防范恐怖主义并遏制其资金来源。 该决议还要求成员国“在涉及恐怖主义行为融资或支持的刑事调查或刑事诉讼中，相互提 供最大程度的协助”。 本决议确立的原则至今仍对国际反恐行动产生深远影响，并持续指导联合国各机构及参与 安全与反恐倡议的组织开展工作。 地下银行业务 参见替代汇款系统。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 538 UAR Unusual activity report UBO Ultimate beneficial owner Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) The individual or individuals who ultimately own or control a company or legal entity, even if their ownership is not directly recorded in public documents. UBOs are the final beneficiaries who enjoy the benefits of ownership, such as financial gains or control over the entity. UBO identification often involves tracing ownership structures through layers of companies or entities to review the individuals who ultimately benefit from the business operations. It may not be obvious who the UBO is due to a complex structure, and, in certain situations, aggregation of indirect ownership may result in an individual being identified as the UBO. UN United Nations UN Security Council Resolution 1373 (2001) Adopted in 2001, a resolution that aims to enhance international cooperation in combating terrorism and establish measures for preventing and suppressing terrorist activities globally. It prompted member nations to adopt or strengthen laws and regulations aimed at preventing terrorism and addressing its financing. The resolution also required member nations to “afford one another the greatest measure of assistance for criminal investigations or criminal proceedings relating to the financing or support of terrorist acts.” The principles established in this resolution continue to influence international counterterrorism efforts and the work of various UN agencies and bodies involved in security and anti-terrorism initiatives. Underground banking See alternative remittance system.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第539页 联合国（UN） 联合国是一个成立于1945年（第二次世界大战结束后不久）的国际组织，由51个国家共同创 立，其主要目标是促进各国之间的和平、安全与合作。该组织通过多种框架、公约及倡议措 施打击金融犯罪，重点解决洗钱、腐败及恐怖主义融资等问题。其中“全球反洗钱计划”作 为联合国毒品管制与犯罪预防办公室的核心工具，至今全球几乎所有国家都已成为联合国成 员国。详见《维也纳公约》。 UNOCT 联合国反恐怖主义办公室 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 联合国安全理事会 联合国安全理事会 UNTAD 联合国贸易和发展 异常活动或交易 任何偏离客户正常行为或既定模式的金融活动，均可能引发怀疑，并提示存在洗钱、欺 诈或其他金融犯罪等潜在非法行为。 美国 合众国 美国爱国者法案 该法案于2001年10月26日颁布，旨在提升美国政府打击恐怖主义的能力，并在9·11事件后加 强国家安全。其全称缩写为“提供拦截和阻断恐怖主义所需适当工具”。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 539 United Nations (UN) An international organization founded in 1945, shortly after World War II, by 51 countries with the primary goal of promoting peace, security, and cooperation among countries. The UN addresses financial crime through various frameworks, conventions, and initiatives aimed at combating issues such as money laundering, corruption, and terrorist financing. One such initiative is the Global Program against Money Laundering, which is the key instrument of the UN Office of Drug Control and Crime Prevention. As of today, almost every nation in the world belongs to the UN. See Vienna Convention. UNOCT United Nations Office of Counter-Terrorism UNODC United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime UNSC United Nations Security Council UNTAD United Nations Trade and Development Unusual activity or transaction Any financial activity that deviates from a customer’s normal behavior or established patterns. This type of activity raises suspicions and may indicate potential illicit conduct such as money laundering, fraud, or other financial crimes. US United States USA PATRIOT Act Enacted on October 26, 2001, a law designed to enhance the US government’s ability to combat terrorism and strengthen national security in the aftermath of the September 11 attacks. The acronym stands for “Providing Appropriate Tools Required to Intercept and Obstruct Terrorism.”

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第540页 《美国爱国者法案》显著改变了美国国家安全与执法领域的格局，体现了在恐怖主义事件后 对感知威胁采取的响应性应对策略。 极限强度设计 美元 美国商务部 美元币 美国运输部 美元Tether 增值服务提供商 虚拟资产服务提供商 VAT 增值税 静脉曲张 风险投资 维也纳公约 1988年《联合国禁止非法贩运麻醉药品和精神药物公约》（通称《1988年维也纳公约》）是 一项旨在应对日益严重的非法毒品生产与贩运问题的国际条约。各缔约国承诺将毒品贩运及 相关洗钱行为定为刑事犯罪，并制定没收毒品贩运所得的法律措施。公约第三条对洗钱行为 作出了全面界定，这一定义已成为后续各国立法的重要依据。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 540 The USA PATRIOT Act significantly altered the landscape of national security and law enforcement in the US, reflecting a responsive approach to perceived threats in the wake of terrorism. USD US dollar USDC USD Coin USDT US dollar Tether VASP Virtual asset service provider VAT Value-added tax VC Venture capital Vienna Convention The 1988 United Nations Convention Against Illicit Trade in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances, commonly referred to as the “1988 Vienna Convention,” an international treaty aimed at combating the growing problem of illicit drug production and trafficking. Signing countries of the Convention commit to criminalizing drug trafficking and associated money laundering and enacting measures for the confiscation of the proceeds of drug trafficking. Article III of the Convention provides a comprehensive definition of money laundering, which has been the basis of much subsequent national legislation.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第541页 虚拟资产服务提供商（VASP） 该数字平台支持用户买卖和交易加密货币。这些交易所作为买卖双方的中介，可实现数 字资产与其他加密货币或法定货币之间的兑换。VASP（虚拟资产服务提供商）的典型 代表包括加密货币交易所、钱包服务商及支付处理机构。 虚拟货币 一种在数字空间中运作的交换媒介，通常可转换为法定货币或政府发行的货币，或用作真 实货币的替代品。 卖主部件编号 虚拟专用网 钱包提供商 该服务提供数字钱包功能，用于存储、管理及交易加密货币等数字资产。用户可通过这些 钱包安全保管加密货币、实时追踪账户余额，并完成资金转账等交易操作。 举报人 指举报或披露组织内其认为非法、不道德或与组织政策不符的信息或活动的个人。举报内容 可涵盖欺诈、腐败、违规操作、安全隐患等各类不当行为。多数司法管辖区为举报人提供法 律保护，使其免遭雇主报复或歧视，而任何试图识别举报人者都将使企业及其高管层面临严 重后果。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 541 Virtual asset service provider (VASP) A digital platform that allows users to buy, sell, and trade cryptocurrencies. These exchanges serve as intermediaries between buyers and sellers, facilitating the exchange of digital assets for other cryptocurrencies or fiat currencies. Examples of VASPs include cryptocurrency exchanges, wallet providers, and payment processors. Virtual currency A medium of exchange that operates in the digital space and can typically be either converted into a fiat, or government-issued, currency or used as a substitute for real currency. VPN Virtual private network Wallet provider A service that offers digital wallets for storing, managing, and transacting with cryptocurrencies and other digital assets. These wallets allow users to securely hold their cryptocurrencies, track their balances, and perform transactions such as sending and receiving funds. Whistleblower An individual who reports or exposes information or activities within an organization that the individual believes to be illegal, unethical, or inconsistent with the organization’s policies. This can include reporting wrongdoing such as fraud, corruption, violations of regulations, safety concerns, or other misconduct. In many jurisdictions, whistleblowers are given legal protection to prevent retaliation or discrimination by their employer as a result of their disclosures, and any attempts to identify them can have serious consequences for the organization and its senior management.

items.zh_text: 反洗钱专家认证证书 7.0版 第542页 故意性盲视 这一法律原则在美国洗钱案件中具有适用性，法院将其定义为‘蓄意回避事实认知’ 或‘故意漠视’。司法实践表明，故意视而不见等同于明知资金非法来源或知晓洗钱交 易中客户的真实意图。 电汇 金融机构为自身或客户进行的资金电子转账。电汇属于金融工具范畴，受多国反洗钱监管 要求约束。 WMD 大规模毁灭性武器 沃尔夫斯贝格集团 该协会由13家全球金融机构于2000年成立，旨在应对私人银行业务领域日益严重的金融犯罪 问题。此后，协会陆续发布了关于代理银行业务及恐怖主义融资等领域的多项指导文件，致 力于通过最佳实践促进金融犯罪风险管理的有效实施，并全面提升金融体系的整体诚信水 平。 世界银行 对发展中国家至关重要的财政和技术援助来源。该机构并非传统意义上的银行，而是由189 个成员拥有的五个组织构成。世界银行在塑造全球反洗钱应对机制中发挥着关键作用：通过 支持各国建立有效的监管与制度框架、促进国际合作，并资助必要改革以提升金融诚信度， 从而为全球反洗钱工作提供有力支撑。
items.en_text: Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist Version 7.0 Page 542 Willful blindness A legal principle that operates in money laundering cases in the US and that courts define as the “deliberate avoidance of knowledge of the facts” or “purposeful indifference.” Courts have held that willful blindness is the equivalent of actual knowledge of the illegal source of funds or of the intentions of a customer in a money laundering transaction. Wire transfer An electronic transmission of funds among financial institutions on behalf of themselves or their customers. Wire transfers are financial vehicles covered by the regulatory requirements of many countries in the AML effort. WMD Weapon of mass destruction Wolfsberg Group An association of 13 global financial institutions established in 2000 in response to growing concerns about financial crime within the private banking sector. Since then, it has issued several guidelines on correspondent banking and terrorist financing, among others, and aims to promote effective financial crime risk management and strengthen the overall integrity of the financial system through best practices. World Bank A vital source of financial and technical assistance to developing countries. It is not a bank in the traditional sense but is made up of five organizations owned by 189 members. The World Bank plays a crucial role in shaping the global response to money laundering by supporting countries in building effective regulatory and institutional frameworks, facilitating international cooperation, and funding necessary reforms to enhance financial integrity.
